MON_FLYING_SKULL.name: Flying skull
MON_FLYING_SKULL.flavorText: A pack of skulls animated by necromantic spells.
MON_FLYING_SKULL.description: A pack of skulls animated by necromantic spells.

MON_GIANT_TARANTULA.name: Giant tarantula
MON_GIANT_TARANTULA.flavorText: A giant spider with hairy black and red legs.
MON_GIANT_TARANTULA.description: A giant spider with hairy black and red legs.

MON_GIANT_CLEAR_CENTIPEDE.name: Giant clear centipede
MON_GIANT_CLEAR_CENTIPEDE.flavorText: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.
MON_GIANT_CLEAR_CENTIPEDE.description: It is about four feet long and carnivorous.

MON_MIRKWOOD_SPIDER.name: Mirkwood spider
MON_MIRKWOOD_SPIDER.flavorText: A strong and powerful spider from Mirkwood forest. Cunning and evil, it seeks to taste your juicy insides.
MON_MIRKWOOD_SPIDER.description: A strong and powerful spider from Mirkwood forest. Cunning and evil, it seeks to taste your juicy insides.

MON_FROST_GIANT.name: Frost giant
MON_FROST_GIANT.flavorText: A twelve foot tall giant covered in furs.
MON_FROST_GIANT.description: A twelve foot tall giant covered in furs.

MON_GRIFFON.name: Griffon
MON_GRIFFON.flavorText: It is half lion, half eagle. It flies menacingly towards you.
MON_GRIFFON.description: It is half lion, half eagle. It flies menacingly towards you.

MON_HOMUNCULUS.name: Homunculus
MON_HOMUNCULUS.flavorText: It is a small demonic spirit full of malevolence.
MON_HOMUNCULUS.description: It is a small demonic spirit full of malevolence.

MON_CLEAR_HOUND.name: Clear hound
MON_CLEAR_HOUND.flavorText: A faint sense of motion in the air, hound shaped, stands before you.
MON_CLEAR_HOUND.description: A faint sense of motion in the air, hound shaped, stands before you.

MON_UMBER_HULK.name: Umber hulk
MON_UMBER_HULK.flavorText: This bizarre creature has glaring eyes and large mandibles capable of slicing through rock.
MON_UMBER_HULK.description: This bizarre creature has glaring eyes and large mandibles capable of slicing through rock.

MON_RUST_MONSTER.name: Rust monster
MON_RUST_MONSTER.flavorText: It is a weird, small animal with two antennae popping forth from its forehead. It looks hungry.
MON_RUST_MONSTER.description: It is a weird, small animal with two antennae popping forth from its forehead. It looks hungry.

MON_OGRILLON.name: Ogrillon
MON_OGRILLON.flavorText: An unholy hybrid of ogre and orc.
MON_OGRILLON.description: An unholy hybrid of ogre and orc.

MON_GELATINOUS_CUBE.name: Gelatinous cube
MON_GELATINOUS_CUBE.flavorText: It is a strange, vast gelatinous structure that assumes cubic proportions as it lines all four walls of the corridors it patrols. Through its transparent jelly structure you can see treasures it has engulfed, and a few corpses as well.
MON_GELATINOUS_CUBE.description: It is a strange, vast gelatinous structure that assumes cubic proportions as it lines all four walls of the corridors it patrols. Through its transparent jelly structure you can see treasures it has engulfed, and a few corpses as well.

MON_FIRE_GIANT.name: Fire giant
MON_FIRE_GIANT.flavorText: A glowing fourteen foot tall giant. Flames drip from its red skin.
MON_FIRE_GIANT.description: A glowing fourteen foot tall giant. Flames drip from its red skin.

MON_HUMMERHORN.name: Hummerhorn
MON_HUMMERHORN.flavorText: A giant buzzing wasp, its stinger drips venom.
MON_HUMMERHORN.description: A giant buzzing wasp, its stinger drips venom.

MON_LIZARD_MAN.name: Lizard man
MON_LIZARD_MAN.flavorText: Intelligent lizard beings from the depths.
MON_LIZARD_MAN.description: Intelligent lizard beings from the depths.

MON_CREBAIN.name: Crebain
MON_CREBAIN.flavorText: A type of crow, specially bred by the forces of evil as spies; their rudimentary intelligence guided by an evil mind has tracked you down, and now they seek to alert other evil creatures to your presence.
MON_CREBAIN.description: A type of crow, specially bred by the forces of evil as spies; their rudimentary intelligence guided by an evil mind has tracked you down, and now they seek to alert other evil creatures to your presence.

MON_BERSERKER.name: Berserker
MON_BERSERKER.flavorText: Even the strongest of normal human warriors fears the Berserker - the one who can drive himself into such a terrible battle-frenzy that he can survive blows which should kill him, and still apparently feel no pain.  He tramples weaker creatures underfoot in his eagerness to get to his real enemy, and his battle-cry strikes terror into his foes.
MON_BERSERKER.description: Even the strongest of normal human warriors fears the Berserker - the one who can drive himself into such a terrible battle-frenzy that he can survive blows which should kill him, and still apparently feel no pain.  He tramples weaker creatures underfoot in his eagerness to get to his real enemy, and his battle-cry strikes terror into his foes.

MON_QUASIT.name: Quasit
MON_QUASIT.flavorText: The chaotic evil master's favourite pet.
MON_QUASIT.description: The chaotic evil master's favourite pet.

MON_SPHINX.name: Sphinx
MON_SPHINX.flavorText: It will eat you if you cannot answer its riddle.
MON_SPHINX.description: It will eat you if you cannot answer its riddle.

MON_IMP.name: Imp
MON_IMP.flavorText: The lawful evil master's favourite pet.
MON_IMP.description: The lawful evil master's favourite pet.

MON_FREEZING_SPHERE.name: Freezing sphere
MON_FREEZING_SPHERE.flavorText: A semi-sentient snowball, hurling itself at targets at random.
MON_FREEZING_SPHERE.description: A semi-sentient snowball, hurling itself at targets at random.

MON_JUMPING_FIREBALL.name: Jumping fireball
MON_JUMPING_FIREBALL.flavorText: A semi-sentient fireball that moves around randomly.
MON_JUMPING_FIREBALL.description: A semi-sentient fireball that moves around randomly.

MON_BALL_LIGHTNING.name: Ball lightning
MON_BALL_LIGHTNING.flavorText: A crackling ball of energy, zooming about seemingly at random.
MON_BALL_LIGHTNING.description: A crackling ball of energy, zooming about seemingly at random.

MON_2_HEADED_HYDRA.name: 2-headed hydra
MON_2_HEADED_HYDRA.flavorText: A strange reptilian creature with two heads, guarding its hoard.
MON_2_HEADED_HYDRA.description: A strange reptilian creature with two heads, guarding its hoard.

MON_SWAMP_THING.name: Swamp thing
MON_SWAMP_THING.flavorText: A creature that was once human, but is now as green as moss.
MON_SWAMP_THING.description: A creature that was once human, but is now as green as moss.

MON_EARTH_SPIRIT.name: Earth spirit
MON_EARTH_SPIRIT.flavorText: A whirling form of sentient rock.
MON_EARTH_SPIRIT.description: A whirling form of sentient rock.

MON_FIRE_HOUND.name: Fire hound
MON_FIRE_HOUND.flavorText: Flames lick at its feet and its tongue is a blade of fire. You can feel a furnace heat radiating from the creature.
MON_FIRE_HOUND.description: Flames lick at its feet and its tongue is a blade of fire. You can feel a furnace heat radiating from the creature.

MON_COLD_HOUND.name: Cold hound
MON_COLD_HOUND.flavorText: A hound as tall as a man, this creature appears to be composed of angular planes of ice. Cold radiates from it and freezes your breath in the air.
MON_COLD_HOUND.description: A hound as tall as a man, this creature appears to be composed of angular planes of ice. Cold radiates from it and freezes your breath in the air.

MON_ENERGY_HOUND.name: Energy hound
MON_ENERGY_HOUND.flavorText: Saint Elmo's Fire forms a ghostly halo around this hound, and sparks sting your fingers as energy builds up in the air around you.
MON_ENERGY_HOUND.description: Saint Elmo's Fire forms a ghostly halo around this hound, and sparks sting your fingers as energy builds up in the air around you.

MON_LESSER_MIMIC.name: Lesser Mimic
MON_LESSER_MIMIC.flavorText: A strange creature that disguises itself as some object to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.
MON_LESSER_MIMIC.description: A strange creature that disguises itself as some object to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

MON_DOOR_MIMIC.name: Door mimic
MON_DOOR_MIMIC.flavorText: A strange creature that disguises itself as a door to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.
MON_DOOR_MIMIC.description: A strange creature that disguises itself as a door to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

MON_BLINK_DOG.name: Blink dog
MON_BLINK_DOG.flavorText: A strange magical member of the canine race, its form seems to shimmer and fade in front of your very eyes.
MON_BLINK_DOG.description: A strange magical member of the canine race, its form seems to shimmer and fade in front of your very eyes.

MON_URUK.name: Uruk
MON_URUK.flavorText: It is a cunning orc of power, as tall as a man, and stronger. It fears little.
MON_URUK.description: It is a cunning orc of power, as tall as a man, and stronger. It fears little.

MON_SHAGRAT_THE_ORC_CAPTAIN.name: Shagrat, the Orc Captain
MON_SHAGRAT_THE_ORC_CAPTAIN.flavorText: He is an orc of power and great cunning, leader of the garrison at Cirith Ungol.
MON_SHAGRAT_THE_ORC_CAPTAIN.description: He is an orc of power and great cunning, leader of the garrison at Cirith Ungol.

MON_GORBAG_THE_ORC_CAPTAIN.name: Gorbag, the Orc Captain
MON_GORBAG_THE_ORC_CAPTAIN.flavorText: He is an orc of power and great cunning, leader of the garrison at Minas Morgul.
MON_GORBAG_THE_ORC_CAPTAIN.description: He is an orc of power and great cunning, leader of the garrison at Minas Morgul.

MON_SHAMBLING_MOUND.name: Shambling mound
MON_SHAMBLING_MOUND.flavorText: A pile of rotting vegetation that slides towards you with a disgusting stench, waking all it nears.
MON_SHAMBLING_MOUND.description: A pile of rotting vegetation that slides towards you with a disgusting stench, waking all it nears.

MON_GIANT_VENUS_FLYTRAP.name: Giant Venus Flytrap
MON_GIANT_VENUS_FLYTRAP.flavorText: A carnivorous plant that is difficult to detect, until it suddenly snaps shut around its prey and releases paralysing enzymes to stop its struggles.
MON_GIANT_VENUS_FLYTRAP.description: A carnivorous plant that is difficult to detect, until it suddenly snaps shut around its prey and releases paralysing enzymes to stop its struggles.

MON_GIANT_BRONZE_DRAGON_FLY.name: Giant bronze dragon fly
MON_GIANT_BRONZE_DRAGON_FLY.flavorText: This vast gleaming bronze fly has wings which beat mesmerically fast.
MON_GIANT_BRONZE_DRAGON_FLY.description: This vast gleaming bronze fly has wings which beat mesmerically fast.

MON_STONE_GIANT.name: Stone giant
MON_STONE_GIANT.flavorText: It is eighteen feet tall and looking at you.
MON_STONE_GIANT.description: It is eighteen feet tall and looking at you.

MON_GIANT_BLACK_DRAGON_FLY.name: Giant black dragon fly
MON_GIANT_BLACK_DRAGON_FLY.flavorText: The size of a large bird, this fly drips caustic acid.
MON_GIANT_BLACK_DRAGON_FLY.description: The size of a large bird, this fly drips caustic acid.

MON_STONE_GOLEM.name: Stone golem
MON_STONE_GOLEM.flavorText: It is a massive animated statue.
MON_STONE_GOLEM.description: It is a massive animated statue.

MON_RED_MOLD.name: Red mold
MON_RED_MOLD.flavorText: It is a strange red growth on the dungeon floor; it seems to burn with flame.
MON_RED_MOLD.description: It is a strange red growth on the dungeon floor; it seems to burn with flame.

MON_GIANT_GOLD_DRAGON_FLY.name: Giant gold dragon fly
MON_GIANT_GOLD_DRAGON_FLY.flavorText: Large beating wings support this dazzling insect. A loud buzzing noise pervades the air.
MON_GIANT_GOLD_DRAGON_FLY.description: Large beating wings support this dazzling insect. A loud buzzing noise pervades the air.

MON_GHAST.name: Ghast
MON_GHAST.flavorText: This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs of them. It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.
MON_GHAST.description: This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs of them. It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.

MON_NEEKERBREEKER.name: Neekerbreeker
MON_NEEKERBREEKER.flavorText: Believed to be an evil relative of the cricket, this creature gets its name from its incessant squeaking, which can best be described as "neek-breek, neek-breek".  The noise can drive people frantic, and worse still, can be heard for quite some distance, alerting other monsters to your presence.
MON_NEEKERBREEKER.description: Believed to be an evil relative of the cricket, this creature gets its name from its incessant squeaking, which can best be described as "neek-breek, neek-breek".  The noise can drive people frantic, and worse still, can be heard for quite some distance, alerting other monsters to your presence.

MON_HUORN.name: Huorn
MON_HUORN.flavorText: A very strong near-sentient tree, which has become hostile to other living things.
MON_HUORN.description: A very strong near-sentient tree, which has become hostile to other living things.

MON_BOLG_SON_OF_AZOG.name: Bolg, Son of Azog
MON_BOLG_SON_OF_AZOG.flavorText: A large and powerful orc, he looks just like his father. He is tall and fast, but fortunately blessed with orcish brains.
MON_BOLG_SON_OF_AZOG.description: A large and powerful orc, he looks just like his father. He is tall and fast, but fortunately blessed with orcish brains.

MON_PHASE_SPIDER.name: Phase spider
MON_PHASE_SPIDER.flavorText: A spider that never seems quite there. Everywhere you look it is just half-seen in the corner of one eye.
MON_PHASE_SPIDER.description: A spider that never seems quite there. Everywhere you look it is just half-seen in the corner of one eye.

MON_LANDMINE.name: Landmine
MON_LANDMINE.flavorText: It was left here to be used against intruders.
MON_LANDMINE.description: It was left here to be used against intruders.

MON_WYVERN.name: Wyvern
MON_WYVERN.flavorText: A fast-moving and deadly draconian animal. Beware its poisonous sting!
MON_WYVERN.description: A fast-moving and deadly draconian animal. Beware its poisonous sting!

MON_GREAT_EAGLE.name: Great eagle
MON_GREAT_EAGLE.flavorText: Greater and more intelligent than most of its kind, this great eagle is a messenger between the forces of good.
MON_GREAT_EAGLE.description: Greater and more intelligent than most of its kind, this great eagle is a messenger between the forces of good.

MON_EARTH_HOUND.name: Earth hound
MON_EARTH_HOUND.flavorText: A beautiful crystalline shape does not disguise the danger this hound clearly presents. Your flesh tingles as it approaches.
MON_EARTH_HOUND.description: A beautiful crystalline shape does not disguise the danger this hound clearly presents. Your flesh tingles as it approaches.

MON_AIR_HOUND.name: Air hound
MON_AIR_HOUND.flavorText: Swirling vapours surround this beast as it floats towards you, seemingly walking on air. Noxious gases sting your throat.
MON_AIR_HOUND.description: Swirling vapours surround this beast as it floats towards you, seemingly walking on air. Noxious gases sting your throat.

MON_SABRE_TOOTH_TIGER.name: Sabre-tooth tiger
MON_SABRE_TOOTH_TIGER.flavorText: A fierce and dangerous cat, its huge tusks and sharp claws would lacerate even the strongest armour.
MON_SABRE_TOOTH_TIGER.description: A fierce and dangerous cat, its huge tusks and sharp claws would lacerate even the strongest armour.

MON_ACID_HOUND.name: Acid hound
MON_ACID_HOUND.flavorText: Footprints are burned in the ground behind this hound as it pads around the dungeon. An acrid smell of acid rises from the dog's pelt.
MON_ACID_HOUND.description: Footprints are burned in the ground behind this hound as it pads around the dungeon. An acrid smell of acid rises from the dog's pelt.

MON_CHIMAERA.name: Chimaera
MON_CHIMAERA.flavorText: It is a strange concoction of goat, lion and dragon, with the heads of all three beasts.
MON_CHIMAERA.description: It is a strange concoction of goat, lion and dragon, with the heads of all three beasts.

MON_QUYLTHULG.name: Quylthulg
MON_QUYLTHULG.flavorText: It is a strange pulsing mound of flesh.
MON_QUYLTHULG.description: It is a strange pulsing mound of flesh.

MON_SASQUATCH.name: Sasquatch
MON_SASQUATCH.flavorText: A tall shaggy, furry humanoid, it could call the yeti brother.
MON_SASQUATCH.description: A tall shaggy, furry humanoid, it could call the yeti brother.

MON_RANGER.name: Ranger
MON_RANGER.flavorText: A warrior who is at one with nature.  A master of both bow and sword, with minor spellcasting skills.
MON_RANGER.description: A warrior who is at one with nature.  A master of both bow and sword, with minor spellcasting skills.

MON_PALADIN.name: Paladin
MON_PALADIN.flavorText: A warrior for a holy cause.  Unfortunately, his god is not yours, and there is rivalry even between the various gods of Good, so he is your enemy.
MON_PALADIN.description: A warrior for a holy cause.  Unfortunately, his god is not yours, and there is rivalry even between the various gods of Good, so he is your enemy.

MON_WEREWOLF.name: Werewolf
MON_WEREWOLF.flavorText: It is a huge wolf with eyes that glow with manly intelligence.
MON_WEREWOLF.description: It is a huge wolf with eyes that glow with manly intelligence.

MON_DARK_ELVEN_LORD.name: Dark elven lord
MON_DARK_ELVEN_LORD.flavorText: A dark elven figure in armour and radiating evil power.
MON_DARK_ELVEN_LORD.description: A dark elven figure in armour and radiating evil power.

MON_CLOUD_GIANT.name: Cloud giant
MON_CLOUD_GIANT.flavorText: It is a twenty foot tall giant wreathed in clouds.
MON_CLOUD_GIANT.description: It is a twenty foot tall giant wreathed in clouds.

MON_UGLUK_THE_URUK.name: Ugluk, the Uruk
MON_UGLUK_THE_URUK.flavorText: A strong and cunning orc warrior, the commander of Saruman's orcish horde.
MON_UGLUK_THE_URUK.description: A strong and cunning orc warrior, the commander of Saruman's orcish horde.

MON_BLUE_DRAGON_BAT.name: Blue dragon bat
MON_BLUE_DRAGON_BAT.flavorText: It is a glowing blue bat with a sharp tail.
MON_BLUE_DRAGON_BAT.description: It is a glowing blue bat with a sharp tail.

MON_MIMIC.name: Mimic
MON_MIMIC.flavorText: A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.
MON_MIMIC.description: A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

MON_ULTIMATE_MIMIC.name: Ultimate Mimic
MON_ULTIMATE_MIMIC.flavorText: A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.
MON_ULTIMATE_MIMIC.description: A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

MON_ACID_VORTEX.name: Acid vortex
MON_ACID_VORTEX.flavorText: A caustic spinning whirlpool of foaming, steaming water.
MON_ACID_VORTEX.description: A caustic spinning whirlpool of foaming, steaming water.

MON_LUGDUSH_THE_URUK.name: Lugdush, the Uruk
MON_LUGDUSH_THE_URUK.flavorText: A large and powerful orc, captain of one of Saruman's orcish regiments.
MON_LUGDUSH_THE_URUK.description: A large and powerful orc, captain of one of Saruman's orcish regiments.

MON_ENERGY_VORTEX.name: Energy vortex
MON_ENERGY_VORTEX.flavorText: A shimmering tornado of air, sparks crackle along its length.
MON_ENERGY_VORTEX.description: A shimmering tornado of air, sparks crackle along its length.

MON_GLOBEFISH.name: Globefish
MON_GLOBEFISH.flavorText: This fish is among the most poisonous creatures there are.
MON_GLOBEFISH.description: This fish is among the most poisonous creatures there are.

MON_GIANT_FIREFLY.name: Giant firefly
MON_GIANT_FIREFLY.flavorText: Clouds of these monsters light up the dungeon - so brightly that you can barely see through them.
MON_GIANT_FIREFLY.description: Clouds of these monsters light up the dungeon - so brightly that you can barely see through them.

MON_MUMMIFIED_ORC.name: Mummified orc
MON_MUMMIFIED_ORC.flavorText: It is an orcish figure covered in wrappings.
MON_MUMMIFIED_ORC.description: It is an orcish figure covered in wrappings.

MON_WOLF_CHIEFTAIN.name: Wolf chieftain
MON_WOLF_CHIEFTAIN.flavorText: A great wolf-chieftain whose pack is in the service of the Dark Lord, and whose howls strike fear into even the boldest heart.
MON_WOLF_CHIEFTAIN.description: A great wolf-chieftain whose pack is in the service of the Dark Lord, and whose howls strike fear into even the boldest heart.

MON_VAMPIRIC_MIST.name: Vampiric mist
MON_VAMPIRIC_MIST.flavorText: A cloud of evil, sentient mist.
MON_VAMPIRIC_MIST.description: A cloud of evil, sentient mist.

MON_KILLER_STAG_BEETLE.name: Killer stag beetle
MON_KILLER_STAG_BEETLE.flavorText: It is a giant beetle with vicious claws.
MON_KILLER_STAG_BEETLE.description: It is a giant beetle with vicious claws.

MON_IRON_GOLEM.name: Iron golem
MON_IRON_GOLEM.flavorText: It is a massive metal statue that moves steadily towards you.
MON_IRON_GOLEM.description: It is a massive metal statue that moves steadily towards you.

MON_AUTO_ROLLER.name: Auto-roller
MON_AUTO_ROLLER.flavorText: It looks like a huge spiked roller, moving on its own towards you.
MON_AUTO_ROLLER.description: It looks like a huge spiked roller, moving on its own towards you.

MON_GIANT_YELLOW_SCORPION.name: Giant yellow scorpion
MON_GIANT_YELLOW_SCORPION.flavorText: It is a giant scorpion with a sharp stinger.
MON_GIANT_YELLOW_SCORPION.description: It is a giant scorpion with a sharp stinger.

MON_BLACK_OOZE.name: Black ooze
MON_BLACK_OOZE.flavorText: It is a strangely moving puddle.
MON_BLACK_OOZE.description: It is a strangely moving puddle.

MON_HARDENED_WARRIOR.name: Hardened warrior
MON_HARDENED_WARRIOR.flavorText: A scarred warrior who moves with confidence.
MON_HARDENED_WARRIOR.description: A scarred warrior who moves with confidence.

MON_AZOG_KING_OF_THE_URUK_HAI.name: Azog, King of the Uruk-Hai
MON_AZOG_KING_OF_THE_URUK_HAI.flavorText: He is also known as the King of Khazad-dum. His ego is renowned to be bigger than his head.
MON_AZOG_KING_OF_THE_URUK_HAI.description: He is also known as the King of Khazad-dum. His ego is renowned to be bigger than his head.

MON_DARK_ELVEN_WARLOCK.name: Dark elven warlock
MON_DARK_ELVEN_WARLOCK.flavorText: A dark elven mage with spells of frightening destructive power.
MON_DARK_ELVEN_WARLOCK.description: A dark elven mage with spells of frightening destructive power.

MON_MASTER_ROGUE.name: Master rogue
MON_MASTER_ROGUE.flavorText: A thief of great power and shifty speed.
MON_MASTER_ROGUE.description: A thief of great power and shifty speed.

MON_RED_DRAGON_BAT.name: Red dragon bat
MON_RED_DRAGON_BAT.flavorText: It is a sharp-tailed bat, wreathed in fire.
MON_RED_DRAGON_BAT.description: It is a sharp-tailed bat, wreathed in fire.

MON_ICE_SKELETON.name: Ice skeleton
MON_ICE_SKELETON.flavorText: It is a skeleton covered in frost.
MON_ICE_SKELETON.description: It is a skeleton covered in frost.

MON_ANGAMAITE_OF_UMBAR.name: Angamaite of Umbar
MON_ANGAMAITE_OF_UMBAR.flavorText: A Black Numenorean who hates the men of the west.
MON_ANGAMAITE_OF_UMBAR.description: A Black Numenorean who hates the men of the west.

MON_FOREST_WIGHT.name: Forest wight
MON_FOREST_WIGHT.flavorText: It is a ghostly apparition with a humanoid form.
MON_FOREST_WIGHT.description: It is a ghostly apparition with a humanoid form.

MON_KHIM_SON_OF_MIM.name: Khim, Son of Mim
MON_KHIM_SON_OF_MIM.flavorText: One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves. Khim is a tricky sorcerous little being, full of mischief.
MON_KHIM_SON_OF_MIM.description: One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves. Khim is a tricky sorcerous little being, full of mischief.

MON_IBUN_SON_OF_MIM.name: Ibun, Son of Mim
MON_IBUN_SON_OF_MIM.flavorText: One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves. Ibun is a tricky sorcerous little being, full of mischief.
MON_IBUN_SON_OF_MIM.description: One of the last of the Petty-Dwarves. Ibun is a tricky sorcerous little being, full of mischief.

MON_MENELDOR_THE_SWIFT.name: Meneldor the Swift
MON_MENELDOR_THE_SWIFT.flavorText: Among all the eagles of Middle-earth he is the swiftest, and in his time has borne messages between all of the Wise.  It was Meneldor who bore the Ring-bearer away from the destruction of Mount Doom.
MON_MENELDOR_THE_SWIFT.description: Among all the eagles of Middle-earth he is the swiftest, and in his time has borne messages between all of the Wise.  It was Meneldor who bore the Ring-bearer away from the destruction of Mount Doom.

MON_PHANTOM_BEAST.name: Phantom beast
MON_PHANTOM_BEAST.flavorText: A creature that is half real, half illusion.
MON_PHANTOM_BEAST.description: A creature that is half real, half illusion.

MON_GIANT_SILVER_ANT.name: Giant silver ant
MON_GIANT_SILVER_ANT.flavorText: A giant silver ant with a caustic bite.
MON_GIANT_SILVER_ANT.description: A giant silver ant with a caustic bite.

MON_4_HEADED_HYDRA.name: 4-headed hydra
MON_4_HEADED_HYDRA.flavorText: A strange reptilian creature with four heads, guarding its hoard.
MON_4_HEADED_HYDRA.description: A strange reptilian creature with four heads, guarding its hoard.

MON_LESSER_HELL_BEAST.name: Lesser hell-beast
MON_LESSER_HELL_BEAST.flavorText: This creature just might crush you.
MON_LESSER_HELL_BEAST.description: This creature just might crush you.

MON_MUMMIFIED_HUMAN.name: Mummified human
MON_MUMMIFIED_HUMAN.flavorText: It is a human form encased in mouldy wrappings.
MON_MUMMIFIED_HUMAN.description: It is a human form encased in mouldy wrappings.

MON_VAMPIRE_BAT.name: Vampire bat
MON_VAMPIRE_BAT.flavorText: A blood-sucking bat that flies at your neck hungrily.
MON_VAMPIRE_BAT.description: A blood-sucking bat that flies at your neck hungrily.

MON_SANGAHYANDO_OF_UMBAR.name: Sangahyando of Umbar
MON_SANGAHYANDO_OF_UMBAR.flavorText: A Black Numenorean with a blacker heart.
MON_SANGAHYANDO_OF_UMBAR.description: A Black Numenorean with a blacker heart.

MON_BANSHEE.name: Banshee
MON_BANSHEE.flavorText: It is a ghostly woman's form that wails mournfully.
MON_BANSHEE.description: It is a ghostly woman's form that wails mournfully.

MON_CARRION_CRAWLER.name: Carrion crawler
MON_CARRION_CRAWLER.flavorText: A hideous centipede covered in slime and with glowing tentacles around its head.
MON_CARRION_CRAWLER.description: A hideous centipede covered in slime and with glowing tentacles around its head.

MON_SILENT_WATCHER.name: Silent watcher
MON_SILENT_WATCHER.flavorText: A figure carved from stone, with three vulture faces whose eyes glow with a malevolent light.  None escape its vigilance.
MON_SILENT_WATCHER.description: A figure carved from stone, with three vulture faces whose eyes glow with a malevolent light.  None escape its vigilance.

MON_PUKELMAN.name: Pukelman
MON_PUKELMAN.flavorText: A stumpy figure carved from stone, with glittering eyes.
MON_PUKELMAN.description: A stumpy figure carved from stone, with glittering eyes.

MON_DARK_ELVEN_DRUID.name: Dark elven druid
MON_DARK_ELVEN_DRUID.flavorText: A powerful dark elf, with mighty nature-controlling enchantments.
MON_DARK_ELVEN_DRUID.description: A powerful dark elf, with mighty nature-controlling enchantments.

MON_STONE_TROLL.name: Stone troll
MON_STONE_TROLL.flavorText: He is a giant troll with scabrous black skin.
MON_STONE_TROLL.description: He is a giant troll with scabrous black skin.

MON_HILL_TROLL.name: Hill troll
MON_HILL_TROLL.flavorText: A large troll with an extremely tough and warty hide.
MON_HILL_TROLL.description: A large troll with an extremely tough and warty hide.

MON_WEREWORM.name: Wereworm
MON_WEREWORM.flavorText: A huge wormlike shape dripping acid, twisted by evil sorcery into a foul monster that breeds on death.
MON_WEREWORM.description: A huge wormlike shape dripping acid, twisted by evil sorcery into a foul monster that breeds on death.

MON_KILLER_RED_BEETLE.name: Killer red beetle
MON_KILLER_RED_BEETLE.flavorText: A giant beetle with poisonous mandibles.
MON_KILLER_RED_BEETLE.description: A giant beetle with poisonous mandibles.

MON_DISENCHANTER_BAT.name: Disenchanter bat
MON_DISENCHANTER_BAT.flavorText: A giant bat which feeds on raw magical energy.
MON_DISENCHANTER_BAT.description: A giant bat which feeds on raw magical energy.

MON_GIANT_GREY_ANT.name: Giant grey ant
MON_GIANT_GREY_ANT.flavorText: It is an ant encased in shaggy grey fur.
MON_GIANT_GREY_ANT.description: It is an ant encased in shaggy grey fur.

MON_KHUFU_THE_MUMMIFIED_KING.name: Khufu, the Mummified King
MON_KHUFU_THE_MUMMIFIED_KING.flavorText: He is out to have revenge on those who have desecrated his tomb.
MON_KHUFU_THE_MUMMIFIED_KING.description: He is out to have revenge on those who have desecrated his tomb.

MON_GWAIHIR_THE_WINDLORD.name: Gwaihir the Windlord
MON_GWAIHIR_THE_WINDLORD.flavorText: The greatest of eagles in the Third Age of Middle-earth, Gwaihir rescued Gandalf the Wizard from Orthanc, and has twice brought his flock to the aid of Sauron's enemies in battle - first outside the gates of Erebor in the Battle of Five Armies, and then before the Black Gate of Mordor itself.
MON_GWAIHIR_THE_WINDLORD.description: The greatest of eagles in the Third Age of Middle-earth, Gwaihir rescued Gandalf the Wizard from Orthanc, and has twice brought his flock to the aid of Sauron's enemies in battle - first outside the gates of Erebor in the Battle of Five Armies, and then before the Black Gate of Mordor itself.

MON_GIANT_FIRE_TICK.name: Giant fire tick
MON_GIANT_FIRE_TICK.flavorText: It is smoking and burning with great heat.
MON_GIANT_FIRE_TICK.description: It is smoking and burning with great heat.

MON_DISPLACER_BEAST.name: Displacer beast
MON_DISPLACER_BEAST.flavorText: It is a huge black panther, clubbed tentacles sprouting from its shoulders.
MON_DISPLACER_BEAST.description: It is a huge black panther, clubbed tentacles sprouting from its shoulders.

MON_WEREBEAR.name: Werebear
MON_WEREBEAR.flavorText: In the eyes of this bear, there glimmers the faintest light of intelligence. And then its form begins to change... The combination of animal cunning, human intelligence and the great physical strength of the bear makes for a dangerous enemy.
MON_WEREBEAR.description: In the eyes of this bear, there glimmers the faintest light of intelligence. And then its form begins to change... The combination of animal cunning, human intelligence and the great physical strength of the bear makes for a dangerous enemy.

MON_CAVE_OGRE.name: Cave ogre
MON_CAVE_OGRE.flavorText: A giant orc-like figure with an awesomely muscled frame.
MON_CAVE_OGRE.description: A giant orc-like figure with an awesomely muscled frame.

MON_WHITE_WRAITH.name: White wraith
MON_WHITE_WRAITH.flavorText: It is a tangible but ghostly form made of white fog.
MON_WHITE_WRAITH.description: It is a tangible but ghostly form made of white fog.

MON_ANGEL.name: Angel
MON_ANGEL.flavorText: Who knows why you are now facing an angel as an enemy? Is it a punishment from your own god for your sins, or a test of your mettle, or has this angel been sent by another god on behalf of someone who wishes to claim the glory for his own god? Perhaps you will never know: but it is here, and you must fight it.
MON_ANGEL.description: Who knows why you are now facing an angel as an enemy? Is it a punishment from your own god for your sins, or a test of your mettle, or has this angel been sent by another god on behalf of someone who wishes to claim the glory for his own god? Perhaps you will never know: but it is here, and you must fight it.

MON_GHOUL.name: Ghoul
MON_GHOUL.flavorText: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.
MON_GHOUL.description: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.

MON_MIM_BETRAYER_OF_TURIN.name: Mim, Betrayer of Turin
MON_MIM_BETRAYER_OF_TURIN.flavorText: The last of his race, Mim is a Petty-Dwarf.  Petty-Dwarves are strange creatures, powerful in sorcery and originating in the East.  They have been hunted nearly to extinction by the High Elves.
MON_MIM_BETRAYER_OF_TURIN.description: The last of his race, Mim is a Petty-Dwarf.  Petty-Dwarves are strange creatures, powerful in sorcery and originating in the East.  They have been hunted nearly to extinction by the High Elves.

MON_HELLBLADE.name: Hellblade
MON_HELLBLADE.flavorText: A deadly blade of chaos, moving of its own volition.
MON_HELLBLADE.description: A deadly blade of chaos, moving of its own volition.

MON_KILLER_FIRE_BEETLE.name: Killer fire beetle
MON_KILLER_FIRE_BEETLE.flavorText: It is a giant beetle wreathed in flames.
MON_KILLER_FIRE_BEETLE.description: It is a giant beetle wreathed in flames.

MON_CREEPING_ADAMANTITE_COINS.name: Creeping adamantite coins
MON_CREEPING_ADAMANTITE_COINS.flavorText: It appears to be a pile of coins made of precious adamant, slithering toward you on lots of tiny legs.
MON_CREEPING_ADAMANTITE_COINS.description: It appears to be a pile of coins made of precious adamant, slithering toward you on lots of tiny legs.

MON_ALGROTH.name: Algroth
MON_ALGROTH.flavorText: A powerful troll form. Venom drips from its needlelike claws.
MON_ALGROTH.description: A powerful troll form. Venom drips from its needlelike claws.

MON_ROPER.name: Roper
MON_ROPER.flavorText: This creature look like a pillar of rock. However, a closer inspection reveals a glaring eye and powerful tentacles, which crush its prey and feed it to the creature's hungry mouth.
MON_ROPER.description: This creature look like a pillar of rock. However, a closer inspection reveals a glaring eye and powerful tentacles, which crush its prey and feed it to the creature's hungry mouth.

MON_VIBRATION_HOUND.name: Vibration hound
MON_VIBRATION_HOUND.flavorText: A blurry canine form which seems to be moving as fast as the eye can follow. You can feel the earth resonating beneath your feet.
MON_VIBRATION_HOUND.description: A blurry canine form which seems to be moving as fast as the eye can follow. You can feel the earth resonating beneath your feet.

MON_NEXUS_HOUND.name: Nexus hound
MON_NEXUS_HOUND.flavorText: A locus of conflicting points coalesce to form the vague shape of a huge hound. Or is it just your imagination?
MON_NEXUS_HOUND.description: A locus of conflicting points coalesce to form the vague shape of a huge hound. Or is it just your imagination?

MON_HALF_OGRE.name: Half-ogre
MON_HALF_OGRE.flavorText: A giant, brutish figure, as ugly as an orc, but with some of the intelligence of his half-human ancestry.
MON_HALF_OGRE.description: A giant, brutish figure, as ugly as an orc, but with some of the intelligence of his half-human ancestry.

MON_LOKKAK_THE_OGRE_CHIEFTAIN.name: Lokkak, the Ogre Chieftain
MON_LOKKAK_THE_OGRE_CHIEFTAIN.flavorText: An ogre renowned for acts of surprising cruelty, Lokkak is the leader of a large band of violent ogres.
MON_LOKKAK_THE_OGRE_CHIEFTAIN.description: An ogre renowned for acts of surprising cruelty, Lokkak is the leader of a large band of violent ogres.

MON_VAMPIRE.name: Vampire
MON_VAMPIRE.flavorText: It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front teeth.
MON_VAMPIRE.description: It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front teeth.

MON_GORGIMAERA.name: Gorgimaera
MON_GORGIMAERA.flavorText: The result of evil experiments, this travesty of nature should never be alive.  It has three heads - goat, dragon and gorgon - all attached to a lion's body.
MON_GORGIMAERA.description: The result of evil experiments, this travesty of nature should never be alive.  It has three heads - goat, dragon and gorgon - all attached to a lion's body.

MON_COLBRAN.name: Colbran
MON_COLBRAN.flavorText: A man-shaped form of living lightning, sparks and shocks crackle all over this madly capering figure, as it leaps and whirls around and about you.
MON_COLBRAN.description: A man-shaped form of living lightning, sparks and shocks crackle all over this madly capering figure, as it leaps and whirls around and about you.

MON_SPIRIT_NAGA.name: Spirit naga
MON_SPIRIT_NAGA.flavorText: A wraithly snake-like form with the torso of a beautiful woman, it is the most powerful of its kind.
MON_SPIRIT_NAGA.description: A wraithly snake-like form with the torso of a beautiful woman, it is the most powerful of its kind.

MON_5_HEADED_HYDRA.name: 5-headed hydra
MON_5_HEADED_HYDRA.flavorText: A strange reptilian creature with five heads dripping venom.
MON_5_HEADED_HYDRA.description: A strange reptilian creature with five heads dripping venom.

MON_BARNEY_THE_DINOSAUR.name: Barney the Dinosaur
MON_BARNEY_THE_DINOSAUR.flavorText: The lovable purple reptile is making a guest appearance here.
MON_BARNEY_THE_DINOSAUR.description: The lovable purple reptile is making a guest appearance here.

MON_BLACK_KNIGHT.name: Black knight
MON_BLACK_KNIGHT.flavorText: He is a figure encased in deep black plate armour; he looks at you menacingly.
MON_BLACK_KNIGHT.description: He is a figure encased in deep black plate armour; he looks at you menacingly.

MON_SEAHORSE.name: Seahorse
MON_SEAHORSE.flavorText: Your mind is filled with admiration as you view this wondrous, magical seahorse.
MON_SEAHORSE.description: Your mind is filled with admiration as you view this wondrous, magical seahorse.

MON_CYCLOPS.name: Cyclops
MON_CYCLOPS.flavorText: A gigantic humanoid with but one eye.
MON_CYCLOPS.description: A gigantic humanoid with but one eye.

MON_CLAIRVOYANT.name: Clairvoyant
MON_CLAIRVOYANT.flavorText: He is using his supernatural talents to bring about your destruction.
MON_CLAIRVOYANT.description: He is using his supernatural talents to bring about your destruction.

MON_PURPLE_WORM.name: Purple worm
MON_PURPLE_WORM.flavorText: It is a massive worm form, many feet in length. Its vast maw drips acid and poison.
MON_PURPLE_WORM.description: It is a massive worm form, many feet in length. Its vast maw drips acid and poison.

MON_CATOBLEPAS.name: Catoblepas
MON_CATOBLEPAS.flavorText: A strange ox-like form with a huge head but a thin, weak neck, it looks like the creation of some deranged alchemist.
MON_CATOBLEPAS.description: A strange ox-like form with a huge head but a thin, weak neck, it looks like the creation of some deranged alchemist.

MON_LESSER_WALL_MONSTER.name: Lesser wall monster
MON_LESSER_WALL_MONSTER.flavorText: A sentient, moving section of wall.
MON_LESSER_WALL_MONSTER.description: A sentient, moving section of wall.

MON_MAGE.name: Mage
MON_MAGE.flavorText: A fat mage with glasses.  And considerable power, too - as you can tell from the size of his hat.
MON_MAGE.description: A fat mage with glasses.  And considerable power, too - as you can tell from the size of his hat.

MON_MIND_FLAYER.name: Mind flayer
MON_MIND_FLAYER.flavorText: A humanoid form with a gruesome head, tentacular mouth, and piercing eyes. Claws reach out for you and you feel a presence invade your mind.
MON_MIND_FLAYER.description: A humanoid form with a gruesome head, tentacular mouth, and piercing eyes. Claws reach out for you and you feel a presence invade your mind.

MON_THE_ULTIMATE_DUNGEON_CLEANER.name: The Ultimate Dungeon Cleaner
MON_THE_ULTIMATE_DUNGEON_CLEANER.flavorText: It looks like a huge spiked roller. It was designed to keep this dungeon clean, and you are the biggest spot of dirt in sight.
MON_THE_ULTIMATE_DUNGEON_CLEANER.description: It looks like a huge spiked roller. It was designed to keep this dungeon clean, and you are the biggest spot of dirt in sight.

MON_BASILISK.name: Basilisk
MON_BASILISK.flavorText: An evil reptile that preys on unsuspecting travellers.  Its eyes stare deeply at you and your soul starts to wilt!
MON_BASILISK.description: An evil reptile that preys on unsuspecting travellers.  Its eyes stare deeply at you and your soul starts to wilt!

MON_ICE_TROLL.name: Ice troll
MON_ICE_TROLL.flavorText: He is a white troll with powerful clawed hands.
MON_ICE_TROLL.description: He is a white troll with powerful clawed hands.

MON_ARCHANGEL.name: Archangel
MON_ARCHANGEL.flavorText: A lesser angel protected by an aura of holiness. Its muscular form looks extremely powerful next to your own frail body.
MON_ARCHANGEL.description: A lesser angel protected by an aura of holiness. Its muscular form looks extremely powerful next to your own frail body.

MON_GREATER_MIMIC.name: Greater Mimic
MON_GREATER_MIMIC.flavorText: A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.
MON_GREATER_MIMIC.description: A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

MON_YOUNG_BLUE_DRAGON.name: Young blue dragon
MON_YOUNG_BLUE_DRAGON.flavorText: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a deep blue in hue. Sparks crackle along its length.
MON_YOUNG_BLUE_DRAGON.description: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a deep blue in hue. Sparks crackle along its length.

MON_YOUNG_WHITE_DRAGON.name: Young white dragon
MON_YOUNG_WHITE_DRAGON.flavorText: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a frosty white in hue. Icy blasts of cold air come from it as it breathes.
MON_YOUNG_WHITE_DRAGON.description: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a frosty white in hue. Icy blasts of cold air come from it as it breathes.

MON_YOUNG_GREEN_DRAGON.name: Young green dragon
MON_YOUNG_GREEN_DRAGON.flavorText: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a deep green in hue. Foul gas seeps through its scales.
MON_YOUNG_GREEN_DRAGON.description: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a deep green in hue. Foul gas seeps through its scales.

MON_YOUNG_BRONZE_DRAGON.name: Young bronze dragon
MON_YOUNG_BRONZE_DRAGON.flavorText: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a rich bronze hue, and its shape masks its true form.
MON_YOUNG_BRONZE_DRAGON.description: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a rich bronze hue, and its shape masks its true form.

MON_MITHRIL_GOLEM.name: Mithril golem
MON_MITHRIL_GOLEM.flavorText: It is a massive statue of purest mithril. It looks expensive!
MON_MITHRIL_GOLEM.description: It is a massive statue of purest mithril. It looks expensive!

MON_SKELETON_TROLL.name: Skeleton troll
MON_SKELETON_TROLL.flavorText: It is a troll skeleton animated by dark dweomers.
MON_SKELETON_TROLL.description: It is a troll skeleton animated by dark dweomers.

MON_BEORN_THE_SHAPE_CHANGER.name: Beorn, the Shape-Changer
MON_BEORN_THE_SHAPE_CHANGER.flavorText: Beorn is only occasionally seen in human form these days, preferring to appear in the shape of a giant black bear:  he also prefers the company of beasts to that of humans.  He has never taken kindly to strangers, even in human form - and still less when in bear's shape, as he is now.
MON_BEORN_THE_SHAPE_CHANGER.description: Beorn is only occasionally seen in human form these days, preferring to appear in the shape of a giant black bear:  he also prefers the company of beasts to that of humans.  He has never taken kindly to strangers, even in human form - and still less when in bear's shape, as he is now.

MON_THORONDOR_LORD_OF_EAGLES.name: Thorondor, Lord of Eagles
MON_THORONDOR_LORD_OF_EAGLES.flavorText: Among the mightiest of birds, Thorondor is the messenger of the Valar, and brings news of Middle-earth to Valinor itself.  Nothing that can be seen from the airs of the world is hidden from him.
MON_THORONDOR_LORD_OF_EAGLES.description: Among the mightiest of birds, Thorondor is the messenger of the Valar, and brings news of Middle-earth to Valinor itself.  Nothing that can be seen from the airs of the world is hidden from him.

MON_GIANT_BLUE_ANT.name: Giant blue ant
MON_GIANT_BLUE_ANT.flavorText: It is a giant ant that crackles with energy.
MON_GIANT_BLUE_ANT.description: It is a giant ant that crackles with energy.

MON_GRAVE_WIGHT.name: Grave wight
MON_GRAVE_WIGHT.flavorText: It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.
MON_GRAVE_WIGHT.description: It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.

MON_SHADOW_DRAKE.name: Shadow drake
MON_SHADOW_DRAKE.flavorText: It is a dragon-like form wrapped in shadow.  Glowing red eyes shine in the dark, and it is surrounded by an aura of unearthly cold that chills the soul rather than the body.
MON_SHADOW_DRAKE.description: It is a dragon-like form wrapped in shadow.  Glowing red eyes shine in the dark, and it is surrounded by an aura of unearthly cold that chills the soul rather than the body.

MON_MANTICORE.name: Manticore
MON_MANTICORE.flavorText: It is a winged lion's body with a human torso and a tail covered in vicious spikes.
MON_MANTICORE.description: It is a winged lion's body with a human torso and a tail covered in vicious spikes.

MON_GIANT_ARMY_ANT.name: Giant army ant
MON_GIANT_ARMY_ANT.flavorText: An armoured form moving with purpose. Powerful on its own, flee when hordes of them march.
MON_GIANT_ARMY_ANT.description: An armoured form moving with purpose. Powerful on its own, flee when hordes of them march.

MON_KILLER_SLICER_BEETLE.name: Killer slicer beetle
MON_KILLER_SLICER_BEETLE.flavorText: It is a beetle with deadly sharp cutting mandibles and a rock-hard carapace.
MON_KILLER_SLICER_BEETLE.description: It is a beetle with deadly sharp cutting mandibles and a rock-hard carapace.

MON_GORGON.name: Gorgon
MON_GORGON.flavorText: A bull-like creature whose skin is made of steel plates. Watch out for its deadly breath!
MON_GORGON.description: A bull-like creature whose skin is made of steel plates. Watch out for its deadly breath!

MON_DEATH_WATCH_BEETLE.name: Death watch beetle
MON_DEATH_WATCH_BEETLE.flavorText: It is a giant beetle that produces a chilling sound.
MON_DEATH_WATCH_BEETLE.description: It is a giant beetle that produces a chilling sound.

MON_MOUNTAIN_OGRE.name: Mountain ogre
MON_MOUNTAIN_OGRE.flavorText: The largest breed of ogre, he is awesomely strong and awesomely ugly.
MON_MOUNTAIN_OGRE.description: The largest breed of ogre, he is awesomely strong and awesomely ugly.

MON_NEXUS_QUYLTHULG.name: Nexus quylthulg
MON_NEXUS_QUYLTHULG.flavorText: It is a very unstable, strange pulsing mound of flesh.
MON_NEXUS_QUYLTHULG.description: It is a very unstable, strange pulsing mound of flesh.

MON_SHELOB_SPIDER_OF_DARKNESS.name: Shelob, Spider of Darkness
MON_SHELOB_SPIDER_OF_DARKNESS.flavorText: Shelob is an enormous bloated spider, the last daughter of Ungoliant the Unlight.  Her poison is legendary, as is her ego.  She normally guards the pass through Cirith Ungol, but occasionally goes out foraging for food to feed her voracious appetite.
MON_SHELOB_SPIDER_OF_DARKNESS.description: Shelob is an enormous bloated spider, the last daughter of Ungoliant the Unlight.  Her poison is legendary, as is her ego.  She normally guards the pass through Cirith Ungol, but occasionally goes out foraging for food to feed her voracious appetite.

MON_GIANT_SQUID.name: Giant squid
MON_GIANT_SQUID.flavorText: Besides being capable of dragging whole ships underwater, this creature can also harm you with ranged attacks.
MON_GIANT_SQUID.description: Besides being capable of dragging whole ships underwater, this creature can also harm you with ranged attacks.

MON_GHOULKING.name: Ghoulking
MON_GHOULKING.flavorText: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.
MON_GHOULKING.description: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.

MON_DOOMBAT.name: Doombat
MON_DOOMBAT.flavorText: It is a fast moving creature of chaos, a gigantic black bat surrounded by flickering bright red flames.
MON_DOOMBAT.description: It is a fast moving creature of chaos, a gigantic black bat surrounded by flickering bright red flames.

MON_NINJA.name: Ninja
MON_NINJA.flavorText: A humanoid clothed in black who moves with blinding speed.
MON_NINJA.description: A humanoid clothed in black who moves with blinding speed.

MON_MEMORY_MOSS.name: Memory moss
MON_MEMORY_MOSS.flavorText: A mass of vegetation. You don't remember seeing anything like it before.
MON_MEMORY_MOSS.description: A mass of vegetation. You don't remember seeing anything like it before.

MON_STORM_GIANT.name: Storm giant
MON_STORM_GIANT.flavorText: It is a twenty-five foot tall giant wreathed in lightning.
MON_STORM_GIANT.description: It is a twenty-five foot tall giant wreathed in lightning.

MON_SPECTATOR.name: Spectator
MON_SPECTATOR.flavorText: A lesser relative of the beholder: a globular body with a large toothy mouth, a large central eye, and four smaller eyes on stalks protruding from the top of its body.
MON_SPECTATOR.description: A lesser relative of the beholder: a globular body with a large toothy mouth, a large central eye, and four smaller eyes on stalks protruding from the top of its body.

MON_HALF_TROLL.name: Half-troll
MON_HALF_TROLL.flavorText: A huge, ugly, half-human in search of plunder.
MON_HALF_TROLL.description: A huge, ugly, half-human in search of plunder.

MON_BERT_THE_STONE_TROLL.name: Bert the Stone Troll
MON_BERT_THE_STONE_TROLL.flavorText: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bill and Tom.
MON_BERT_THE_STONE_TROLL.description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bill and Tom.

MON_BILL_THE_STONE_TROLL.name: Bill the Stone Troll
MON_BILL_THE_STONE_TROLL.flavorText: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bert and Tom.
MON_BILL_THE_STONE_TROLL.description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bert and Tom.

MON_TOM_THE_STONE_TROLL.name: Tom the Stone Troll
MON_TOM_THE_STONE_TROLL.flavorText: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bert and Bill.
MON_TOM_THE_STONE_TROLL.description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a taste for hobbit. He has friends called Bert and Bill.

MON_CAVE_TROLL.name: Cave troll
MON_CAVE_TROLL.flavorText: He is a vicious monster, feared for his ferocity.
MON_CAVE_TROLL.description: He is a vicious monster, feared for his ferocity.

MON_BARROW_WIGHT.name: Barrow wight
MON_BARROW_WIGHT.flavorText: It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.
MON_BARROW_WIGHT.description: It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.

MON_SKELETON_ETTIN.name: Skeleton ettin
MON_SKELETON_ETTIN.flavorText: It is the animated skeleton of a massive two-headed troll.
MON_SKELETON_ETTIN.description: It is the animated skeleton of a massive two-headed troll.

MON_CHAOS_DRAKE.name: Chaos drake
MON_CHAOS_DRAKE.flavorText: A dragon twisted by the forces of chaos. It seems first ugly, then fair, as its form shimmers and changes in front of your eyes.
MON_CHAOS_DRAKE.description: A dragon twisted by the forces of chaos. It seems first ugly, then fair, as its form shimmers and changes in front of your eyes.

MON_LAW_DRAKE.name: Law drake
MON_LAW_DRAKE.flavorText: This dragon is clever and cunning. It laughs at your puny efforts to disturb it.
MON_LAW_DRAKE.description: This dragon is clever and cunning. It laughs at your puny efforts to disturb it.

MON_BALANCE_DRAKE.name: Balance drake
MON_BALANCE_DRAKE.flavorText: A mighty dragon, the balance drake seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance, and despises your feeble efforts to destroy evil.
MON_BALANCE_DRAKE.description: A mighty dragon, the balance drake seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance, and despises your feeble efforts to destroy evil.

MON_ETHEREAL_DRAKE.name: Ethereal drake
MON_ETHEREAL_DRAKE.flavorText: A dragon of great power with control over light and dark, the ethereal drake's eyes glare with white hatred from the shadows.
MON_ETHEREAL_DRAKE.description: A dragon of great power with control over light and dark, the ethereal drake's eyes glare with white hatred from the shadows.

MON_FASOLT_THE_GIANT.name: Fasolt the Giant
MON_FASOLT_THE_GIANT.flavorText: Big, brawny, powerful and with a greed for gold.
MON_FASOLT_THE_GIANT.description: Big, brawny, powerful and with a greed for gold.

MON_SHADE.name: Shade
MON_SHADE.flavorText: A shadowy form clutches at you from the darkness. A powerful undead with a deadly touch.
MON_SHADE.description: A shadowy form clutches at you from the darkness. A powerful undead with a deadly touch.

MON_SPECTRE.name: Spectre
MON_SPECTRE.flavorText: A phantasmal shrieking spirit. Its wail drives the intense cold of pure evil deep within your body.
MON_SPECTRE.description: A phantasmal shrieking spirit. Its wail drives the intense cold of pure evil deep within your body.

MON_WATER_TROLL.name: Water troll
MON_WATER_TROLL.flavorText: He is a troll that reeks of brackish water and mud.
MON_WATER_TROLL.description: He is a troll that reeks of brackish water and mud.

MON_FIRE_ELEMENTAL.name: Fire elemental
MON_FIRE_ELEMENTAL.flavorText: It is a towering inferno of flames.
MON_FIRE_ELEMENTAL.description: It is a towering inferno of flames.

MON_CHERUB.name: Cherub
MON_CHERUB.flavorText: It is an angel moving very quickly, wielding a holy war hammer and casting a volley of powerful spells in your direction.
MON_CHERUB.description: It is an angel moving very quickly, wielding a holy war hammer and casting a volley of powerful spells in your direction.

MON_WATER_ELEMENTAL.name: Water elemental
MON_WATER_ELEMENTAL.flavorText: It is a towering tempest of water.
MON_WATER_ELEMENTAL.description: It is a towering tempest of water.

MON_MULTI_HUED_HOUND.name: Multi-hued hound
MON_MULTI_HUED_HOUND.flavorText: Shimmering in rainbow hues, this hound is beautiful and deadly.
MON_MULTI_HUED_HOUND.description: Shimmering in rainbow hues, this hound is beautiful and deadly.

MON_INVISIBLE_STALKER.name: Invisible stalker
MON_INVISIBLE_STALKER.flavorText: It is impossible to define its form but its violence is legendary.
MON_INVISIBLE_STALKER.description: It is impossible to define its form but its violence is legendary.

MON_MASTER_THIEF.name: Master thief
MON_MASTER_THIEF.flavorText: Cool and confident, fast and lithe; protect your possessions quickly!
MON_MASTER_THIEF.description: Cool and confident, fast and lithe; protect your possessions quickly!

MON_THE_WATCHER_IN_THE_WATER.name: The Watcher in the Water
MON_THE_WATCHER_IN_THE_WATER.flavorText: A vile creature which seems to consist mostly of tentacles, it seeks to drag people to their doom in the water.  Few have ever escaped its grasp.
MON_THE_WATCHER_IN_THE_WATER.description: A vile creature which seems to consist mostly of tentacles, it seeks to drag people to their doom in the water.  Few have ever escaped its grasp.

MON_LICH.name: Lich
MON_LICH.flavorText: It is a skeletal form dressed in robes. It radiates vastly evil power.
MON_LICH.description: It is a skeletal form dressed in robes. It radiates vastly evil power.

MON_GAS_SPORE.name: Gas spore
MON_GAS_SPORE.flavorText: From a distance, this creature is often mistaken for the much more dangerous beholder.
MON_GAS_SPORE.description: From a distance, this creature is often mistaken for the much more dangerous beholder.

MON_MASTER_VAMPIRE.name: Master vampire
MON_MASTER_VAMPIRE.flavorText: It is a humanoid form dressed in robes. Power emanates from its chilling frame.
MON_MASTER_VAMPIRE.description: It is a humanoid form dressed in robes. Power emanates from its chilling frame.

MON_ORIENTAL_VAMPIRE.name: Oriental vampire
MON_ORIENTAL_VAMPIRE.flavorText: The oriental vampire can transform into a mist at will.
MON_ORIENTAL_VAMPIRE.description: The oriental vampire can transform into a mist at will.

MON_GREATER_MUMMY.name: Greater mummy
MON_GREATER_MUMMY.flavorText: Once a powerful ruler, now an even more powerful undead menace.
MON_GREATER_MUMMY.description: Once a powerful ruler, now an even more powerful undead menace.

MON_GIANT_GREY_SCORPION.name: Giant grey scorpion
MON_GIANT_GREY_SCORPION.flavorText: It is a giant grey scorpion. It looks poisonous.
MON_GIANT_GREY_SCORPION.description: It is a giant grey scorpion. It looks poisonous.

MON_EARTH_ELEMENTAL.name: Earth elemental
MON_EARTH_ELEMENTAL.flavorText: It is a towering form composed of rock with fists of awesome power.
MON_EARTH_ELEMENTAL.description: It is a towering form composed of rock with fists of awesome power.

MON_AIR_ELEMENTAL.name: Air elemental
MON_AIR_ELEMENTAL.flavorText: It is a towering tornado of winds.
MON_AIR_ELEMENTAL.description: It is a towering tornado of winds.

MON_SHIMMERING_MOLD.name: Shimmering mold
MON_SHIMMERING_MOLD.flavorText: It is a strange growth on the dungeon floor, glowing and crackling with sparks.
MON_SHIMMERING_MOLD.description: It is a strange growth on the dungeon floor, glowing and crackling with sparks.

MON_GARGOYLE.name: Gargoyle
MON_GARGOYLE.flavorText: A weird demon creature with a stone-like skin.
MON_GARGOYLE.description: A weird demon creature with a stone-like skin.

MON_MALICIOUS_LEPRECHAUN.name: Malicious leprechaun
MON_MALICIOUS_LEPRECHAUN.flavorText: This little creature has a fiendish gleam in its eyes.
MON_MALICIOUS_LEPRECHAUN.description: This little creature has a fiendish gleam in its eyes.

MON_EOG_GOLEM.name: Eog golem
MON_EOG_GOLEM.flavorText: It is a massive deep brown statue, striding towards you with an all-too-familiar purpose. Your magic surprisingly feels much less powerful now.
MON_EOG_GOLEM.description: It is a massive deep brown statue, striding towards you with an all-too-familiar purpose. Your magic surprisingly feels much less powerful now.

MON_LITTLE_BOY.name: Little Boy
MON_LITTLE_BOY.flavorText: A shining machine of death and destruction.
MON_LITTLE_BOY.description: A shining machine of death and destruction.

MON_DAGASHI.name: Dagashi
MON_DAGASHI.flavorText: A human warrior, moving with lightning speed.
MON_DAGASHI.description: A human warrior, moving with lightning speed.

MON_HEADLESS_GHOST.name: Headless ghost
MON_HEADLESS_GHOST.flavorText: A phantasmal apparition with no head.
MON_HEADLESS_GHOST.description: A phantasmal apparition with no head.

MON_DREAD.name: Dread
MON_DREAD.flavorText: It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate, its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe itself struggles to banish it.
MON_DREAD.description: It is a form that screams its presence against the eye. Death incarnate, its hideous black body seems to struggle against reality as the universe itself struggles to banish it.

MON_GAUTH.name: Gauth
MON_GAUTH.flavorText: Another lesser relative of the beholder, this six-eyed creature feeds on magic.
MON_GAUTH.description: Another lesser relative of the beholder, this six-eyed creature feeds on magic.

MON_SMOKE_ELEMENTAL.name: Smoke elemental
MON_SMOKE_ELEMENTAL.flavorText: It is a towering blackened form, crackling with heat.
MON_SMOKE_ELEMENTAL.description: It is a towering blackened form, crackling with heat.

MON_OLOG.name: Olog
MON_OLOG.flavorText: It is a massive troll, more intelligent than most of its kind, with needle- sharp fangs.
MON_OLOG.description: It is a massive troll, more intelligent than most of its kind, with needle- sharp fangs.

MON_HALFLING_SLINGER.name: Halfling slinger
MON_HALFLING_SLINGER.flavorText: A rebel halfling who has rejected the halfling tradition of archery.
MON_HALFLING_SLINGER.description: A rebel halfling who has rejected the halfling tradition of archery.

MON_GRAVITY_HOUND.name: Gravity hound
MON_GRAVITY_HOUND.flavorText: Unfettered by the usual constraints of gravity, these unnatural creatures are walking on the walls and even the ceiling!  The earth suddenly feels rather less solid as you see gravity warp all around these monsters.
MON_GRAVITY_HOUND.description: Unfettered by the usual constraints of gravity, these unnatural creatures are walking on the walls and even the ceiling!  The earth suddenly feels rather less solid as you see gravity warp all around these monsters.

MON_ACIDIC_CYTOPLASM.name: Acidic cytoplasm
MON_ACIDIC_CYTOPLASM.flavorText: A disgusting animated blob of destruction. Flee its gruesome hunger!
MON_ACIDIC_CYTOPLASM.description: A disgusting animated blob of destruction. Flee its gruesome hunger!

MON_INERTIA_HOUND.name: Inertia hound
MON_INERTIA_HOUND.flavorText: Bizarrely, this hound seems to be hardly moving at all, yet it approaches you with deadly menace. It makes you tired just to look at it.
MON_INERTIA_HOUND.description: Bizarrely, this hound seems to be hardly moving at all, yet it approaches you with deadly menace. It makes you tired just to look at it.

MON_IMPACT_HOUND.name: Impact hound
MON_IMPACT_HOUND.flavorText: A deep brown shape is visible before you, its canine form striking you with an almost physical force. The dungeon floor buckles as if struck by a powerful blow as it stalks towards you.
MON_IMPACT_HOUND.description: A deep brown shape is visible before you, its canine form striking you with an almost physical force. The dungeon floor buckles as if struck by a powerful blow as it stalks towards you.

MON_SHARDSTORM.name: Shardstorm
MON_SHARDSTORM.flavorText: A howling blast of razor-sharp mountain fragments, kept intact by perilous magics.
MON_SHARDSTORM.description: A howling blast of razor-sharp mountain fragments, kept intact by perilous magics.

MON_OOZE_ELEMENTAL.name: Ooze elemental
MON_OOZE_ELEMENTAL.flavorText: It is a towering mass of filth, an eyesore of ooze.
MON_OOZE_ELEMENTAL.description: It is a towering mass of filth, an eyesore of ooze.

MON_YOUNG_BLACK_DRAGON.name: Young black dragon
MON_YOUNG_BLACK_DRAGON.flavorText: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a darkest black hue. Acid drips from its body.
MON_YOUNG_BLACK_DRAGON.description: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a darkest black hue. Acid drips from its body.

MON_MUMAK.name: Mumak
MON_MUMAK.flavorText: A massive elephantine form with eyes twisted by madness.
MON_MUMAK.description: A massive elephantine form with eyes twisted by madness.

MON_GIANT_FIRE_ANT.name: Giant fire ant
MON_GIANT_FIRE_ANT.flavorText: A giant ant covered in shaggy fur. Its powerful jaws glow with heat.
MON_GIANT_FIRE_ANT.description: A giant ant covered in shaggy fur. Its powerful jaws glow with heat.

MON_MATURE_WHITE_DRAGON.name: Mature white dragon
MON_MATURE_WHITE_DRAGON.flavorText: A large dragon, scales gleaming bright white.
MON_MATURE_WHITE_DRAGON.description: A large dragon, scales gleaming bright white.

MON_XORN.name: Xorn
MON_XORN.flavorText: A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.
MON_XORN.description: A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.

MON_ROGROG_THE_BLACK_TROLL.name: Rogrog the Black Troll
MON_ROGROG_THE_BLACK_TROLL.flavorText: A massive and cruel troll of great power, drool slides caustically down his muscular frame. Despite his bulk, he strikes with stunning speed.
MON_ROGROG_THE_BLACK_TROLL.description: A massive and cruel troll of great power, drool slides caustically down his muscular frame. Despite his bulk, he strikes with stunning speed.

MON_PHANTOM.name: Phantom
MON_PHANTOM.flavorText: An unholy creature of darkness, the aura emanating from this evil being saps your very soul.
MON_PHANTOM.description: An unholy creature of darkness, the aura emanating from this evil being saps your very soul.

MON_GREY_WRAITH.name: Grey wraith
MON_GREY_WRAITH.flavorText: A tangible but ghostly form, made of grey fog. The air around it feels deathly cold.
MON_GREY_WRAITH.description: A tangible but ghostly form, made of grey fog. The air around it feels deathly cold.

MON_REVENANT.name: Revenant
MON_REVENANT.flavorText: Back from the grave, to wreak vengeance upon the living. A skeletal figure wearing a black robe, with eyes that burn with undying hatred.
MON_REVENANT.description: Back from the grave, to wreak vengeance upon the living. A skeletal figure wearing a black robe, with eyes that burn with undying hatred.

MON_YOUNG_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON.name: Young multi-hued dragon
MON_YOUNG_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON.flavorText: It has a form out of legend. Beautiful scales of shimmering and magical colours cover it.
MON_YOUNG_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON.description: It has a form out of legend. Beautiful scales of shimmering and magical colours cover it.

MON_COLOSSUS.name: Colossus
MON_COLOSSUS.flavorText: An enormous construct resembling a titan made from stone. It strides purposefully towards you, swinging its slow fists with earth-shattering power.
MON_COLOSSUS.description: An enormous construct resembling a titan made from stone. It strides purposefully towards you, swinging its slow fists with earth-shattering power.

MON_YOUNG_GOLD_DRAGON.name: Young gold dragon
MON_YOUNG_GOLD_DRAGON.flavorText: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a tarnished gold hue, and light is reflected from its form.
MON_YOUNG_GOLD_DRAGON.description: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a tarnished gold hue, and light is reflected from its form.

MON_MATURE_BLUE_DRAGON.name: Mature blue dragon
MON_MATURE_BLUE_DRAGON.flavorText: A large dragon, scales tinted deep blue.
MON_MATURE_BLUE_DRAGON.description: A large dragon, scales tinted deep blue.

MON_MATURE_GREEN_DRAGON.name: Mature green dragon
MON_MATURE_GREEN_DRAGON.flavorText: A large dragon, scales tinted deep green.
MON_MATURE_GREEN_DRAGON.description: A large dragon, scales tinted deep green.

MON_MATURE_BRONZE_DRAGON.name: Mature bronze dragon
MON_MATURE_BRONZE_DRAGON.flavorText: A large dragon with scales of rich bronze.
MON_MATURE_BRONZE_DRAGON.description: A large dragon with scales of rich bronze.

MON_YOUNG_RED_DRAGON.name: Young red dragon
MON_YOUNG_RED_DRAGON.flavorText: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a deepest red hue. Heat radiates from its form.
MON_YOUNG_RED_DRAGON.description: It has a form out of legend. Its still-tender scales are a deepest red hue. Heat radiates from its form.

MON_TRAPPER.name: Trapper
MON_TRAPPER.flavorText: This creature traps unsuspecting victims and paralyzes them, to be slowly digested later.
MON_TRAPPER.description: This creature traps unsuspecting victims and paralyzes them, to be slowly digested later.

MON_BODAK.name: Bodak
MON_BODAK.flavorText: It is a humanoid form composed of flames and hatred.
MON_BODAK.description: It is a humanoid form composed of flames and hatred.

MON_TIME_BOMB.name: Time bomb
MON_TIME_BOMB.flavorText: It was left here to be used against intruders.
MON_TIME_BOMB.description: It was left here to be used against intruders.

MON_MEZZODAEMON.name: Mezzodaemon
MON_MEZZODAEMON.flavorText: An ugly demon with insect-like extremities and large bulbous eyes.
MON_MEZZODAEMON.description: An ugly demon with insect-like extremities and large bulbous eyes.

MON_ICE_ELEMENTAL.name: Ice elemental
MON_ICE_ELEMENTAL.flavorText: It is a towering glacier of ice.
MON_ICE_ELEMENTAL.description: It is a towering glacier of ice.

MON_NECROMANCER.name: Necromancer
MON_NECROMANCER.flavorText: A gaunt figure, clothed in black robes.
MON_NECROMANCER.description: A gaunt figure, clothed in black robes.

MON_THE_GREATER_HELL_MAGIC_MUSHROOM_WERE.name: The Greater hell magic mushroom were-quylthulg
MON_THE_GREATER_HELL_MAGIC_MUSHROOM_WERE.flavorText: This unholy abomination will crush you too. Flee while you can!
MON_THE_GREATER_HELL_MAGIC_MUSHROOM_WERE.description: This unholy abomination will crush you too. Flee while you can!

MON_LORGAN_CHIEF_OF_THE_EASTERLINGS.name: Lorgan, Chief of the Easterlings
MON_LORGAN_CHIEF_OF_THE_EASTERLINGS.flavorText: A mighty warrior from the east, Lorgan hates everything that he cannot control.
MON_LORGAN_CHIEF_OF_THE_EASTERLINGS.description: A mighty warrior from the east, Lorgan hates everything that he cannot control.

MON_MUMMIFIED_TROLL.name: Mummified troll
MON_MUMMIFIED_TROLL.flavorText: It is a massive figure clothed in wrappings. You are wary of its massive fists.
MON_MUMMIFIED_TROLL.description: It is a massive figure clothed in wrappings. You are wary of its massive fists.

MON_STORM_OF_UNMAGIC.name: Storm of Unmagic
MON_STORM_OF_UNMAGIC.flavorText: Howling through the disintegrating dungeon, this awesome whirlpool of Unmagic rips the enchantments from everything it touches.
MON_STORM_OF_UNMAGIC.description: Howling through the disintegrating dungeon, this awesome whirlpool of Unmagic rips the enchantments from everything it touches.

MON_CRYPT_THING.name: Crypt thing
MON_CRYPT_THING.flavorText: It is a skeletal form dressed in robes. It looks evil and devious...
MON_CRYPT_THING.description: It is a skeletal form dressed in robes. It looks evil and devious...

MON_THE_QUEEN_ANT.name: The Queen Ant
MON_THE_QUEEN_ANT.flavorText: She's upset because you hurt her children.
MON_THE_QUEEN_ANT.description: She's upset because you hurt her children.

MON_WILL_O_THE_WISP.name: Will o' the wisp
MON_WILL_O_THE_WISP.flavorText: A strange ball of glowing light. It disappears and reappears and seems to draw you to it. You seem somehow compelled to stand still and watch its strange dancing motion.
MON_WILL_O_THE_WISP.description: A strange ball of glowing light. It disappears and reappears and seems to draw you to it. You seem somehow compelled to stand still and watch its strange dancing motion.

MON_MAGMA_ELEMENTAL.name: Magma elemental
MON_MAGMA_ELEMENTAL.flavorText: It is a towering glowing form of molten rock.
MON_MAGMA_ELEMENTAL.description: It is a towering glowing form of molten rock.

MON_BLACK_PUDDING.name: Black pudding
MON_BLACK_PUDDING.flavorText: A lump of rotting black flesh that slurrrrrrrps across the dungeon floor.
MON_BLACK_PUDDING.description: A lump of rotting black flesh that slurrrrrrrps across the dungeon floor.

MON_KILLER_IRIDESCENT_BEETLE.name: Killer iridescent beetle
MON_KILLER_IRIDESCENT_BEETLE.flavorText: It is a giant beetle, whose carapace shimmers with vibrant energies.
MON_KILLER_IRIDESCENT_BEETLE.description: It is a giant beetle, whose carapace shimmers with vibrant energies.

MON_NEXUS_VORTEX.name: Nexus vortex
MON_NEXUS_VORTEX.flavorText: A maelstrom of potent magical energy.
MON_NEXUS_VORTEX.description: A maelstrom of potent magical energy.

MON_PLASMA_VORTEX.name: Plasma vortex
MON_PLASMA_VORTEX.flavorText: A whirlpool of intense flame, charring the stones at your feet.
MON_PLASMA_VORTEX.description: A whirlpool of intense flame, charring the stones at your feet.

MON_MATURE_RED_DRAGON.name: Mature red dragon
MON_MATURE_RED_DRAGON.flavorText: A large dragon, scales tinted deep red.
MON_MATURE_RED_DRAGON.description: A large dragon, scales tinted deep red.

MON_MATURE_GOLD_DRAGON.name: Mature gold dragon
MON_MATURE_GOLD_DRAGON.flavorText: A large dragon with scales of gleaming gold.
MON_MATURE_GOLD_DRAGON.description: A large dragon with scales of gleaming gold.

MON_CRYSTAL_DRAKE.name: Crystal drake
MON_CRYSTAL_DRAKE.flavorText: A dragon of strange crystalline form. Light shines through it, dazzling your eyes with spectrums of colour.
MON_CRYSTAL_DRAKE.description: A dragon of strange crystalline form. Light shines through it, dazzling your eyes with spectrums of colour.

MON_MATURE_BLACK_DRAGON.name: Mature black dragon
MON_MATURE_BLACK_DRAGON.flavorText: A large dragon, with scales of deepest black.
MON_MATURE_BLACK_DRAGON.description: A large dragon, with scales of deepest black.

MON_MATURE_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON.name: Mature multi-hued dragon
MON_MATURE_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON.flavorText: A large dragon, scales shimmering many colours.
MON_MATURE_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON.description: A large dragon, scales shimmering many colours.

MON_DRAEBOR_THE_IMP.name: Draebor, the Imp
MON_DRAEBOR_THE_IMP.flavorText: An intensely irritating git of a monster.
MON_DRAEBOR_THE_IMP.description: An intensely irritating git of a monster.

MON_DEATH_KNIGHT.name: Death knight
MON_DEATH_KNIGHT.flavorText: It is a humanoid figure dressed in armour of an ancient form. From beneath its helmet, eyes glow a baleful red and seem to pierce you like lances of fire.
MON_DEATH_KNIGHT.description: It is a humanoid figure dressed in armour of an ancient form. From beneath its helmet, eyes glow a baleful red and seem to pierce you like lances of fire.

MON_CASTAMIR_THE_USURPER.name: Castamir the Usurper
MON_CASTAMIR_THE_USURPER.flavorText: A Black Numenorean who usurped the throne of Gondor, he is treacherous and evil.
MON_CASTAMIR_THE_USURPER.description: A Black Numenorean who usurped the throne of Gondor, he is treacherous and evil.

MON_SHIMMERING_VORTEX.name: Shimmering vortex
MON_SHIMMERING_VORTEX.flavorText: A strange pillar of shining light that hurts your eyes. Its shape changes constantly as it cuts through the air towards you. It is like a beacon, waking monsters from their slumber.
MON_SHIMMERING_VORTEX.description: A strange pillar of shining light that hurts your eyes. Its shape changes constantly as it cuts through the air towards you. It is like a beacon, waking monsters from their slumber.

MON_ANCIENT_BLUE_DRAGON.name: Ancient blue dragon
MON_ANCIENT_BLUE_DRAGON.flavorText: A huge draconic form. Lightning crackles along its length.
MON_ANCIENT_BLUE_DRAGON.description: A huge draconic form. Lightning crackles along its length.

MON_ANCIENT_BRONZE_DRAGON.name: Ancient bronze dragon
MON_ANCIENT_BRONZE_DRAGON.flavorText: A huge draconic form enveloped in a cascade of colour.
MON_ANCIENT_BRONZE_DRAGON.description: A huge draconic form enveloped in a cascade of colour.

MON_BEHOLDER.name: Beholder
MON_BEHOLDER.flavorText: A vile creature with one huge central eye, twelve smaller eyes on stalks, and a huge mouth filled with sharp teeth.
MON_BEHOLDER.description: A vile creature with one huge central eye, twelve smaller eyes on stalks, and a huge mouth filled with sharp teeth.

MON_EMPEROR_WIGHT.name: Emperor wight
MON_EMPEROR_WIGHT.flavorText: Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being approaches.
MON_EMPEROR_WIGHT.description: Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being approaches.

MON_SERAPH.name: Seraph
MON_SERAPH.flavorText: It is an angel, fast and strong. You are stunned by its extreme holiness and try to resist all desires to obey it.
MON_SERAPH.description: It is an angel, fast and strong. You are stunned by its extreme holiness and try to resist all desires to obey it.

MON_VARGO_TYRANT_OF_FIRE.name: Vargo, Tyrant of Fire
MON_VARGO_TYRANT_OF_FIRE.flavorText: A towering fire elemental, Vargo burns everything beyond recognition.
MON_VARGO_TYRANT_OF_FIRE.description: A towering fire elemental, Vargo burns everything beyond recognition.

MON_BLACK_WRAITH.name: Black wraith
MON_BLACK_WRAITH.flavorText: A figure that seems made of void, its strangely human shape is cloaked in shadow. It reaches out at you.
MON_BLACK_WRAITH.description: A figure that seems made of void, its strangely human shape is cloaked in shadow. It reaches out at you.

MON_MONASTIC_LICH.name: Monastic lich
MON_MONASTIC_LICH.flavorText: A skeletal form wrapped in priestly robes. Before its un-death, it was a monk in an evil order.
MON_MONASTIC_LICH.description: A skeletal form wrapped in priestly robes. Before its un-death, it was a monk in an evil order.

MON_NETHER_WRAITH.name: Nether wraith
MON_NETHER_WRAITH.flavorText: A form that hurts the eye, death permeates the air around it. As it nears you, a coldness saps your soul.
MON_NETHER_WRAITH.description: A form that hurts the eye, death permeates the air around it. As it nears you, a coldness saps your soul.

MON_HELLHOUND.name: Hellhound
MON_HELLHOUND.flavorText: It is a giant dog that glows with heat. Flames pour from its nostrils.
MON_HELLHOUND.description: It is a giant dog that glows with heat. Flames pour from its nostrils.

MON_7_HEADED_HYDRA.name: 7-headed hydra
MON_7_HEADED_HYDRA.flavorText: A strange reptilian creature with seven heads dripping venom.
MON_7_HEADED_HYDRA.description: A strange reptilian creature with seven heads dripping venom.

MON_WALDERN_KING_OF_WATER.name: Waldern, King of Water
MON_WALDERN_KING_OF_WATER.flavorText: A towering water elemental, Waldern is master of all things liquid. Wave after wave drowns your frail body.
MON_WALDERN_KING_OF_WATER.description: A towering water elemental, Waldern is master of all things liquid. Wave after wave drowns your frail body.

MON_KAVLAX_THE_MANY_HEADED.name: Kavlax the Many-Headed
MON_KAVLAX_THE_MANY_HEADED.flavorText: A large dragon with a selection of heads, all shouting and arguing as they look for prey, but each with its own deadly breath weapon.
MON_KAVLAX_THE_MANY_HEADED.description: A large dragon with a selection of heads, all shouting and arguing as they look for prey, but each with its own deadly breath weapon.

MON_ANCIENT_WHITE_DRAGON.name: Ancient white dragon
MON_ANCIENT_WHITE_DRAGON.flavorText: A huge draconic form. Frost covers it from head to tail.
MON_ANCIENT_WHITE_DRAGON.description: A huge draconic form. Frost covers it from head to tail.

MON_ANCIENT_GREEN_DRAGON.name: Ancient green dragon
MON_ANCIENT_GREEN_DRAGON.flavorText: A huge draconic form enveloped in clouds of poisonous vapour.
MON_ANCIENT_GREEN_DRAGON.description: A huge draconic form enveloped in clouds of poisonous vapour.

MON_ELDRAK.name: Eldrak
MON_ELDRAK.flavorText: A massive troll of huge strength. Eldraks are extremely stupid and extremely violent.
MON_ELDRAK.description: A massive troll of huge strength. Eldraks are extremely stupid and extremely violent.

MON_ETTIN.name: Ettin
MON_ETTIN.flavorText: A massive two-headed troll, larger and stronger than many men together. Fortunately, ettins are solitary creatures.  They are also living proof that two heads are not necessarily more intelligent than one...
MON_ETTIN.description: A massive two-headed troll, larger and stronger than many men together. Fortunately, ettins are solitary creatures.  They are also living proof that two heads are not necessarily more intelligent than one...

MON_NIGHT_MARE.name: Night mare
MON_NIGHT_MARE.flavorText: A fearsome skeletal horse with glowing eyes that watch you with little more than a hatred of all that lives. Its flying hooves do not touch the ground.
MON_NIGHT_MARE.description: A fearsome skeletal horse with glowing eyes that watch you with little more than a hatred of all that lives. Its flying hooves do not touch the ground.

MON_VAMPIRE_LORD.name: Vampire lord
MON_VAMPIRE_LORD.flavorText: A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.
MON_VAMPIRE_LORD.description: A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.

MON_ANCIENT_BLACK_DRAGON.name: Ancient black dragon
MON_ANCIENT_BLACK_DRAGON.flavorText: A huge draconic form. Pools of acid melt the floor around it.
MON_ANCIENT_BLACK_DRAGON.description: A huge draconic form. Pools of acid melt the floor around it.

MON_FAT_MAN.name: Fat Man
MON_FAT_MAN.flavorText: A shining machine of death and destruction.
MON_FAT_MAN.description: A shining machine of death and destruction.

MON_SHADOWFAX_STEED_OF_GANDALF.name: Shadowfax, steed of Gandalf
MON_SHADOWFAX_STEED_OF_GANDALF.flavorText: Shadowfax is the chief of the "Mearas", the greatest of all horses that are bred in the fields of Rohan.  Although the Mearas should technically be only ridden by the royal family of Rohan, only Gandalf the Wizard has ever succeeded in taming Shadowfax: and even then, Shadowfax will not be subjected to a bridle or saddle, but must be ridden bareback.
MON_SHADOWFAX_STEED_OF_GANDALF.description: Shadowfax is the chief of the "Mearas", the greatest of all horses that are bred in the fields of Rohan.  Although the Mearas should technically be only ridden by the royal family of Rohan, only Gandalf the Wizard has ever succeeded in taming Shadowfax: and even then, Shadowfax will not be subjected to a bridle or saddle, but must be ridden bareback.

MON_SPIRIT_TROLL.name: Spirit troll
MON_SPIRIT_TROLL.flavorText: A weird ghostly troll-like being from the ethereal plane.
MON_SPIRIT_TROLL.description: A weird ghostly troll-like being from the ethereal plane.

MON_WAR_TROLL.name: War troll
