MON_WAR_TROLL.flavorText: A massive troll, equipped with a scimitar and heavy armour.
MON_WAR_TROLL.description: A massive troll, equipped with a scimitar and heavy armour.

MON_DISENCHANTER_WORM_MASS.name: Disenchanter worm mass
MON_DISENCHANTER_WORM_MASS.flavorText: It is a strange mass of squirming worms. Magical energy crackles around its disgusting form.
MON_DISENCHANTER_WORM_MASS.description: It is a strange mass of squirming worms. Magical energy crackles around its disgusting form.

MON_ROTTING_QUYLTHULG.name: Rotting quylthulg
MON_ROTTING_QUYLTHULG.flavorText: It is a pulsing flesh mound that reeks of death and putrefaction.
MON_ROTTING_QUYLTHULG.description: It is a pulsing flesh mound that reeks of death and putrefaction.

MON_LESSER_TITAN.name: Lesser titan
MON_LESSER_TITAN.flavorText: It is a humanoid figure thirty feet tall that gives off an aura of power and hate.
MON_LESSER_TITAN.description: It is a humanoid figure thirty feet tall that gives off an aura of power and hate.

MON_9_HEADED_HYDRA.name: 9-headed hydra
MON_9_HEADED_HYDRA.flavorText: A strange reptilian creature with nine smouldering heads.
MON_9_HEADED_HYDRA.description: A strange reptilian creature with nine smouldering heads.

MON_ENCHANTRESS.name: Enchantress
MON_ENCHANTRESS.flavorText: This elusive female spellcaster has a special affinity for dragons, without whom she rarely fights.
MON_ENCHANTRESS.description: This elusive female spellcaster has a special affinity for dragons, without whom she rarely fights.

MON_RANGER_CHIEFTAIN.name: Ranger chieftain
MON_RANGER_CHIEFTAIN.flavorText: A chieftain among the Rangers.  His understanding of nature gives him powerful elemental spells to use against you, in addition to his skills as an archer and a warrior.  Furthermore, he is a master of camouflage, so you will need magically enhanced seeing to spot him.
MON_RANGER_CHIEFTAIN.description: A chieftain among the Rangers.  His understanding of nature gives him powerful elemental spells to use against you, in addition to his skills as an archer and a warrior.  Furthermore, he is a master of camouflage, so you will need magically enhanced seeing to spot him.

MON_SORCERER.name: Sorcerer
MON_SORCERER.flavorText: A human figure in robes, he moves with magically improved speed, and his hands are ablur with spell casting.
MON_SORCERER.description: A human figure in robes, he moves with magically improved speed, and his hands are ablur with spell casting.

MON_XAREN.name: Xaren
MON_XAREN.flavorText: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.
MON_XAREN.description: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.

MON_GIANT_ROC.name: Giant roc
MON_GIANT_ROC.flavorText: A vast legendary bird, its iron talons rake the most impenetrable of surfaces and its screech echoes through the many winding dungeon corridors.
MON_GIANT_ROC.description: A vast legendary bird, its iron talons rake the most impenetrable of surfaces and its screech echoes through the many winding dungeon corridors.

MON_MINOTAUR.name: Minotaur
MON_MINOTAUR.flavorText: It is a cross between a human and a bull.
MON_MINOTAUR.description: It is a cross between a human and a bull.

MON_MEDUSA_THE_GORGON.name: Medusa, the Gorgon
MON_MEDUSA_THE_GORGON.flavorText: One of the original three ugly sisters. Her face could sink a thousand ships. Her scales rattle as she slithers towards you, venom dripping from her ghastly mouth.
MON_MEDUSA_THE_GORGON.description: One of the original three ugly sisters. Her face could sink a thousand ships. Her scales rattle as she slithers towards you, venom dripping from her ghastly mouth.

MON_DEATH_DRAKE.name: Death drake
MON_DEATH_DRAKE.flavorText: It is a dragon-like form wrapped in darkness. You cannot make out its true form but you sense its evil.
MON_DEATH_DRAKE.description: It is a dragon-like form wrapped in darkness. You cannot make out its true form but you sense its evil.

MON_ANCIENT_RED_DRAGON.name: Ancient red dragon
MON_ANCIENT_RED_DRAGON.flavorText: A huge draconic form. Wisps of smoke steam from its nostrils and the extreme heat surrounding it makes you gasp for breath.
MON_ANCIENT_RED_DRAGON.description: A huge draconic form. Wisps of smoke steam from its nostrils and the extreme heat surrounding it makes you gasp for breath.

MON_ANCIENT_GOLD_DRAGON.name: Ancient gold dragon
MON_ANCIENT_GOLD_DRAGON.flavorText: A huge draconic form wreathed in a nimbus of light. Its roar stuns and deafens you.
MON_ANCIENT_GOLD_DRAGON.description: A huge draconic form wreathed in a nimbus of light. Its roar stuns and deafens you.

MON_GREAT_CRYSTAL_DRAKE.name: Great crystal drake
MON_GREAT_CRYSTAL_DRAKE.flavorText: A huge crystalline dragon. Its claws could cut you to shreds and its teeth are razor sharp. Strange colours ripple through it as it moves in the light.
MON_GREAT_CRYSTAL_DRAKE.description: A huge crystalline dragon. Its claws could cut you to shreds and its teeth are razor sharp. Strange colours ripple through it as it moves in the light.

MON_VROCK.name: Vrock
MON_VROCK.flavorText: It is a demon with a long neck and raking claws.
MON_VROCK.description: It is a demon with a long neck and raking claws.

MON_DEATH_QUASIT.name: Death quasit
MON_DEATH_QUASIT.flavorText: It is a demon of small stature, but its armoured frame moves with lightning speed and its powers make it a tornado of death and destruction.
MON_DEATH_QUASIT.description: It is a demon of small stature, but its armoured frame moves with lightning speed and its powers make it a tornado of death and destruction.

MON_FALLEN_ANGEL.name: Fallen angel
MON_FALLEN_ANGEL.flavorText: An angelic being, who was mighty once, but dared defy its Creator.
MON_FALLEN_ANGEL.description: An angelic being, who was mighty once, but dared defy its Creator.

MON_JUDGE_FIRE.name: Judge Fire
MON_JUDGE_FIRE.flavorText: One of the Dark Judges, he has come to punish your crime of living. He looks like a skeleton enveloped in flames.
MON_JUDGE_FIRE.description: One of the Dark Judges, he has come to punish your crime of living. He looks like a skeleton enveloped in flames.

MON_JUDGE_MORTIS.name: Judge Mortis
MON_JUDGE_MORTIS.flavorText: Another Dark Judge, he is a rotting humanoid with a cow's skull as his head.
MON_JUDGE_MORTIS.description: Another Dark Judge, he is a rotting humanoid with a cow's skull as his head.

MON_DARK_ELVEN_SORCERER.name: Dark elven sorcerer
MON_DARK_ELVEN_SORCERER.flavorText: A dark elven figure, dressed in deepest black. Power seems to crackle from his slender frame.
MON_DARK_ELVEN_SORCERER.description: A dark elven figure, dressed in deepest black. Power seems to crackle from his slender frame.

MON_MASTER_LICH.name: Master lich
MON_MASTER_LICH.flavorText: A skeletal form wrapped in robes. Powerful magic crackles along its bony fingers.
MON_MASTER_LICH.description: A skeletal form wrapped in robes. Powerful magic crackles along its bony fingers.

MON_EOL_THE_DARK_ELF.name: Eol, the Dark Elf
MON_EOL_THE_DARK_ELF.flavorText: A lord of the Teleri, Eol is a mighty metalsmith, the first one ever to forge weapons of meteorite iron.  His dark countenance glares at you in disdain.
MON_EOL_THE_DARK_ELF.description: A lord of the Teleri, Eol is a mighty metalsmith, the first one ever to forge weapons of meteorite iron.  His dark countenance glares at you in disdain.

MON_ARCHON.name: Archon
MON_ARCHON.flavorText: Never a more heavenly being have you seen. The very holiness of its presence makes you deeply respect it. Few creatures can match the powers of an Archon; fewer still live to tell the tale after attacking one.
MON_ARCHON.description: Never a more heavenly being have you seen. The very holiness of its presence makes you deeply respect it. Few creatures can match the powers of an Archon; fewer still live to tell the tale after attacking one.

MON_UNDEAD_BEHOLDER.name: Undead beholder
MON_UNDEAD_BEHOLDER.flavorText: A beholder which has cheated death.  Black nether storms rage around the bloodshot pupil of its central giant eye, and light seems to bend as it sucks its power from the very air around it.  Your soul chills as it drains your vitality for its evil enchantments.
MON_UNDEAD_BEHOLDER.description: A beholder which has cheated death.  Black nether storms rage around the bloodshot pupil of its central giant eye, and light seems to bend as it sucks its power from the very air around it.  Your soul chills as it drains your vitality for its evil enchantments.

MON_SHADOW.name: Shadow
MON_SHADOW.flavorText: A mighty spirit of darkness of vaguely humanoid form. Razor-edged claws reach out to end your life as it glides towards you, seeking to suck the energy from your soul to feed its power.
MON_SHADOW.description: A mighty spirit of darkness of vaguely humanoid form. Razor-edged claws reach out to end your life as it glides towards you, seeking to suck the energy from your soul to feed its power.

MON_IRON_LICH.name: Iron lich
MON_IRON_LICH.flavorText: It is a huge, twisted grey skull floating through the air. Its cold eyes burn with hatred towards all who live.
MON_IRON_LICH.description: It is a huge, twisted grey skull floating through the air. Its cold eyes burn with hatred towards all who live.

MON_GREATER_BASILISK.name: Greater basilisk
MON_GREATER_BASILISK.flavorText: A large basilisk, whose shape resembles that of a great wyrm.
MON_GREATER_BASILISK.description: A large basilisk, whose shape resembles that of a great wyrm.

MON_JUDGE_FEAR.name: Judge Fear
MON_JUDGE_FEAR.flavorText: A Dark Judge, reputedly so frightening that his gaze can kill.
MON_JUDGE_FEAR.description: A Dark Judge, reputedly so frightening that his gaze can kill.

MON_ANCIENT_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON.name: Ancient multi-hued dragon
MON_ANCIENT_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON.flavorText: A huge draconic form. Many colours ripple down its massive frame. Few live to see another.
MON_ANCIENT_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON.description: A huge draconic form. Many colours ripple down its massive frame. Few live to see another.

MON_ETHEREAL_DRAGON.name: Ethereal dragon
MON_ETHEREAL_DRAGON.flavorText: A huge dragon emanating from the ethereal plane, this terrible creature is a master of light and dark. Its form disappears from sight as it cloaks itself in unearthly shadows.
MON_ETHEREAL_DRAGON.description: A huge dragon emanating from the ethereal plane, this terrible creature is a master of light and dark. Its form disappears from sight as it cloaks itself in unearthly shadows.

MON_QUAKER_MASTER_OF_EARTH.name: Quaker, Master of Earth
MON_QUAKER_MASTER_OF_EARTH.flavorText: A towering stone elemental stands before you. The walls and ceiling are reduced to rubble as Quaker advances.
MON_QUAKER_MASTER_OF_EARTH.description: A towering stone elemental stands before you. The walls and ceiling are reduced to rubble as Quaker advances.

MON_JUDGE_DEATH.name: Judge Death
MON_JUDGE_DEATH.flavorText: The most powerful Dark Judge, whose touch means death.
MON_JUDGE_DEATH.description: The most powerful Dark Judge, whose touch means death.

MON_ARIEL_QUEEN_OF_AIR.name: Ariel, Queen of Air
MON_ARIEL_QUEEN_OF_AIR.flavorText: A towering air elemental, Ariel the sorceress avoids your blows with her extreme speed.
MON_ARIEL_QUEEN_OF_AIR.description: A towering air elemental, Ariel the sorceress avoids your blows with her extreme speed.

MON_11_HEADED_HYDRA.name: 11-headed hydra
MON_11_HEADED_HYDRA.flavorText: A strange reptilian hybrid with eleven smouldering heads.
MON_11_HEADED_HYDRA.description: A strange reptilian hybrid with eleven smouldering heads.

MON_PATRIARCH.name: Patriarch
MON_PATRIARCH.flavorText: An evil priest, dressed all in black.  Deadly spells hit you at an alarming rate as his black spiked mace rains down blow after blow on your pitiful frame.
MON_PATRIARCH.description: An evil priest, dressed all in black.  Deadly spells hit you at an alarming rate as his black spiked mace rains down blow after blow on your pitiful frame.

MON_DREADMASTER.name: Dreadmaster
MON_DREADMASTER.flavorText: It is an unlife of power almost unequalled. An affront to existence, its very touch abuses and disrupts the flow of life, and its unearthly limbs, of purest black, crush rock and flesh with ease.
MON_DREADMASTER.description: It is an unlife of power almost unequalled. An affront to existence, its very touch abuses and disrupts the flow of life, and its unearthly limbs, of purest black, crush rock and flesh with ease.

MON_DROLEM.name: Drolem
MON_DROLEM.flavorText: A constructed dragon, the drolem has massive strength. Powerful spells weaved during its creation make it a fearsome adversary. Its eyes show little intelligence, but it has been instructed to destroy all it meets.
MON_DROLEM.description: A constructed dragon, the drolem has massive strength. Powerful spells weaved during its creation make it a fearsome adversary. Its eyes show little intelligence, but it has been instructed to destroy all it meets.

MON_SCATHA_THE_WORM.name: Scatha the Worm
MON_SCATHA_THE_WORM.flavorText: An ancient and wise dragon, Scatha has grown clever over the long years. His scales are covered with frost, and his breath sends a shower of ice into the air.
MON_SCATHA_THE_WORM.description: An ancient and wise dragon, Scatha has grown clever over the long years. His scales are covered with frost, and his breath sends a shower of ice into the air.

MON_LESSER_BLACK_REAVER.name: Lesser black reaver
MON_LESSER_BLACK_REAVER.flavorText: A humanoid form, black as night, advancing steadily and unstoppably.
MON_LESSER_BLACK_REAVER.description: A humanoid form, black as night, advancing steadily and unstoppably.

MON_GRAND_MASTER_THIEF.name: Grand master thief
MON_GRAND_MASTER_THIEF.flavorText: A class of its own: you are already too late to protect your possessions - and he seems to have studied magic too, and is a master of setting traps.
MON_GRAND_MASTER_THIEF.description: A class of its own: you are already too late to protect your possessions - and he seems to have studied magic too, and is a master of setting traps.

MON_SMAUG_THE_GOLDEN.name: Smaug the Golden
MON_SMAUG_THE_GOLDEN.flavorText: Smaug is one of the Uruloki that still survive, a fire-drake of immense cunning and intelligence.  His speed through air is matched by few other dragons, his dragonfire is legendary, and his hide is armoured with diamonds. He is believed to be the greatest dragon still surviving into the Third Age.
MON_SMAUG_THE_GOLDEN.description: Smaug is one of the Uruloki that still survive, a fire-drake of immense cunning and intelligence.  His speed through air is matched by few other dragons, his dragonfire is legendary, and his hide is armoured with diamonds. He is believed to be the greatest dragon still surviving into the Third Age.

MON_KNIGHT_TEMPLAR.name: Knight Templar
MON_KNIGHT_TEMPLAR.flavorText: It seems that the more devout the person, the more likely they are to cross the boundary between piety and sanctimoniousness.  And such is the case with the Order of the Knights Templar; they are among the most pious and powerful of the religious knightly orders, but noted for their intolerance. Thus it is Morgoth's will that is unwittingly done, as the forces of good are set against each other.
MON_KNIGHT_TEMPLAR.description: It seems that the more devout the person, the more likely they are to cross the boundary between piety and sanctimoniousness.  And such is the case with the Order of the Knights Templar; they are among the most pious and powerful of the religious knightly orders, but noted for their intolerance. Thus it is Morgoth's will that is unwittingly done, as the forces of good are set against each other.

MON_DRACOLICH.name: Dracolich
MON_DRACOLICH.flavorText: The skeletal form of a once-great dragon, enchanted by magic most perilous. Its animated form strikes with speed and drains life from its prey to satisfy its hunger.
MON_DRACOLICH.description: The skeletal form of a once-great dragon, enchanted by magic most perilous. Its animated form strikes with speed and drains life from its prey to satisfy its hunger.

MON_GREATER_TITAN.name: Greater titan
MON_GREATER_TITAN.flavorText: A forty foot tall humanoid that shakes the ground as it walks. The power radiating from its frame shakes your courage, its hatred inspired by your defiance.
MON_GREATER_TITAN.description: A forty foot tall humanoid that shakes the ground as it walks. The power radiating from its frame shakes your courage, its hatred inspired by your defiance.

MON_DRACOLISK.name: Dracolisk
MON_DRACOLISK.flavorText: A mixture of dragon and basilisk, the dracolisk stares at you with deep piercing eyes, its evil breath burning the ground where it stands.
MON_DRACOLISK.description: A mixture of dragon and basilisk, the dracolisk stares at you with deep piercing eyes, its evil breath burning the ground where it stands.

MON_WINGED_HORROR.name: Winged Horror
MON_WINGED_HORROR.flavorText: A terrifying sight:  a winged creature greater than any bird you have ever seen, and with no feathers on its horrid black leathery wings.  Descended from a creature of an older world perhaps, bred by Sauron to be a winged steed for his Ringwraiths.
MON_WINGED_HORROR.description: A terrifying sight:  a winged creature greater than any bird you have ever seen, and with no feathers on its horrid black leathery wings.  Descended from a creature of an older world perhaps, bred by Sauron to be a winged steed for his Ringwraiths.

MON_ENT.name: Ent
MON_ENT.flavorText: A tree-herd: a sentient, moving tree. Its wrath is fearsome, and it could split stones and even the very rock of Isengard with its roots.
MON_ENT.description: A tree-herd: a sentient, moving tree. Its wrath is fearsome, and it could split stones and even the very rock of Isengard with its roots.

MON_HRU.name: Hru
MON_HRU.flavorText: A rock giant, a being made of living stone.
MON_HRU.description: A rock giant, a being made of living stone.

MON_ITANGAST_THE_FIRE_DRAKE.name: Itangast the Fire Drake
MON_ITANGAST_THE_FIRE_DRAKE.flavorText: A mighty ancient dragon, Itangast's form scorches your flesh. Wisps of smoke curl up from his nostrils as he regards you with disdain.
MON_ITANGAST_THE_FIRE_DRAKE.description: A mighty ancient dragon, Itangast's form scorches your flesh. Wisps of smoke curl up from his nostrils as he regards you with disdain.

MON_DEATH_MOLD.name: Death mold
MON_DEATH_MOLD.flavorText: It is the epitome of all that is evil, in a mold. Its lifeless form draws power from sucking the souls of those that approach it; a nimbus of pure evil surrounds it. Luckily for you, it can't move...
MON_DEATH_MOLD.description: It is the epitome of all that is evil, in a mold. Its lifeless form draws power from sucking the souls of those that approach it; a nimbus of pure evil surrounds it. Luckily for you, it can't move...

MON_QUICKBEAM_THE_ENT.name: Quickbeam, the Ent
MON_QUICKBEAM_THE_ENT.flavorText: Unusually hasty, for an ent.  Quickbeam hates evil creatures, and orcs in particular, since the destruction of his beloved rowan-trees to feed the fires of Orthanc.
MON_QUICKBEAM_THE_ENT.description: Unusually hasty, for an ent.  Quickbeam hates evil creatures, and orcs in particular, since the destruction of his beloved rowan-trees to feed the fires of Orthanc.

MON_GLAURUNG_FATHER_OF_THE_DRAGONS.name: Glaurung, Father of the Dragons
MON_GLAURUNG_FATHER_OF_THE_DRAGONS.flavorText: Glaurung is the father of all dragons, and was for a long time the most powerful.  Though this is no longer so, he still has full command over his brood and can command them to appear whenever he so wishes.  He is the definition of dragonfire.
MON_GLAURUNG_FATHER_OF_THE_DRAGONS.description: Glaurung is the father of all dragons, and was for a long time the most powerful.  Though this is no longer so, he still has full command over his brood and can command them to appear whenever he so wishes.  He is the definition of dragonfire.

MON_BEHEMOTH.name: Behemoth
MON_BEHEMOTH.flavorText: A great water-beast, with an almost impenetrable skin.
MON_BEHEMOTH.description: A great water-beast, with an almost impenetrable skin.

MON_GREATER_WALL_MONSTER.name: Greater wall monster
MON_GREATER_WALL_MONSTER.flavorText: A sentient, moving section of wall.
MON_GREATER_WALL_MONSTER.description: A sentient, moving section of wall.

MON_NYCADAEMON.name: Nycadaemon
MON_NYCADAEMON.flavorText: A loathsome, sturdy, winged, horned demon, with talons that could tear a stone wall down.
MON_NYCADAEMON.description: A loathsome, sturdy, winged, horned demon, with talons that could tear a stone wall down.

MON_BARBAZU.name: Barbazu
MON_BARBAZU.flavorText: A foul, humanoid creature with a long tail, clawed hands and feet, and a disgusting, wiry, snaky beard.  They are the elite shock troops of the hells, capable of a terrifying berserk fury.
MON_BARBAZU.description: A foul, humanoid creature with a long tail, clawed hands and feet, and a disgusting, wiry, snaky beard.  They are the elite shock troops of the hells, capable of a terrifying berserk fury.

MON_NIGHTWING.name: Nightwing
MON_NIGHTWING.flavorText: Everywhere colours seem paler and the air chiller. At the centre of the cold stands a mighty figure. Its wings envelop you in the chill of death as the nightwing reaches out to draw you into oblivion. Your muscles sag and your mind loses all will to fight as you stand in awe of this mighty being.
MON_NIGHTWING.description: Everywhere colours seem paler and the air chiller. At the centre of the cold stands a mighty figure. Its wings envelop you in the chill of death as the nightwing reaches out to draw you into oblivion. Your muscles sag and your mind loses all will to fight as you stand in awe of this mighty being.

MON_MAULOTAUR.name: Maulotaur
MON_MAULOTAUR.flavorText: It is a belligerent minotaur with a destructive magical arsenal, armed with a hammer.
MON_MAULOTAUR.description: It is a belligerent minotaur with a destructive magical arsenal, armed with a hammer.

MON_NETHER_HOUND.name: Nether hound
MON_NETHER_HOUND.flavorText: You feel a soul-tearing chill upon viewing this beast, a ghostly form of darkness in the shape of a large dog.
MON_NETHER_HOUND.description: You feel a soul-tearing chill upon viewing this beast, a ghostly form of darkness in the shape of a large dog.

MON_TIME_HOUND.name: Time hound
MON_TIME_HOUND.flavorText: You get a terrible sense of deja vu, or is it a premonition?  All at once you see a little puppy and a toothless old dog. Perhaps you should give up and go to bed.
MON_TIME_HOUND.description: You get a terrible sense of deja vu, or is it a premonition?  All at once you see a little puppy and a toothless old dog. Perhaps you should give up and go to bed.

MON_PLASMA_HOUND.name: Plasma hound
MON_PLASMA_HOUND.flavorText: The very air warps as pure elemental energy stalks towards you in the shape of a giant hound. Your hair stands on end and your palms itch as you sense trouble.
MON_PLASMA_HOUND.description: The very air warps as pure elemental energy stalks towards you in the shape of a giant hound. Your hair stands on end and your palms itch as you sense trouble.

MON_DEMONIC_QUYLTHULG.name: Demonic quylthulg
MON_DEMONIC_QUYLTHULG.flavorText: A pile of pulsing flesh that glows with an inner hellish fire. The world itself seems to cry out against it.
MON_DEMONIC_QUYLTHULG.description: A pile of pulsing flesh that glows with an inner hellish fire. The world itself seems to cry out against it.

MON_GREAT_STORM_WYRM.name: Great Storm Wyrm
MON_GREAT_STORM_WYRM.flavorText: A vast dragon of power. Storms and lightning crash around its titanic form. Deep blue scales reflect the flashes and highlight the creature's great muscles. It regards you with contempt.
MON_GREAT_STORM_WYRM.description: A vast dragon of power. Storms and lightning crash around its titanic form. Deep blue scales reflect the flashes and highlight the creature's great muscles. It regards you with contempt.

MON_ULIK_THE_TROLL.name: Ulik the Troll
MON_ULIK_THE_TROLL.flavorText: Ulik is the strongest troll who has ever lived. He could challenge the immortals and pound them to dust with his great strength.
MON_ULIK_THE_TROLL.description: Ulik is the strongest troll who has ever lived. He could challenge the immortals and pound them to dust with his great strength.

MON_BAPHOMET_THE_MINOTAUR_LORD.name: Baphomet the Minotaur Lord
MON_BAPHOMET_THE_MINOTAUR_LORD.flavorText: A fearsome bull-headed monster, Baphomet swings a mighty axe as he curses all that defy him.
MON_BAPHOMET_THE_MINOTAUR_LORD.description: A fearsome bull-headed monster, Baphomet swings a mighty axe as he curses all that defy him.

MON_HELL_KNIGHT.name: Hell knight
MON_HELL_KNIGHT.flavorText: It is a humanoid form dressed in armour of ancient style. From beneath its helmet, eyes glow with hellfire.
MON_HELL_KNIGHT.description: It is a humanoid form dressed in armour of ancient style. From beneath its helmet, eyes glow with hellfire.

MON_BULL_GATES.name: Bull Gates
MON_BULL_GATES.flavorText: He may not code worth a dime, but he certainly knows how to make money.
MON_BULL_GATES.description: He may not code worth a dime, but he certainly knows how to make money.

MON_SANTA_CLAUS.name: Santa Claus
MON_SANTA_CLAUS.flavorText: Why would anybody want to kill Santa Claus? To get all the presents, of course!
MON_SANTA_CLAUS.description: Why would anybody want to kill Santa Claus? To get all the presents, of course!

MON_OLD_SORCERER.name: Old Sorcerer
MON_OLD_SORCERER.flavorText: A human figure in robes, he moves with magically improved speed, and his hands are ablur with spell casting. You stagger at the mighty sound of his spells as they echo hollowly through the dungeon.
MON_OLD_SORCERER.description: A human figure in robes, he moves with magically improved speed, and his hands are ablur with spell casting. You stagger at the mighty sound of his spells as they echo hollowly through the dungeon.

MON_ETHEREAL_HOUND.name: Ethereal hound
MON_ETHEREAL_HOUND.flavorText: A pale green hound. Pulsing red lines and strange fluorescent light hint at internal organs best left to the imagination.
MON_ETHEREAL_HOUND.description: A pale green hound. Pulsing red lines and strange fluorescent light hint at internal organs best left to the imagination.

MON_LESSER_KRAKEN.name: Lesser kraken
MON_LESSER_KRAKEN.flavorText: An enormously fearsome and powerful inhabitant of the depths. It resembles a gargantuan octopus and its evil is almost tangible.
MON_LESSER_KRAKEN.description: An enormously fearsome and powerful inhabitant of the depths. It resembles a gargantuan octopus and its evil is almost tangible.

MON_GREAT_ICE_WYRM.name: Great Ice Wyrm
MON_GREAT_ICE_WYRM.flavorText: An immense dragon capable of awesome destruction. You have never felt such extreme cold, or witnessed such an icy stare. Begone quickly or feel its wrath!
MON_GREAT_ICE_WYRM.description: An immense dragon capable of awesome destruction. You have never felt such extreme cold, or witnessed such an icy stare. Begone quickly or feel its wrath!

MON_DEMILICH.name: Demilich
MON_DEMILICH.flavorText: A lich who is partially immaterial, on its way to a new, ethereal form.
MON_DEMILICH.description: A lich who is partially immaterial, on its way to a new, ethereal form.

MON_THE_PHOENIX.name: The Phoenix
MON_THE_PHOENIX.flavorText: A massive glowing eagle bathed in flames. The searing heat chars your skin and melts your armour.
MON_THE_PHOENIX.description: A massive glowing eagle bathed in flames. The searing heat chars your skin and melts your armour.

MON_NIGHTCRAWLER.name: Nightcrawler
MON_NIGHTCRAWLER.flavorText: This intensely evil creature bears the form of a gargantuan black worm. Its gaping maw is a void of blackness, and acid drips from its steely hide. It is like nothing you have ever seen before, and a terrible chill runs down your spine as you face it.
MON_NIGHTCRAWLER.description: This intensely evil creature bears the form of a gargantuan black worm. Its gaping maw is a void of blackness, and acid drips from its steely hide. It is like nothing you have ever seen before, and a terrible chill runs down your spine as you face it.

MON_HAND_DRUJ.name: Hand druj
MON_HAND_DRUJ.flavorText: A skeletal hand floating in the air, motionless except for its flexing fingers.
MON_HAND_DRUJ.description: A skeletal hand floating in the air, motionless except for its flexing fingers.

MON_EYE_DRUJ.name: Eye druj
MON_EYE_DRUJ.flavorText: A bloodshot eyeball floating in the air, you'd be forgiven for assuming it harmless.
MON_EYE_DRUJ.description: A bloodshot eyeball floating in the air, you'd be forgiven for assuming it harmless.

MON_SKULL_DRUJ.name: Skull druj
MON_SKULL_DRUJ.flavorText: A glowing skull possessed by sorcerous power. It need not move, but merely blast you with mighty magic.
MON_SKULL_DRUJ.description: A glowing skull possessed by sorcerous power. It need not move, but merely blast you with mighty magic.

MON_AETHER_VORTEX.name: Aether vortex
MON_AETHER_VORTEX.flavorText: An awesome vortex of pure magic, power radiates from its frame.
MON_AETHER_VORTEX.description: An awesome vortex of pure magic, power radiates from its frame.

MON_THE_LERNAEAN_HYDRA.name: The Lernaean Hydra
MON_THE_LERNAEAN_HYDRA.flavorText: A massive legendary hydra. It has twelve powerful heads. Its many eyes stare at you as clouds of smoke and poisonous vapour rise from its seething form.  It grows new heads as fast as you chop them off.
MON_THE_LERNAEAN_HYDRA.description: A massive legendary hydra. It has twelve powerful heads. Its many eyes stare at you as clouds of smoke and poisonous vapour rise from its seething form.  It grows new heads as fast as you chop them off.

MON_THURINGWETHIL_THE_VAMPIRE_MESSENGER.name: Thuringwethil, the Vampire Messenger
MON_THURINGWETHIL_THE_VAMPIRE_MESSENGER.flavorText: Chief messenger between Sauron and Morgoth, she is the most deadly of her vampire race on Middle-earth.  At first she is charming to meet, but her wings and eyes give away her true form.
MON_THURINGWETHIL_THE_VAMPIRE_MESSENGER.description: Chief messenger between Sauron and Morgoth, she is the most deadly of her vampire race on Middle-earth.  At first she is charming to meet, but her wings and eyes give away her true form.

MON_GREAT_HELL_WYRM.name: Great Hell Wyrm
MON_GREAT_HELL_WYRM.flavorText: A vast dragon of immense power. Fire leaps continuously from its huge form. The air around it scalds you. Its slightest glance burns you, and you realise how truly insignificant you are.
MON_GREAT_HELL_WYRM.description: A vast dragon of immense power. Fire leaps continuously from its huge form. The air around it scalds you. Its slightest glance burns you, and you realise how truly insignificant you are.

MON_DRACONIC_QUYLTHULG.name: Draconic quylthulg
MON_DRACONIC_QUYLTHULG.flavorText: It looks like it was once a dragon corpse, now deeply infected with magical bacteria that make it pulse in a foul and degrading way.
MON_DRACONIC_QUYLTHULG.description: It looks like it was once a dragon corpse, now deeply infected with magical bacteria that make it pulse in a foul and degrading way.

MON_FUNDIN_BLUECLOAK.name: Fundin Bluecloak
MON_FUNDIN_BLUECLOAK.flavorText: He is one of the greatest dwarven priests to walk the earth. Fundin has earned a high position in the church, and his skill with both weapon and spell only justify his position further. His combination of both dwarven strength and priestly wisdom are a true match for any adventurer.
MON_FUNDIN_BLUECLOAK.description: He is one of the greatest dwarven priests to walk the earth. Fundin has earned a high position in the church, and his skill with both weapon and spell only justify his position further. His combination of both dwarven strength and priestly wisdom are a true match for any adventurer.

MON_BILE_DEMON.name: Bile Demon
MON_BILE_DEMON.flavorText: It's big.  It's fat.  It's red.  It's ugly.  It's got a severe attack of highly poisonous flatulence.  And its insides are corrosive.  All of which go together to make the single most repulsive sight - and smell - you have ever experienced.
MON_BILE_DEMON.description: It's big.  It's fat.  It's red.  It's ugly.  It's got a severe attack of highly poisonous flatulence.  And its insides are corrosive.  All of which go together to make the single most repulsive sight - and smell - you have ever experienced.

MON_URIEL_ANGEL_OF_FIRE.name: Uriel, Angel of Fire
MON_URIEL_ANGEL_OF_FIRE.flavorText: A creature of godly appearance. You dare not challenge Uriel's supremacy. Those who stood against him before are but a memory, cremated by his mastery of elemental fire.
MON_URIEL_ANGEL_OF_FIRE.description: A creature of godly appearance. You dare not challenge Uriel's supremacy. Those who stood against him before are but a memory, cremated by his mastery of elemental fire.

MON_AZRIEL_ANGEL_OF_DEATH.name: Azriel, Angel of Death
MON_AZRIEL_ANGEL_OF_DEATH.flavorText: Azriel commands awesome power, his visage holy enough to shrivel your soul. You shriek with disbelief as his mastery of death draws you to your grave. It is truly beyond all but the mightiest of warriors to stand against him and live.
MON_AZRIEL_ANGEL_OF_DEATH.description: Azriel commands awesome power, his visage holy enough to shrivel your soul. You shriek with disbelief as his mastery of death draws you to your grave. It is truly beyond all but the mightiest of warriors to stand against him and live.

MON_ANCALAGON_THE_BLACK.name: Ancalagon the Black
MON_ANCALAGON_THE_BLACK.flavorText: "Rushing Jaws" is his name, and death is his game; the greatest and most terrible of all dragonkind, his power dismayed even the Valar for a time.
MON_ANCALAGON_THE_BLACK.description: "Rushing Jaws" is his name, and death is his game; the greatest and most terrible of all dragonkind, his power dismayed even the Valar for a time.

MON_NIGHTWALKER.name: Nightwalker
MON_NIGHTWALKER.flavorText: A huge giant garbed in black, more massive than a titan and stronger than a dragon. With terrible blows, it breaks your armour from your back, leaving you defenceless against its evil wrath. It can smell your fear, and you in turn smell the awful stench of death as this ghastly figure strides towards you menacingly.
MON_NIGHTWALKER.description: A huge giant garbed in black, more massive than a titan and stronger than a dragon. With terrible blows, it breaks your armour from your back, leaving you defenceless against its evil wrath. It can smell your fear, and you in turn smell the awful stench of death as this ghastly figure strides towards you menacingly.

MON_GABRIEL_THE_MESSENGER.name: Gabriel, the Messenger
MON_GABRIEL_THE_MESSENGER.flavorText: Commanding a legion of angels, Gabriel will destroy you for your sins. He will crush you like the pitiful insignificant being he sees you to be. Your very soul will be taken into judgement by his supreme authority as he cleanses the world of evil.
MON_GABRIEL_THE_MESSENGER.description: Commanding a legion of angels, Gabriel will destroy you for your sins. He will crush you like the pitiful insignificant being he sees you to be. Your very soul will be taken into judgement by his supreme authority as he cleanses the world of evil.

MON_SARUMAN_OF_MANY_COLOURS.name: Saruman of Many Colours
MON_SARUMAN_OF_MANY_COLOURS.flavorText: Originally known as the White, Saruman fell prey to Sauron's wiles. He searches forever for the One Ring, to become a mighty Sorcerer-King of the world.
MON_SARUMAN_OF_MANY_COLOURS.description: Originally known as the White, Saruman fell prey to Sauron's wiles. He searches forever for the One Ring, to become a mighty Sorcerer-King of the world.

MON_HAROWEN_THE_BLACK_HAND.name: Harowen the Black Hand
MON_HAROWEN_THE_BLACK_HAND.flavorText: He is a master of disguise, an expert of stealth, a genius at traps, and moves with blinding speed. Check your pockets!
MON_HAROWEN_THE_BLACK_HAND.description: He is a master of disguise, an expert of stealth, a genius at traps, and moves with blinding speed. Check your pockets!

MON_OSYLUTH.name: Osyluth
MON_OSYLUTH.flavorText: It is a demon made almost entirely out of bones.  It is humanoid, but with a large tail similar to that of a giant scorpion, and emits a foul smell of decay and rot.  They are despised even in the hells.
MON_OSYLUTH.description: It is a demon made almost entirely out of bones.  It is humanoid, but with a large tail similar to that of a giant scorpion, and emits a foul smell of decay and rot.  They are despised even in the hells.

MON_DREADLORD.name: Dreadlord
MON_DREADLORD.flavorText: It is a massive form of animated death, its colour deeper than black.  It drinks in light, and space around it is twisted and torn by the weight of its evil.  It is unlife and it knows nothing but the stealing of souls and the stench of death.  Flee its hunger!
MON_DREADLORD.description: It is a massive form of animated death, its colour deeper than black.  It drinks in light, and space around it is twisted and torn by the weight of its evil.  It is unlife and it knows nothing but the stealing of souls and the stench of death.  Flee its hunger!

MON_GREATER_KRAKEN.name: Greater kraken
MON_GREATER_KRAKEN.flavorText: An enormously fearsome and powerful inhabitant of the depths. It resembles a gargantuan octopus and its evil is almost tangible.
MON_GREATER_KRAKEN.description: An enormously fearsome and powerful inhabitant of the depths. It resembles a gargantuan octopus and its evil is almost tangible.

MON_ARCHLICH.name: Archlich
MON_ARCHLICH.flavorText: A lich who has reached its ultimate evolutionary stage: a completely immaterial state.
MON_ARCHLICH.description: A lich who has reached its ultimate evolutionary stage: a completely immaterial state.

MON_THE_CAT_LORD.name: The Cat Lord
MON_THE_CAT_LORD.flavorText: Master of all things feline, the Cat Lord moves with catlike stealth.
MON_THE_CAT_LORD.description: Master of all things feline, the Cat Lord moves with catlike stealth.

MON_JABBERWOCK.name: Jabberwock
MON_JABBERWOCK.flavorText: 'Twas brillig, and the slithy toves / Did gyre and gimble in the wabe: / All mimsy were the borogoves, / And the mome raths outgrabe. / "Beware the Jabberwock, my son! / The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!"
MON_JABBERWOCK.description: 'Twas brillig, and the slithy toves / Did gyre and gimble in the wabe: / All mimsy were the borogoves, / And the mome raths outgrabe. / "Beware the Jabberwock, my son! / The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!"

MON_CHAOS_HOUND.name: Chaos hound
MON_CHAOS_HOUND.flavorText: A constantly changing canine form, this hound rushes towards you as if expecting mayhem and chaos ahead. It appears to have an almost kamikaze relish for combat. You suspect all may not be as it seems.
MON_CHAOS_HOUND.description: A constantly changing canine form, this hound rushes towards you as if expecting mayhem and chaos ahead. It appears to have an almost kamikaze relish for combat. You suspect all may not be as it seems.

MON_BEHOLDER_HIVE_MOTHER.name: Beholder hive-mother
MON_BEHOLDER_HIVE_MOTHER.flavorText: A hive mother of the race of beholders, she can summon her brood to her aid whenever she wishes.
MON_BEHOLDER_HIVE_MOTHER.description: A hive mother of the race of beholders, she can summon her brood to her aid whenever she wishes.

MON_LEVIATHAN.name: Leviathan
MON_LEVIATHAN.flavorText: An enormous, terrible sea-monster, the true master of the ocean.
MON_LEVIATHAN.description: An enormous, terrible sea-monster, the true master of the ocean.

MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_CHAOS.name: Great Wyrm of Chaos
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_CHAOS.flavorText: A massive dragon of changing form. As you watch, it appears first fair and then foul. Its body is twisted by chaotic forces as it strives to stay real. Its very existence distorts the universe around it.
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_CHAOS.description: A massive dragon of changing form. As you watch, it appears first fair and then foul. Its body is twisted by chaotic forces as it strives to stay real. Its very existence distorts the universe around it.

MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_LAW.name: Great Wyrm of Law
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_LAW.flavorText: A massive dragon of powerful intellect. It seeks to dominate the universe and despises all other life. It sees all who do not obey it as mere insects to be crushed underfoot.
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_LAW.description: A massive dragon of powerful intellect. It seeks to dominate the universe and despises all other life. It sees all who do not obey it as mere insects to be crushed underfoot.

MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_BALANCE.name: Great Wyrm of Balance
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_BALANCE.flavorText: A massive dragon, it is thousands of years old and seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance. It sees you as an upstart troublemaker without the wisdom to control your actions.
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_BALANCE.description: A massive dragon, it is thousands of years old and seeks to maintain the Cosmic Balance. It sees you as an upstart troublemaker without the wisdom to control your actions.

MON_GELUGON.name: Gelugon
MON_GELUGON.flavorText: This demon from the ice planes is a truly terrifying sight.  It has an extremely large, insect-like body towering a full twelve feet tall, with great claws on its hands and pincers on its mouth, and its head bulges with great multi-faceted eyes.  Its tail is covered with razor-sharp spikes.
MON_GELUGON.description: This demon from the ice planes is a truly terrifying sight.  It has an extremely large, insect-like body towering a full twelve feet tall, with great claws on its hands and pincers on its mouth, and its head bulges with great multi-faceted eyes.  Its tail is covered with razor-sharp spikes.

MON_TRONE_THE_REBEL_THUNDERLORD.name: Trone, the Rebel Thunderlord
MON_TRONE_THE_REBEL_THUNDERLORD.flavorText: As the Thunderlords came from afar to help the elves, Trone and his rebel wing came to defend Morgoth! He is an evil and powerful Thunderlord.
MON_TRONE_THE_REBEL_THUNDERLORD.description: As the Thunderlords came from afar to help the elves, Trone and his rebel wing came to defend Morgoth! He is an evil and powerful Thunderlord.

MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_MANY_COLOURS.name: Great Wyrm of Many Colours
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_MANY_COLOURS.flavorText: A huge dragon whose scales shimmer in myriad hues.
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_MANY_COLOURS.description: A huge dragon whose scales shimmer in myriad hues.

MON_MARDA_RIDER_OF_GOLD_LARONTH.name: Marda, rider of gold Laronth
MON_MARDA_RIDER_OF_GOLD_LARONTH.flavorText: Former leader among the Thunderlords, she and Trone have fallen under the control of Morgoth. Laronth, her eagle, can summon Thunderlords to her aid.
MON_MARDA_RIDER_OF_GOLD_LARONTH.description: Former leader among the Thunderlords, she and Trone have fallen under the control of Morgoth. Laronth, her eagle, can summon Thunderlords to her aid.

MON_TSELAKUS_THE_DREADLORD.name: Tselakus, the Dreadlord
MON_TSELAKUS_THE_DREADLORD.flavorText: This huge affront to existence twists and tears at the fabric of space. Darkness itself recoils from the touch of Tselakus as he leaves a trail of death and destruction. Mighty claws rend reality as he annihilates all in his path to your soul!
MON_TSELAKUS_THE_DREADLORD.description: This huge affront to existence twists and tears at the fabric of space. Darkness itself recoils from the touch of Tselakus as he leaves a trail of death and destruction. Mighty claws rend reality as he annihilates all in his path to your soul!

MON_SKY_DRAKE.name: Sky Drake
MON_SKY_DRAKE.flavorText: The mightiest elemental dragon of air, it can destroy you with ease.
MON_SKY_DRAKE.description: The mightiest elemental dragon of air, it can destroy you with ease.

MON_HORNED_REAPER.name: Horned Reaper
MON_HORNED_REAPER.flavorText: A giant humanoid demon wielding a massive, heavy and sharp scythe.  Feared by foes and friends alike when it flies into one of its berserk rages, the Horned Reaper will cut down anything in its path between it and you - even the minions it has just summoned.
MON_HORNED_REAPER.description: A giant humanoid demon wielding a massive, heavy and sharp scythe.  Feared by foes and friends alike when it flies into one of its berserk rages, the Horned Reaper will cut down anything in its path between it and you - even the minions it has just summoned.

MON_BLACK_REAVER.name: Black reaver
MON_BLACK_REAVER.flavorText: A humanoid form,  black as night, advancing steadily and unstoppably, even the very rock of the dungeon cannot prevent it reaching you.
MON_BLACK_REAVER.description: A humanoid form,  black as night, advancing steadily and unstoppably, even the very rock of the dungeon cannot prevent it reaching you.

MON_MASTER_MINDCRAFTER.name: Master mindcrafter
MON_MASTER_MINDCRAFTER.flavorText: A mindcrafter of the highest order.  Powerful and evil, and a dangerous enemy: a master of mind over matter, of his own mind, and of the minds of others, who slavishly follow him into battle when he calls them.
MON_MASTER_MINDCRAFTER.description: A mindcrafter of the highest order.  Powerful and evil, and a dangerous enemy: a master of mind over matter, of his own mind, and of the minds of others, who slavishly follow him into battle when he calls them.

MON_GREATER_DEMONIC_QUYLTHULG.name: Greater demonic quylthulg
MON_GREATER_DEMONIC_QUYLTHULG.flavorText: A massive pulsating mound of flesh, glowing with an inner hellish light.
MON_GREATER_DEMONIC_QUYLTHULG.description: A massive pulsating mound of flesh, glowing with an inner hellish light.

MON_GREATER_DRACONIC_QUYLTHULG.name: Greater draconic quylthulg
MON_GREATER_DRACONIC_QUYLTHULG.flavorText: A massive mound of scaled flesh, throbbing and pulsating with multi-hued light.
MON_GREATER_DRACONIC_QUYLTHULG.description: A massive mound of scaled flesh, throbbing and pulsating with multi-hued light.

MON_GREATER_ROTTING_QUYLTHULG.name: Greater rotting quylthulg
MON_GREATER_ROTTING_QUYLTHULG.flavorText: A massive pile of rotting flesh. A disgusting stench fills the air as it throbs and writhes.
MON_GREATER_ROTTING_QUYLTHULG.description: A massive pile of rotting flesh. A disgusting stench fills the air as it throbs and writhes.

MON_FEAGWATH_THE_UNDEAD_SORCERER.name: Feagwath, the Undead Sorcerer
MON_FEAGWATH_THE_UNDEAD_SORCERER.flavorText: A stench of corruption and decay surrounds this sorcerer, who has clearly risen from the dead to continue his foul plots and schemes.
MON_FEAGWATH_THE_UNDEAD_SORCERER.description: A stench of corruption and decay surrounds this sorcerer, who has clearly risen from the dead to continue his foul plots and schemes.

MON_OMARAX_THE_EYE_TYRANT.name: Omarax the Eye Tyrant
MON_OMARAX_THE_EYE_TYRANT.flavorText: A beholder of great size and age, floating in the air.  His gaze seems to shred your soul and his spells crush your will.  He is ancient, his history steeped in forgotten evils, his atrocities numerous and sickening.
MON_OMARAX_THE_EYE_TYRANT.description: A beholder of great size and age, floating in the air.  His gaze seems to shred your soul and his spells crush your will.  He is ancient, his history steeped in forgotten evils, his atrocities numerous and sickening.

MON_GREATER_BALROG.name: Greater Balrog
MON_GREATER_BALROG.flavorText: Originally of the semi-divine Maiar, this evil spirit swore allegiance to Morgoth at the beginning of time and is now one of his most terrible demonic servants.  With its flaming whip and sword it seeks to destroy you.
MON_GREATER_BALROG.description: Originally of the semi-divine Maiar, this evil spirit swore allegiance to Morgoth at the beginning of time and is now one of his most terrible demonic servants.  With its flaming whip and sword it seeks to destroy you.

MON_UNGOLIANT_THE_UNLIGHT.name: Ungoliant, the Unlight
MON_UNGOLIANT_THE_UNLIGHT.flavorText: This enormous, hideous spirit of void is in the form of a spider of immense proportions.  She is surrounded by a cloud of Unlight as she sucks in all living light into her bloated body, and breathes out the blackest of darkness.  She is always ravenously hungry and would even eat herself to avoid starvation.
MON_UNGOLIANT_THE_UNLIGHT.description: This enormous, hideous spirit of void is in the form of a spider of immense proportions.  She is surrounded by a cloud of Unlight as she sucks in all living light into her bloated body, and breathes out the blackest of darkness.  She is always ravenously hungry and would even eat herself to avoid starvation.

MON_AETHER_HOUND.name: Aether hound
MON_AETHER_HOUND.flavorText: A shifting, swirling form. It seems to be all colours and sizes and shapes, though the dominant form is that of a huge dog. You feel very uncertain all of a sudden.
MON_AETHER_HOUND.description: A shifting, swirling form. It seems to be all colours and sizes and shapes, though the dominant form is that of a huge dog. You feel very uncertain all of a sudden.

MON_PIT_FIEND.name: Pit Fiend
MON_PIT_FIEND.flavorText: Appearing as a giant, clawed and winged humanoid with a scaly red body and massive fangs dripping a foul green liquid, the Pit Fiend is a dreadful enemy from the lowest depths of the hells.  They are often the commanders of vast demon armies.
MON_PIT_FIEND.description: Appearing as a giant, clawed and winged humanoid with a scaly red body and massive fangs dripping a foul green liquid, the Pit Fiend is a dreadful enemy from the lowest depths of the hells.  They are often the commanders of vast demon armies.

MON_THE_MOUTH_OF_SAURON.name: The Mouth of Sauron
MON_THE_MOUTH_OF_SAURON.flavorText: The Mouth of Sauron is a mighty spell caster. So old that even he cannot remember his own name, his power and evil are undeniable. He believes unshakeably that he is unbeatable and laughs as he weaves his awesome spells.
MON_THE_MOUTH_OF_SAURON.description: The Mouth of Sauron is a mighty spell caster. So old that even he cannot remember his own name, his power and evil are undeniable. He believes unshakeably that he is unbeatable and laughs as he weaves his awesome spells.

MON_THE_NECROMANCER_OF_DOL_GULDUR.name: The Necromancer of Dol Guldur
MON_THE_NECROMANCER_OF_DOL_GULDUR.flavorText: The dark master of the terrible fortress of southern Mirkwood.  It is rumoured that this is in fact none other than Sauron in disguise: although if this is so, he has yet to reveal his full power - and perhaps will not do so while his deception lasts, in the hope of keeping it going.
MON_THE_NECROMANCER_OF_DOL_GULDUR.description: The dark master of the terrible fortress of southern Mirkwood.  It is rumoured that this is in fact none other than Sauron in disguise: although if this is so, he has yet to reveal his full power - and perhaps will not do so while his deception lasts, in the hope of keeping it going.

MON_MASTER_QUYLTHULG.name: Master quylthulg
MON_MASTER_QUYLTHULG.flavorText: A giant seething mass of flesh, overwhelming you with monster after monster.
MON_MASTER_QUYLTHULG.description: A giant seething mass of flesh, overwhelming you with monster after monster.

MON_QLZQQLZUUP_THE_LORD_OF_FLESH.name: Qlzqqlzuup, the Lord of Flesh
MON_QLZQQLZUUP_THE_LORD_OF_FLESH.flavorText: A gigantic seething mass of flesh, Qlzqqlzuup changes colours in front of your eyes.  Pulsating first one colour then the next, it knows only it must bring help to protect itself.
MON_QLZQQLZUUP_THE_LORD_OF_FLESH.description: A gigantic seething mass of flesh, Qlzqqlzuup changes colours in front of your eyes.  Pulsating first one colour then the next, it knows only it must bring help to protect itself.

MON_FLARE_RIDER_OF_BRONZE_MOONTH.name: Flare, rider of bronze Moonth
MON_FLARE_RIDER_OF_BRONZE_MOONTH.flavorText: A leader from afar, he has come with his eagle to help you in your battle. Having already saved his home, he now wants to save Arda!
MON_FLARE_RIDER_OF_BRONZE_MOONTH.description: A leader from afar, he has come with his eagle to help you in your battle. Having already saved his home, he now wants to save Arda!

MON_MAEGLIN_THE_TRAITOR_OF_GONDOLIN.name: Maeglin, the Traitor of Gondolin
MON_MAEGLIN_THE_TRAITOR_OF_GONDOLIN.flavorText: The son of Eol the Dark Elf, Maeglin is every bit as evil as his father and more.  His greed for gold led him to betray the Hidden Kingdom of Gondolin to Morgoth's forces.  He is a mighty warrior himself, and some of Morgoth's greatest servants answer to his call.
MON_MAEGLIN_THE_TRAITOR_OF_GONDOLIN.description: The son of Eol the Dark Elf, Maeglin is every bit as evil as his father and more.  His greed for gold led him to betray the Hidden Kingdom of Gondolin to Morgoth's forces.  He is a mighty warrior himself, and some of Morgoth's greatest servants answer to his call.

MON_PAZUZU_LORD_OF_AIR.name: Pazuzu, Lord of Air
MON_PAZUZU_LORD_OF_AIR.flavorText: A winged humanoid demon from the Planes of Hell, Pazuzu grins inhumanely at you as he decides your fate.
MON_PAZUZU_LORD_OF_AIR.description: A winged humanoid demon from the Planes of Hell, Pazuzu grins inhumanely at you as he decides your fate.

MON_GREATER_HELLHOUND.name: Greater Hellhound
MON_GREATER_HELLHOUND.flavorText: It is a giant dog that glows with heat. Flames pour from its nostrils.
MON_GREATER_HELLHOUND.description: It is a giant dog that glows with heat. Flames pour from its nostrils.

MON_CANTORAS_THE_SKELETAL_LORD.name: Cantoras, the Skeletal Lord
MON_CANTORAS_THE_SKELETAL_LORD.flavorText: A legion of evil undead druj animating the skeleton of a once mighty sorcerer. His power is devastating and his speed unmatched in the underworld. Flee his wrath!
MON_CANTORAS_THE_SKELETAL_LORD.description: A legion of evil undead druj animating the skeleton of a once mighty sorcerer. His power is devastating and his speed unmatched in the underworld. Flee his wrath!

MON_GODZILLA.name: Godzilla
MON_GODZILLA.flavorText: Godzilla rose from the contaminated sea.  This terrible creature could level whole cities in anger.
MON_GODZILLA.description: Godzilla rose from the contaminated sea.  This terrible creature could level whole cities in anger.

MON_THE_TARRASQUE.name: The Tarrasque
MON_THE_TARRASQUE.flavorText: The Tarrasque is a massive reptile of legend, rumoured to be unkillable and immune to magic. Fear its anger, for its devastation is unmatched!
MON_THE_TARRASQUE.description: The Tarrasque is a massive reptile of legend, rumoured to be unkillable and immune to magic. Fear its anger, for its devastation is unmatched!

MON_LUNGORTHIN_THE_BALROG_OF_WHITE_FIRE.name: Lungorthin, the Balrog of White Fire
MON_LUNGORTHIN_THE_BALROG_OF_WHITE_FIRE.flavorText: A massive form cloaked in flame. Lungorthin stares balefully at you with eyes that smoulder red. The dungeon floor where he stands is scorched by the heat of his body.
MON_LUNGORTHIN_THE_BALROG_OF_WHITE_FIRE.description: A massive form cloaked in flame. Lungorthin stares balefully at you with eyes that smoulder red. The dungeon floor where he stands is scorched by the heat of his body.

MON_DRAUGLUIN_SIRE_OF_ALL_WEREWOLVES.name: Draugluin, Sire of All Werewolves
MON_DRAUGLUIN_SIRE_OF_ALL_WEREWOLVES.flavorText: Draugluin provides Sauron with a fearsome personal guard. He is an enormous wolf inhabited by a human spirit. He is chief of all his kind.
MON_DRAUGLUIN_SIRE_OF_ALL_WEREWOLVES.description: Draugluin provides Sauron with a fearsome personal guard. He is an enormous wolf inhabited by a human spirit. He is chief of all his kind.

MON_OREMORJ_THE_CYBERDEMON_LORD.name: Oremorj, the Cyberdemon Lord
MON_OREMORJ_THE_CYBERDEMON_LORD.flavorText: The mightiest of Cyberdemons, their lord and ruler.
MON_OREMORJ_THE_CYBERDEMON_LORD.description: The mightiest of Cyberdemons, their lord and ruler.

MON_VECNA_THE_EMPEROR_LICH.name: Vecna, the Emperor Lich
MON_VECNA_THE_EMPEROR_LICH.flavorText: The greatest of all undead sorcerers, even the gods once feared him.  This ancient shadow of death wilts every living thing it passes.
MON_VECNA_THE_EMPEROR_LICH.description: The greatest of all undead sorcerers, even the gods once feared him.  This ancient shadow of death wilts every living thing it passes.

MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_POWER.name: Great Wyrm of Power
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_POWER.flavorText: The mightiest of all dragonkind, a great wyrm of power is seldom encountered in our world. It can crush stars with its might.
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_POWER.description: The mightiest of all dragonkind, a great wyrm of power is seldom encountered in our world. It can crush stars with its might.

MON_CARCHAROTH_THE_JAWS_OF_THIRST.name: Carcharoth, the Jaws of Thirst
MON_CARCHAROTH_THE_JAWS_OF_THIRST.flavorText: The first guard of Angband, Carcharoth, also known as 'The Red Maw', is the largest wolf to ever walk the earth. He is highly intelligent and a deadly opponent in combat.
MON_CARCHAROTH_THE_JAWS_OF_THIRST.description: The first guard of Angband, Carcharoth, also known as 'The Red Maw', is the largest wolf to ever walk the earth. He is highly intelligent and a deadly opponent in combat.

MON_HUAN_WOLFHOUND_OF_THE_VALAR.name: Huan, Wolfhound of the Valar
MON_HUAN_WOLFHOUND_OF_THE_VALAR.flavorText: The wolfhound of the Valar, Huan has served many masters in his time, from Celegorm son of Feanor to Beren son of Barahir: but now he runs wild and acknowledges no master save himself, as he hunts alone for his nemesis - Carcharoth, the terrible wolf of Angband.
MON_HUAN_WOLFHOUND_OF_THE_VALAR.description: The wolfhound of the Valar, Huan has served many masters in his time, from Celegorm son of Feanor to Beren son of Barahir: but now he runs wild and acknowledges no master save himself, as he hunts alone for his nemesis - Carcharoth, the terrible wolf of Angband.

MON_GOTHMOG_THE_HIGH_CAPTAIN_OF_BALROGS.name: Gothmog, the High Captain of Balrogs
MON_GOTHMOG_THE_HIGH_CAPTAIN_OF_BALROGS.flavorText: Gothmog is the Chief Balrog in Morgoth's personal guard. He is renowned for slaying three High Kings of the Noldor Elves, and he has never been defeated in combat. With his whip of flame and awesome fiery breath he saved his master from Ungoliant's rage.
MON_GOTHMOG_THE_HIGH_CAPTAIN_OF_BALROGS.description: Gothmog is the Chief Balrog in Morgoth's personal guard. He is renowned for slaying three High Kings of the Noldor Elves, and he has never been defeated in combat. With his whip of flame and awesome fiery breath he saved his master from Ungoliant's rage.

MON_SARKO_RIDER_OF_GOLD_FORONTH.name: Sarko, rider of gold Foronth
MON_SARKO_RIDER_OF_GOLD_FORONTH.flavorText: Foronth is the first Eagle queen, and Sarko the first to discover the Firebirds, the ancestor of the Thunderlord eagles. She will try to help you!
MON_SARKO_RIDER_OF_GOLD_FORONTH.description: Foronth is the first Eagle queen, and Sarko the first to discover the Firebirds, the ancestor of the Thunderlord eagles. She will try to help you!

MON_SAURON_THE_SORCERER.name: Sauron, the Sorcerer
MON_SAURON_THE_SORCERER.flavorText: Mighty in spells and enchantments, he created the One Ring. His eyes glow with power and with his gaze he seeks to destroy your soul. He has many servants, and rarely fights without them.
MON_SAURON_THE_SORCERER.description: Mighty in spells and enchantments, he created the One Ring. His eyes glow with power and with his gaze he seeks to destroy your soul. He has many servants, and rarely fights without them.

MON_DARKGOD_THE_MIGHTY_CODER_OF_HELL.name: DarkGod, the Mighty Coder of Hell
MON_DARKGOD_THE_MIGHTY_CODER_OF_HELL.flavorText: He is the master of coding; none can match his skill. He created the Variant Maintainer, the RNGs, and the software bugs. Bull Gates is nothing next to him. Do not think that since he loves the novels of Tolkien he is to be ignored! He wishes to translate your soul into assembler, the one hitch being that he must kill you first. If you encounter him, pray your deity holds you in good stead.
MON_DARKGOD_THE_MIGHTY_CODER_OF_HELL.description: He is the master of coding; none can match his skill. He created the Variant Maintainer, the RNGs, and the software bugs. Bull Gates is nothing next to him. Do not think that since he loves the novels of Tolkien he is to be ignored! He wishes to translate your soul into assembler, the one hitch being that he must kill you first. If you encounter him, pray your deity holds you in good stead.

MON_MORGOTH_LORD_OF_DARKNESS.name: Morgoth, Lord of Darkness
MON_MORGOTH_LORD_OF_DARKNESS.flavorText: He was the most powerful of the Valar, the equal of Manwe. He is the Master of the Pits of Angband. His figure is like a black mountain crowned with Lightning. He rages with everlasting anger, his body scarred by Fingolfin's eight mighty wounds. He can never rest from his pain, but seeks forever to dominate all that is light and good in the world. He is the origin of man's fear of darkness and created many foul creatures with his evil powers. Orcs, Dragons, and Trolls are his most foul corruptions, causing much pain and suffering in the world to please him. His disgusting visage, twisted with evil, is crowned with iron, the two remaining Silmarils forever burning him. Grond, the mighty Hammer of the Underworld, cries defiance as he strides towards you to crush you to a pulp!
MON_MORGOTH_LORD_OF_DARKNESS.description: He was the most powerful of the Valar, the equal of Manwe. He is the Master of the Pits of Angband. His figure is like a black mountain crowned with Lightning. He rages with everlasting anger, his body scarred by Fingolfin's eight mighty wounds. He can never rest from his pain, but seeks forever to dominate all that is light and good in the world. He is the origin of man's fear of darkness and created many foul creatures with his evil powers. Orcs, Dragons, and Trolls are his most foul corruptions, causing much pain and suffering in the world to please him. His disgusting visage, twisted with evil, is crowned with iron, the two remaining Silmarils forever burning him. Grond, the mighty Hammer of the Underworld, cries defiance as he strides towards you to crush you to a pulp!

MON_HUMAN_WARRIOR.name: Human Warrior
MON_HUMAN_WARRIOR.flavorText: They are used as the main assault force of the human kings. They will help you in some quests.
MON_HUMAN_WARRIOR.description: They are used as the main assault force of the human kings. They will help you in some quests.

MON_ELVEN_ARCHER.name: Elven archer
MON_ELVEN_ARCHER.flavorText: They are used as the main assault force of the elven kings. They will help you in some quests.
MON_ELVEN_ARCHER.description: They are used as the main assault force of the elven kings. They will help you in some quests.

MON_DWARVEN_WARRIOR.name: Dwarven warrior
MON_DWARVEN_WARRIOR.flavorText: They are used as the main assault force of the dwarven kings. They will help you in some quests.
MON_DWARVEN_WARRIOR.description: They are used as the main assault force of the dwarven kings. They will help you in some quests.

MON_ELITE_URUK.name: Elite uruk
MON_ELITE_URUK.flavorText: It is a cunning orc of power, taller than a man, and stronger. It fears little.
MON_ELITE_URUK.description: It is a cunning orc of power, taller than a man, and stronger. It fears little.

MON_THE_PHILOSOPHY_TEACHER.name: The Philosophy Teacher
MON_THE_PHILOSOPHY_TEACHER.flavorText: She is a feared teacher, mistress of chaos and strangely minded. She wants to take your mind. Fear her and flee while you can.
MON_THE_PHILOSOPHY_TEACHER.description: She is a feared teacher, mistress of chaos and strangely minded. She wants to take your mind. Fear her and flee while you can.

MON_THE_VARIANT_MAINTAINER.name: The Variant Maintainer
MON_THE_VARIANT_MAINTAINER.flavorText: A deranged programmer, scattering bizarre ideas and bad code everywhere.
MON_THE_VARIANT_MAINTAINER.description: A deranged programmer, scattering bizarre ideas and bad code everywhere.

MON_RANDOM_NUMBER_GENERATOR.name: Random Number Generator
MON_RANDOM_NUMBER_GENERATOR.flavorText: A feared creation of the Variant Maintainer, it tries to generate Morgoth in the town and the One Ring in the magic shop.
MON_RANDOM_NUMBER_GENERATOR.description: A feared creation of the Variant Maintainer, it tries to generate Morgoth in the town and the One Ring in the magic shop.

MON_ROCKET_MINE.name: Rocket mine
MON_ROCKET_MINE.flavorText: It was left here to be used against intruders.
MON_ROCKET_MINE.description: It was left here to be used against intruders.

MON_BOUNCING_MINE.name: Bouncing mine
MON_BOUNCING_MINE.flavorText: It was left here to be used against intruders.
MON_BOUNCING_MINE.description: It was left here to be used against intruders.

MON_DURIN_S_BANE.name: Durin's Bane
MON_DURIN_S_BANE.flavorText: A huge Balrog surrounded by raging pillars of fire, this is indeed a terrible opponent. Wielding a great whip of fire and a blazing sword, his fury blisters your skin and melts your flesh!
MON_DURIN_S_BANE.description: A huge Balrog surrounded by raging pillars of fire, this is indeed a terrible opponent. Wielding a great whip of fire and a blazing sword, his fury blisters your skin and melts your flesh!

MON_THE_ICKY_QUEEN.name: The Icky Queen
MON_THE_ICKY_QUEEN.flavorText: And you thought her offspring were icky!
MON_THE_ICKY_QUEEN.description: And you thought her offspring were icky!

MON_ROT_JELLY.name: Rot jelly
MON_ROT_JELLY.flavorText: It is a large pile of rotting flesh, whose touch spoils your food.  The terrible smell it exudes is also very hard to get rid of...
MON_ROT_JELLY.description: It is a large pile of rotting flesh, whose touch spoils your food.  The terrible smell it exudes is also very hard to get rid of...

MON_DEATH.name: Death
MON_DEATH.flavorText: "And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth."
MON_DEATH.description: "And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth."

MON_FAMINE.name: Famine
MON_FAMINE.flavorText: One of the horsemen of the apocalypse, before you lies Famine. A figure so gaunt that the shape of the bones beneath are revealed, Famine rides a pale grey mare that appears near death.
MON_FAMINE.description: One of the horsemen of the apocalypse, before you lies Famine. A figure so gaunt that the shape of the bones beneath are revealed, Famine rides a pale grey mare that appears near death.

MON_PESTILENCE.name: Pestilence
MON_PESTILENCE.flavorText: One of the horsemen of the apocalypse, before you lies Pestilence. At first, it looks like a human, but then you notice ants, worms, and worse peeking out of the flesh. Pestilence rides a purple horse with skin that bulges and occasionally gives hints of the vermin within.
MON_PESTILENCE.description: One of the horsemen of the apocalypse, before you lies Pestilence. At first, it looks like a human, but then you notice ants, worms, and worse peeking out of the flesh. Pestilence rides a purple horse with skin that bulges and occasionally gives hints of the vermin within.

MON_WAR.name: War
MON_WAR.flavorText: One of the horsemen of the apocalypse, before you lies War. A healthy and hearty warrior, War grins a little too wide at you as he prepares for combat. War rides a large well-groomed yellow horse that leaves behind puddles of blood where its hooves touch the ground.
MON_WAR.description: One of the horsemen of the apocalypse, before you lies War. A healthy and hearty warrior, War grins a little too wide at you as he prepares for combat. War rides a large well-groomed yellow horse that leaves behind puddles of blood where its hooves touch the ground.

MON_PIKE.name: Pike
MON_PIKE.flavorText: It's a common fresh-water predatory fish.
MON_PIKE.description: It's a common fresh-water predatory fish.

MON_ELECTRIC_EEL.name: Electric eel
MON_ELECTRIC_EEL.flavorText: This serpentine creature can create a deadly voltage.  Better watch out!
MON_ELECTRIC_EEL.description: This serpentine creature can create a deadly voltage.  Better watch out!

MON_GIANT_CRAYFISH.name: Giant crayfish
MON_GIANT_CRAYFISH.flavorText: A man-sized, heavily armoured fresh-water relative of the lobster.
MON_GIANT_CRAYFISH.description: A man-sized, heavily armoured fresh-water relative of the lobster.

MON_BOX_JELLYFISH.name: Box jellyfish
MON_BOX_JELLYFISH.flavorText: A strange water creature, whose touch can be deadly.
MON_BOX_JELLYFISH.description: A strange water creature, whose touch can be deadly.

MON_GIANT_PIRANHA.name: Giant piranha
MON_GIANT_PIRANHA.flavorText: A very large and bloodthirsty fish.
MON_GIANT_PIRANHA.description: A very large and bloodthirsty fish.

MON_PIRANHA.name: Piranha
MON_PIRANHA.flavorText: Bloodthirsty fish who can smell your blood from a great distance.
MON_PIRANHA.description: Bloodthirsty fish who can smell your blood from a great distance.

MON_BULLYWUG.name: Bullywug
MON_BULLYWUG.flavorText: A vaguely humanoid creature, it looks like a cross between a hobbit and a frog.
MON_BULLYWUG.description: A vaguely humanoid creature, it looks like a cross between a hobbit and a frog.

MON_BULLYWUG_WARRIOR.name: Bullywug warrior
MON_BULLYWUG_WARRIOR.flavorText: A member of the frog-people clan. He is wielding a long, sharp shark tooth.
MON_BULLYWUG_WARRIOR.description: A member of the frog-people clan. He is wielding a long, sharp shark tooth.

MON_BULLYWUG_SHAMAN.name: Bullywug shaman
MON_BULLYWUG_SHAMAN.flavorText: A leader of a clan of frog-people, he is cloaked in a cloak made of shark skin.
MON_BULLYWUG_SHAMAN.description: A leader of a clan of frog-people, he is cloaked in a cloak made of shark skin.

MON_WHALE.name: Whale
MON_WHALE.flavorText: Although it looks like a fish and lives in water, it is in fact a mammal. And it is huge!
MON_WHALE.description: Although it looks like a fish and lives in water, it is in fact a mammal. And it is huge!

MON_SAND_MITE.name: Sand mite
MON_SAND_MITE.flavorText: A relative of crabs and shrimp, this is a tiny creature that inhabits sandy bottoms. It has a pair of dangerous-looking claws.
MON_SAND_MITE.description: A relative of crabs and shrimp, this is a tiny creature that inhabits sandy bottoms. It has a pair of dangerous-looking claws.

MON_OCTOPUS.name: Octopus
MON_OCTOPUS.flavorText: It doesn't move very fast, but when it does - watch out!
MON_OCTOPUS.description: It doesn't move very fast, but when it does - watch out!

MON_GIANT_OCTOPUS.name: Giant octopus
MON_GIANT_OCTOPUS.flavorText: A cunning and dangerous undersea opponent.
MON_GIANT_OCTOPUS.description: A cunning and dangerous undersea opponent.

MON_EYE_OF_THE_DEEP.name: Eye of the deep
MON_EYE_OF_THE_DEEP.flavorText: A beholder that inhabits the depths of the sea, sleeping and pondering alien thoughts for centuries. Occasionally, it will float to the surface to wreck the lives of surface dwellers.
MON_EYE_OF_THE_DEEP.description: A beholder that inhabits the depths of the sea, sleeping and pondering alien thoughts for centuries. Occasionally, it will float to the surface to wreck the lives of surface dwellers.

MON_MURK_DWELLER.name: Murk dweller
MON_MURK_DWELLER.flavorText: A gigantic aquatic monster, somewhat resembling a cross between a lobster and a spider. It is coated in poisonous slime and noxious parasites. This foul creature hides in the silt of the deep ocean floor, waiting to trap unsuspecting prey.
MON_MURK_DWELLER.description: A gigantic aquatic monster, somewhat resembling a cross between a lobster and a spider. It is coated in poisonous slime and noxious parasites. This foul creature hides in the silt of the deep ocean floor, waiting to trap unsuspecting prey.

MON_DROWNED_SOUL.name: Drowned soul
MON_DROWNED_SOUL.flavorText: A ghastly victim of drowning, forever doomed to wander the ocean waters looking for revenge.
MON_DROWNED_SOUL.description: A ghastly victim of drowning, forever doomed to wander the ocean waters looking for revenge.

MON_TIGER_SHARK.name: Tiger shark
MON_TIGER_SHARK.flavorText: A small species of shark, although the teeth are still as deadly.
MON_TIGER_SHARK.description: A small species of shark, although the teeth are still as deadly.

MON_HAMMERHEAD_SHARK.name: Hammerhead shark
MON_HAMMERHEAD_SHARK.flavorText: A hungry shark with a strange head.
MON_HAMMERHEAD_SHARK.description: A hungry shark with a strange head.

MON_AQUATIC_GOLEM.name: Aquatic golem
MON_AQUATIC_GOLEM.flavorText: An ingenious gnomish invention -- a golem designed for underwater usage.
MON_AQUATIC_GOLEM.description: An ingenious gnomish invention -- a golem designed for underwater usage.

MON_AQUATIC_KOBOLD.name: Aquatic kobold
MON_AQUATIC_KOBOLD.flavorText: Yes, your favourite denizen of evil also comes in an aquatic variety.
MON_AQUATIC_KOBOLD.description: Yes, your favourite denizen of evil also comes in an aquatic variety.

MON_WHITE_SHARK.name: White shark
MON_WHITE_SHARK.flavorText: A fast-moving hunter of the depths. When this creature moves, everybody in the water is in danger!
MON_WHITE_SHARK.description: A fast-moving hunter of the depths. When this creature moves, everybody in the water is in danger!

MON_SCRAG.name: Scrag
MON_SCRAG.flavorText: A troll of the sea, he reeks of brine.
MON_SCRAG.description: A troll of the sea, he reeks of brine.

MON_STARGAZER.name: Stargazer
MON_STARGAZER.flavorText: A giant fish shaped like a flounder. There are two enormous eyes occupying half of the creature's body.
MON_STARGAZER.description: A giant fish shaped like a flounder. There are two enormous eyes occupying half of the creature's body.

MON_ELDER_STARGAZER.name: Elder stargazer
MON_ELDER_STARGAZER.flavorText: A stargazer a bit larger than average, covered with barnacles.
MON_ELDER_STARGAZER.description: A stargazer a bit larger than average, covered with barnacles.

MON_FLOUNDER.name: Flounder
MON_FLOUNDER.flavorText: A flattened fish which is able to change body colouring for camouflage.
MON_FLOUNDER.description: A flattened fish which is able to change body colouring for camouflage.

MON_GIANT_TURTLE.name: Giant turtle
MON_GIANT_TURTLE.flavorText: A giant turtle with flippers, adapted for life in the ocean.
MON_GIANT_TURTLE.description: A giant turtle with flippers, adapted for life in the ocean.

MON_BABY_DRAGON_TURTLE.name: Baby dragon turtle
MON_BABY_DRAGON_TURTLE.flavorText: A newly-hatched dragon turtle. It still hasn't grown a proper shell.
MON_BABY_DRAGON_TURTLE.description: A newly-hatched dragon turtle. It still hasn't grown a proper shell.

MON_YOUNG_DRAGON_TURTLE.name: Young dragon turtle
MON_YOUNG_DRAGON_TURTLE.flavorText: A dragon-like creature inhabiting lightless reaches of ocean caves. It has a long neck with a tiny head, and four massive flippers. It has a soft and flexible shell.
MON_YOUNG_DRAGON_TURTLE.description: A dragon-like creature inhabiting lightless reaches of ocean caves. It has a long neck with a tiny head, and four massive flippers. It has a soft and flexible shell.

MON_MATURE_DRAGON_TURTLE.name: Mature dragon turtle
MON_MATURE_DRAGON_TURTLE.flavorText: A large dragon turtle, covered with a tough white shell.
MON_MATURE_DRAGON_TURTLE.description: A large dragon turtle, covered with a tough white shell.

MON_ANCIENT_DRAGON_TURTLE.name: Ancient dragon turtle
MON_ANCIENT_DRAGON_TURTLE.flavorText: A huge dragon turtle. You can see many barnacles covering its body.
MON_ANCIENT_DRAGON_TURTLE.description: A huge dragon turtle. You can see many barnacles covering its body.

MON_FASTITOCALON.name: Fastitocalon
MON_FASTITOCALON.flavorText: A huge aquatic dragon-turtle, its shell is as large as a small island.
MON_FASTITOCALON.description: A huge aquatic dragon-turtle, its shell is as large as a small island.

MON_UNDEAD_STARGAZER.name: Undead stargazer
MON_UNDEAD_STARGAZER.flavorText: A stargazer brought back from the dead under control of some unholy sorceror.
MON_UNDEAD_STARGAZER.description: A stargazer brought back from the dead under control of some unholy sorceror.

MON_MERROW.name: Merrow
MON_MERROW.flavorText: A great ogre of the sea, it is violent and stupid.
MON_MERROW.description: A great ogre of the sea, it is violent and stupid.

MON_WATER_NAGA.name: Water naga
MON_WATER_NAGA.flavorText: A naga adapted to underwater life. She has a fish-like tail and a pair of gills.
MON_WATER_NAGA.description: A naga adapted to underwater life. She has a fish-like tail and a pair of gills.

MON_MOBY_DICK_THE_WHITE_WHALE.name: Moby Dick, the White Whale
MON_MOBY_DICK_THE_WHITE_WHALE.flavorText: The mightiest whale of the seas, he has sunk many ships in his time. With a mere flick of his tail he can create a mighty whirlpool, to the ruin of all who would travel the ocean.
MON_MOBY_DICK_THE_WHITE_WHALE.description: The mightiest whale of the seas, he has sunk many ships in his time. With a mere flick of his tail he can create a mighty whirlpool, to the ruin of all who would travel the ocean.

MON_AQUATIC_HOUND.name: Aquatic hound
MON_AQUATIC_HOUND.flavorText: A dog with a finned tail and large, muscular flippers for hind legs. It has a rubbery skin instead of fur.
MON_AQUATIC_HOUND.description: A dog with a finned tail and large, muscular flippers for hind legs. It has a rubbery skin instead of fur.

MON_WATER_DEMON.name: Water demon
MON_WATER_DEMON.flavorText: A hideous scaled demon, it is a sleek form with many fins but no visible arms or legs. It has a toothed gaping maw, reminiscent of a caricature of a shark's jaws.
MON_WATER_DEMON.description: A hideous scaled demon, it is a sleek form with many fins but no visible arms or legs. It has a toothed gaping maw, reminiscent of a caricature of a shark's jaws.

MON_IXITXACHITL.name: Ixitxachitl
MON_IXITXACHITL.flavorText: An intelligent devil-ray of the depths.
MON_IXITXACHITL.description: An intelligent devil-ray of the depths.

MON_IXITXACHITL_PRIEST.name: Ixitxachitl priest
MON_IXITXACHITL_PRIEST.flavorText: A devil-ray of the depths, with priestly magic.
MON_IXITXACHITL_PRIEST.description: A devil-ray of the depths, with priestly magic.

MON_VAMPIRIC_IXITXACHITL.name: Vampiric ixitxachitl
MON_VAMPIRIC_IXITXACHITL.flavorText: A devil-ray of the depths, with vampiric powers.
MON_VAMPIRIC_IXITXACHITL.description: A devil-ray of the depths, with vampiric powers.

MON_MATHILDE_THE_SCIENCE_STUDENT.name: Mathilde, the Science Student
MON_MATHILDE_THE_SCIENCE_STUDENT.flavorText: She loves joking, and she's constantly giggling. A very happy girl. Beware, it is rumoured that Dark God has put a mighty curse on her.
MON_MATHILDE_THE_SCIENCE_STUDENT.description: She loves joking, and she's constantly giggling. A very happy girl. Beware, it is rumoured that Dark God has put a mighty curse on her.

MON_CHILD_SPIRIT.name: Child spirit
MON_CHILD_SPIRIT.flavorText: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.
MON_CHILD_SPIRIT.description: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.

MON_YOUNG_SPIRIT.name: Young spirit
MON_YOUNG_SPIRIT.flavorText: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.
MON_YOUNG_SPIRIT.description: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.

MON_MATURE_SPIRIT.name: Mature spirit
MON_MATURE_SPIRIT.flavorText: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.
MON_MATURE_SPIRIT.description: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.

MON_EXPERIENCED_SPIRIT.name: Experienced spirit
MON_EXPERIENCED_SPIRIT.flavorText: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.
MON_EXPERIENCED_SPIRIT.description: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.

MON_WISE_SPIRIT.name: Wise spirit
MON_WISE_SPIRIT.flavorText: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.
MON_WISE_SPIRIT.description: A helpful spirit from beyond the grave.

MON_FANGORN_THE_TREEBEARD_LORD_OF_THE_EN.name: Fangorn the Treebeard, Lord of the Ents
