MON_FANGORN_THE_TREEBEARD_LORD_OF_THE_EN.flavorText: The first being to awoke on Arda, apart from the Valar themselves.  He is the first, oldest, greatest and most respected of all the Ents:  and though he is slow to anger, he is a terrible foe when roused.
MON_FANGORN_THE_TREEBEARD_LORD_OF_THE_EN.description: The first being to awoke on Arda, apart from the Valar themselves.  He is the first, oldest, greatest and most respected of all the Ents:  and though he is slow to anger, he is a terrible foe when roused.

MON_GANDALF_THE_GREY.name: Gandalf the Grey
MON_GANDALF_THE_GREY.flavorText: The wizard who opposed Sauron and, in the end, was the only one of the Istari to succeed in his task. Gandalf is very wise and specialises in fire magic.
MON_GANDALF_THE_GREY.description: The wizard who opposed Sauron and, in the end, was the only one of the Istari to succeed in his task. Gandalf is very wise and specialises in fire magic.

MON_NAR_THE_DWARF.name: Nar, the Dwarf
MON_NAR_THE_DWARF.flavorText: The friend and companion of the dwarven king Thror, he went mad with grief after Thror's death at the hands of Azog the Orc.  With torn beard and ragged clothes, he seems to have fixed on you as a convenient target to vent his anger.
MON_NAR_THE_DWARF.description: The friend and companion of the dwarven king Thror, he went mad with grief after Thror's death at the hands of Azog the Orc.  With torn beard and ragged clothes, he seems to have fixed on you as a convenient target to vent his anger.

MON_NOVICE_MINDCRAFTER.name: Novice mindcrafter
MON_NOVICE_MINDCRAFTER.flavorText: A novice in the arts of mind over matter.
MON_NOVICE_MINDCRAFTER.description: A novice in the arts of mind over matter.

MON_GREAT_SWAMP_WYRM.name: Great Swamp Wyrm
MON_GREAT_SWAMP_WYRM.flavorText: A truly enormous dragon with great powers.  The foul gases issuing from the beast nearly make you vomit; and while you may try to hold your breath as you fight it, it sees no reason to do likewise.
MON_GREAT_SWAMP_WYRM.description: A truly enormous dragon with great powers.  The foul gases issuing from the beast nearly make you vomit; and while you may try to hold your breath as you fight it, it sees no reason to do likewise.

MON_GREAT_BILE_WYRM.name: Great Bile Wyrm
MON_GREAT_BILE_WYRM.flavorText: A huge and very powerful dragon.  Great steaming pools of acid drip from its form onto the ground.  You shudder when you see the acid eating away the very stones of the dungeon - what could it do to you?
MON_GREAT_BILE_WYRM.description: A huge and very powerful dragon.  Great steaming pools of acid drip from its form onto the ground.  You shudder when you see the acid eating away the very stones of the dungeon - what could it do to you?

MON_BLUE_FIREBIRD.name: Blue Firebird
MON_BLUE_FIREBIRD.flavorText: The ancestors of the Eagles of the Thunderlords, these are friendly funny flying creatures with power.
MON_BLUE_FIREBIRD.description: The ancestors of the Eagles of the Thunderlords, these are friendly funny flying creatures with power.

MON_GREEN_FIREBIRD.name: Green Firebird
MON_GREEN_FIREBIRD.flavorText: The ancestors of the Eagles of the Thunderlords, these are friendly funny flying creatures with power.
MON_GREEN_FIREBIRD.description: The ancestors of the Eagles of the Thunderlords, these are friendly funny flying creatures with power.

MON_BROWN_FIREBIRD.name: Brown Firebird
MON_BROWN_FIREBIRD.flavorText: The ancestors of the Eagles of the Thunderlords, these are friendly funny flying creatures with power.
MON_BROWN_FIREBIRD.description: The ancestors of the Eagles of the Thunderlords, these are friendly funny flying creatures with power.

MON_BRONZE_FIREBIRD.name: Bronze Firebird
MON_BRONZE_FIREBIRD.flavorText: The ancestors of the Eagles of the Thunderlords, these are friendly funny flying creatures with power.
MON_BRONZE_FIREBIRD.description: The ancestors of the Eagles of the Thunderlords, these are friendly funny flying creatures with power.

MON_GOLD_FIREBIRD.name: Gold Firebird
MON_GOLD_FIREBIRD.flavorText: The ancestors of the Eagles of the Thunderlords, these are friendly funny flying creatures with power.
MON_GOLD_FIREBIRD.description: The ancestors of the Eagles of the Thunderlords, these are friendly funny flying creatures with power.

MON_HIGH_ELVEN_RANGER.name: High-elven ranger
MON_HIGH_ELVEN_RANGER.flavorText: An elf cloaked in green wielding a longbow.
MON_HIGH_ELVEN_RANGER.description: An elf cloaked in green wielding a longbow.

MON_UVATHA_THE_HORSEMAN.name: Uvatha the Horseman
MON_UVATHA_THE_HORSEMAN.flavorText: A tall black Ringwraith, he is a master of horsemanship. He longs to taste your blood.
MON_UVATHA_THE_HORSEMAN.description: A tall black Ringwraith, he is a master of horsemanship. He longs to taste your blood.

MON_ADUNAPHEL_THE_QUIET.name: Adunaphel the Quiet
MON_ADUNAPHEL_THE_QUIET.flavorText: A sorceress in life, Adunaphel quickly fell under Sauron's sway and the power of the rings.
MON_ADUNAPHEL_THE_QUIET.description: A sorceress in life, Adunaphel quickly fell under Sauron's sway and the power of the rings.

MON_AKHORAHIL_THE_BLIND.name: Akhorahil the Blind
MON_AKHORAHIL_THE_BLIND.flavorText: A mighty sorcerer king, Akhorahil was blind in life. With powerful enchantments, he created jewelled eyes that enabled him to see better than any ordinary man ever could.
MON_AKHORAHIL_THE_BLIND.description: A mighty sorcerer king, Akhorahil was blind in life. With powerful enchantments, he created jewelled eyes that enabled him to see better than any ordinary man ever could.

MON_REN_THE_UNCLEAN.name: Ren the Unclean
MON_REN_THE_UNCLEAN.flavorText: Ren was an insane eastern king who believed himself to be the son of a volcano god. At an early age his sanity was destroyed by a plague that wiped out his family, and he never recovered.
MON_REN_THE_UNCLEAN.description: Ren was an insane eastern king who believed himself to be the son of a volcano god. At an early age his sanity was destroyed by a plague that wiped out his family, and he never recovered.

MON_JI_INDUR_DAWNDEATH.name: Ji Indur Dawndeath
MON_JI_INDUR_DAWNDEATH.flavorText: This Ringwraith was a weak-minded sorcerer-king who fell easily under Sauron's power.
MON_JI_INDUR_DAWNDEATH.description: This Ringwraith was a weak-minded sorcerer-king who fell easily under Sauron's power.

MON_DWAR_DOG_LORD_OF_WAW.name: Dwar, Dog Lord of Waw
MON_DWAR_DOG_LORD_OF_WAW.flavorText: Dwar had a special affinity for dogs in life, and can still command them at will. He howls manically as he reaches out to destroy you.
MON_DWAR_DOG_LORD_OF_WAW.description: Dwar had a special affinity for dogs in life, and can still command them at will. He howls manically as he reaches out to destroy you.

MON_HOARMURATH_OF_DIR.name: Hoarmurath of Dir
MON_HOARMURATH_OF_DIR.flavorText: A Ringwraith powerful in fell sorcery, he yearns for the life he has exchanged for an unlife of everlasting torment.
MON_HOARMURATH_OF_DIR.description: A Ringwraith powerful in fell sorcery, he yearns for the life he has exchanged for an unlife of everlasting torment.

MON_KHAMUL_THE_BLACK_EASTERLING.name: Khamul, the Black Easterling
MON_KHAMUL_THE_BLACK_EASTERLING.flavorText: He was the warrior-king of the East, now a Ringwraith. Khamul is a powerful opponent, his skill in combat awesome and his form twisted by evil cunning.
MON_KHAMUL_THE_BLACK_EASTERLING.description: He was the warrior-king of the East, now a Ringwraith. Khamul is a powerful opponent, his skill in combat awesome and his form twisted by evil cunning.

MON_THE_WITCH_KING_OF_ANGMAR.name: The Witch-King of Angmar
MON_THE_WITCH_KING_OF_ANGMAR.flavorText: The Chief of the Ringwraiths. A fell being of devastating power, his spells are lethal and his combat blows crushingly hard. He moves at speed, and commands legions of evil to do his bidding. It is said that he is fated never to die by the hand of mortal man.
MON_THE_WITCH_KING_OF_ANGMAR.description: The Chief of the Ringwraiths. A fell being of devastating power, his spells are lethal and his combat blows crushingly hard. He moves at speed, and commands legions of evil to do his bidding. It is said that he is fated never to die by the hand of mortal man.

MON_GREEN_THUNDERLORD.name: Green Thunderlord
MON_GREEN_THUNDERLORD.flavorText: A Thunderlord. Among the weaker breeds, but still dangerous.
MON_GREEN_THUNDERLORD.description: A Thunderlord. Among the weaker breeds, but still dangerous.

MON_BLUE_THUNDERLORD.name: Blue Thunderlord
MON_BLUE_THUNDERLORD.flavorText: A Thunderlord. Among the weaker breeds, but still dangerous.
MON_BLUE_THUNDERLORD.description: A Thunderlord. Among the weaker breeds, but still dangerous.

MON_BRONZE_THUNDERLORD.name: Bronze Thunderlord
MON_BRONZE_THUNDERLORD.flavorText: A Thunderlord, mightiest among the males.
MON_BRONZE_THUNDERLORD.description: A Thunderlord, mightiest among the males.

MON_GOLD_THUNDERLORD.name: Gold Thunderlord
MON_GOLD_THUNDERLORD.flavorText: A Thunderlord, among the queens of their kind.
MON_GOLD_THUNDERLORD.description: A Thunderlord, among the queens of their kind.

MON_BLOOD_SPROUT.name: Blood Sprout
MON_BLOOD_SPROUT.flavorText: A kind of giant mycorrhiza, corrupted into a carnivore by Morgoth.
MON_BLOOD_SPROUT.description: A kind of giant mycorrhiza, corrupted into a carnivore by Morgoth.

MON_GORLIM_BETRAYER_OF_BARAHIR.name: Gorlim, Betrayer of Barahir
MON_GORLIM_BETRAYER_OF_BARAHIR.flavorText: This sad creature - once a mighty warrior - betrayed his former friends to Morgoth's army in return for, he thought, safety for himself and his wife. And so he fell under Morgoth's power and became little more than a mindless servant of evil, even though the other side of his "bargain" was not kept.
MON_GORLIM_BETRAYER_OF_BARAHIR.description: This sad creature - once a mighty warrior - betrayed his former friends to Morgoth's army in return for, he thought, safety for himself and his wife. And so he fell under Morgoth's power and became little more than a mindless servant of evil, even though the other side of his "bargain" was not kept.

MON_THE_BLUBBERING_IDIOT_AGENT_OF_BLACK_.name: The Blubbering idiot, agent of black market, Simon the weak
MON_THE_BLUBBERING_IDIOT_AGENT_OF_BLACK_.flavorText: He tends to blubber a lot, he was a simple blubbering idiot before he lost himself in the dungeon and fell under Morgoth's will. Now he is a mindless servant of Morgoth. Destroy him - if you can...
MON_THE_BLUBBERING_IDIOT_AGENT_OF_BLACK_.description: He tends to blubber a lot, he was a simple blubbering idiot before he lost himself in the dungeon and fell under Morgoth's will. Now he is a mindless servant of Morgoth. Destroy him - if you can...

MON_ARANEA.name: Aranea
MON_ARANEA.flavorText: A red arachnid with legs weaving spells in the air.
MON_ARANEA.description: A red arachnid with legs weaving spells in the air.

MON_ELDER_ARANEA.name: Elder aranea
MON_ELDER_ARANEA.flavorText: A vast, bloated arachnid, master of its brood: among the more terrible of Ungoliant's descendants, this is a monster such as those who haunted the dread valley of Nan Dungortheb long ago.
MON_ELDER_ARANEA.description: A vast, bloated arachnid, master of its brood: among the more terrible of Ungoliant's descendants, this is a monster such as those who haunted the dread valley of Nan Dungortheb long ago.

MON_GIANT_BROWN_TICK.name: Giant brown tick
MON_GIANT_BROWN_TICK.flavorText: It is moving slowly towards you.
MON_GIANT_BROWN_TICK.description: It is moving slowly towards you.

MON_WAVELORD.name: Wavelord
MON_WAVELORD.flavorText: The Dolphiners came with the Thunderlords from their far home. These friendly beings ride their sharks into combat to assist you.
MON_WAVELORD.description: The Dolphiners came with the Thunderlords from their far home. These friendly beings ride their sharks into combat to assist you.

MON_NOVICE_POSSESSOR_SOUL.name: Novice possessor (soul)
MON_NOVICE_POSSESSOR_SOUL.flavorText: It does not look that powerful.
MON_NOVICE_POSSESSOR_SOUL.description: It does not look that powerful.

MON_BAT_OF_GORGOROTH.name: Bat of Gorgoroth
MON_BAT_OF_GORGOROTH.flavorText: Fed with horrid meats and grown to enormous size, this slavering creature seeks livelier prey.
MON_BAT_OF_GORGOROTH.description: Fed with horrid meats and grown to enormous size, this slavering creature seeks livelier prey.

MON_THE_PRINCESS.name: The Princess
MON_THE_PRINCESS.flavorText: The princess of an unknown kingdom, you need to save her!
MON_THE_PRINCESS.description: The princess of an unknown kingdom, you need to save her!

MON_MERTON_PROUDFOOT_THE_LOST_HOBBIT.name: Merton Proudfoot, the lost hobbit
MON_MERTON_PROUDFOOT_THE_LOST_HOBBIT.flavorText: The poor hobbit got lost in the dreadful maze!
MON_MERTON_PROUDFOOT_THE_LOST_HOBBIT.description: The poor hobbit got lost in the dreadful maze!

MON_THE_WIGHT_KING_OF_THE_BARROW_DOWNS.name: The Wight-King of the Barrow-downs
MON_THE_WIGHT_KING_OF_THE_BARROW_DOWNS.flavorText: He has lived in the Barrow-Downs for centuries after his first death at the hands of the Witch-King of Angmar.  A once loyal captain under the Witch-King's command, he now awaits a time when his undead forces shall rise again to avenge their deaths.
MON_THE_WIGHT_KING_OF_THE_BARROW_DOWNS.description: He has lived in the Barrow-Downs for centuries after his first death at the hands of the Witch-King of Angmar.  A once loyal captain under the Witch-King's command, he now awaits a time when his undead forces shall rise again to avenge their deaths.

MON_EXPERIENCED_POSSESSOR_SOUL.name: Experienced possessor (soul)
MON_EXPERIENCED_POSSESSOR_SOUL.flavorText: It does not look that powerful.
MON_EXPERIENCED_POSSESSOR_SOUL.description: It does not look that powerful.

MON_OLD_POSSESSOR_SOUL.name: Old possessor (soul)
MON_OLD_POSSESSOR_SOUL.flavorText: It does not look that powerful.
MON_OLD_POSSESSOR_SOUL.description: It does not look that powerful.

MON_BRONZE_DRAGON_WORM.name: Bronze dragon worm
MON_BRONZE_DRAGON_WORM.flavorText: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Its scales glitter in a multitude of perplexing and distracting ways.
MON_BRONZE_DRAGON_WORM.description: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Its scales glitter in a multitude of perplexing and distracting ways.

MON_GOLD_DRAGON_WORM.name: Gold dragon worm
MON_GOLD_DRAGON_WORM.flavorText: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. You can feel the air itself vibrating as you near it.
MON_GOLD_DRAGON_WORM.description: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. You can feel the air itself vibrating as you near it.

MON_MOLDOUX_THE_DEFENCELESS_MOLD.name: Moldoux, the Defenceless Mold
MON_MOLDOUX_THE_DEFENCELESS_MOLD.flavorText: A small strange growth. It seems to be defenceless...
MON_MOLDOUX_THE_DEFENCELESS_MOLD.description: A small strange growth. It seems to be defenceless...

MON_THE_PHYSICS_TEACHER.name: The Physics Teacher
MON_THE_PHYSICS_TEACHER.flavorText: A keeper of forbidden wisdom, this Teacher bombards you with his mastery over elements of matter.
MON_THE_PHYSICS_TEACHER.description: A keeper of forbidden wisdom, this Teacher bombards you with his mastery over elements of matter.

MON_AR_PHARAZON_THE_GOLDEN.name: Ar-Pharazon the Golden
MON_AR_PHARAZON_THE_GOLDEN.flavorText: Last and proudest king of ancient Numenor. Corrupted by power and avarice, he fell victim to Sauron's wiles, tried to fight the immortals themselves, and condemned Numenor to oblivion.
MON_AR_PHARAZON_THE_GOLDEN.description: Last and proudest king of ancient Numenor. Corrupted by power and avarice, he fell victim to Sauron's wiles, tried to fight the immortals themselves, and condemned Numenor to oblivion.

MON_MARYLENE_HEARTBREAKERESS_OF_THE_NETH.name: Marylene, Heartbreakeress of the Netherworld
MON_MARYLENE_HEARTBREAKERESS_OF_THE_NETH.flavorText: A woman of mind-shattering beauty, none can match her beauty. She is perfect, and totally evil. She loves nothing but herself and her evil is as great as her beauty. No one can stand against her, even DarkGod. As you see her approaching, you feel your heart breaking. She is the perfection, don't even try against her; you will surely lose your mind...
MON_MARYLENE_HEARTBREAKERESS_OF_THE_NETH.description: A woman of mind-shattering beauty, none can match her beauty. She is perfect, and totally evil. She loves nothing but herself and her evil is as great as her beauty. No one can stand against her, even DarkGod. As you see her approaching, you feel your heart breaking. She is the perfection, don't even try against her; you will surely lose your mind...

MON_THE_GREATER_LAG_MONSTER.name: The Greater Lag Monster
MON_THE_GREATER_LAG_MONSTER.flavorText: It is even worse than the RNG, coming from Mangband, it seeks to crush you to pulp... and surely can.
MON_THE_GREATER_LAG_MONSTER.description: It is even worse than the RNG, coming from Mangband, it seeks to crush you to pulp... and surely can.

MON_BULLROARER_THE_HOBBIT.name: Bullroarer the Hobbit
MON_BULLROARER_THE_HOBBIT.flavorText: He is a sturdy hobbit who is renowned for his unusual strength and vigour. He can prove a troublesome opponent.
MON_BULLROARER_THE_HOBBIT.description: He is a sturdy hobbit who is renowned for his unusual strength and vigour. He can prove a troublesome opponent.

MON_3_HEADED_HYDRA.name: 3-headed hydra
MON_3_HEADED_HYDRA.flavorText: A strange reptilian creature with three heads, guarding its hoard.
MON_3_HEADED_HYDRA.description: A strange reptilian creature with three heads, guarding its hoard.

MON_ULDOR_THE_ACCURSED.name: Uldor the Accursed
MON_ULDOR_THE_ACCURSED.flavorText: An evil and cunning man from the East.  Having once sworn allegiance to the sons of Feanor, it was Uldor's treachery that turned the tide of the Battle of Unnumbered Tears in Morgoth's favour.
MON_ULDOR_THE_ACCURSED.description: An evil and cunning man from the East.  Having once sworn allegiance to the sons of Feanor, it was Uldor's treachery that turned the tide of the Battle of Unnumbered Tears in Morgoth's favour.

MON_MYSTIC.name: Mystic
MON_MYSTIC.flavorText: An adept at unarmed combat, the mystic strikes with stunning power. He can summon help from nature and is able to focus his power to ease any pain.
MON_MYSTIC.description: An adept at unarmed combat, the mystic strikes with stunning power. He can summon help from nature and is able to focus his power to ease any pain.

MON_ELDER_VAMPIRE.name: Elder vampire
MON_ELDER_VAMPIRE.flavorText: A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others. It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.
MON_ELDER_VAMPIRE.description: A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others. It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.

MON_ULFANG_THE_BLACK.name: Ulfang the Black
MON_ULFANG_THE_BLACK.flavorText: A short and swarthy Easterling dressed in black.  He and his three sons once openly swore allegiance to the High Elves, but were secretly in the pay of Morgoth.
MON_ULFANG_THE_BLACK.description: A short and swarthy Easterling dressed in black.  He and his three sons once openly swore allegiance to the High Elves, but were secretly in the pay of Morgoth.

MON_DEMONOLOGIST.name: Demonologist
MON_DEMONOLOGIST.flavorText: A figure twisted by evil standing in robes of deepest crimson.
MON_DEMONOLOGIST.description: A figure twisted by evil standing in robes of deepest crimson.

MON_HEZROU.name: Hezrou
MON_HEZROU.flavorText: It is a demon of lizard form with cruel-looking jaws.
MON_HEZROU.description: It is a demon of lizard form with cruel-looking jaws.

MON_GLABREZU.name: Glabrezu
MON_GLABREZU.flavorText: It is a demon with arms and pincers, its form a true mockery of life.
MON_GLABREZU.description: It is a demon with arms and pincers, its form a true mockery of life.

MON_NALFESHNEE.name: Nalfeshnee
MON_NALFESHNEE.flavorText: It is a large demon with the head of a giant boar. Flames run up and down its length.
MON_NALFESHNEE.description: It is a large demon with the head of a giant boar. Flames run up and down its length.

MON_MARILITH.name: Marilith
MON_MARILITH.flavorText: She is a demon of female form with many arms, each bearing deadly weapons.
MON_MARILITH.description: She is a demon of female form with many arms, each bearing deadly weapons.

MON_LESSER_BALROG.name: Lesser Balrog
MON_LESSER_BALROG.flavorText: It is a massive humanoid demon wreathed in flames.
MON_LESSER_BALROG.description: It is a massive humanoid demon wreathed in flames.

MON_MASTER_MYSTIC.name: Master mystic
MON_MASTER_MYSTIC.flavorText: A lord of all that is natural, skilled in the mystic ways. He is a master of martial arts and is at one with nature, able to summon help from the wild if need be.
MON_MASTER_MYSTIC.description: A lord of all that is natural, skilled in the mystic ways. He is a master of martial arts and is at one with nature, able to summon help from the wild if need be.

MON_GRAND_MASTER_MYSTIC.name: Grand master mystic
MON_GRAND_MASTER_MYSTIC.flavorText: He is one of the few true masters of the art, being extremely skillful in all forms of unarmed combat and controlling the world's natural creatures with disdainful ease.
MON_GRAND_MASTER_MYSTIC.description: He is one of the few true masters of the art, being extremely skillful in all forms of unarmed combat and controlling the world's natural creatures with disdainful ease.

MON_ERINYES.name: Erinyes
MON_ERINYES.flavorText: It is a lesser demon of female form; however, she takes little time to show her true colours.
MON_ERINYES.description: It is a lesser demon of female form; however, she takes little time to show her true colours.

MON_POLYPHEMUS_THE_BLIND_CYCLOPS.name: Polyphemus, the Blind Cyclops
MON_POLYPHEMUS_THE_BLIND_CYCLOPS.flavorText: No ordinary cyclops, but the son of a sea-god:  he wields the powers of elemental water as well as the considerable strength of a cyclops.  His one eye was blinded long ago by the warrior Odysseus, but he has trained himself to hear so well that it nearly makes up for his disability.
MON_POLYPHEMUS_THE_BLIND_CYCLOPS.description: No ordinary cyclops, but the son of a sea-god:  he wields the powers of elemental water as well as the considerable strength of a cyclops.  His one eye was blinded long ago by the warrior Odysseus, but he has trained himself to hear so well that it nearly makes up for his disability.

MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_PERPLEXITY.name: Great Wyrm of Perplexity
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_PERPLEXITY.flavorText: A dragon of great size and power.  Its polished bronze scales reflect the light in strange and confusing patterns, and you find it hard to keep your mind on the job of fighting for your life.
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_PERPLEXITY.description: A dragon of great size and power.  Its polished bronze scales reflect the light in strange and confusing patterns, and you find it hard to keep your mind on the job of fighting for your life.

MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_THUNDER.name: Great Wyrm of Thunder
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_THUNDER.flavorText: A dragon of gigantic proportions, with destructive abilities to match.  The sheer loudness of its roar leaves you stunned and unable to think clearly enough to defend yourself adequately.
MON_GREAT_WYRM_OF_THUNDER.description: A dragon of gigantic proportions, with destructive abilities to match.  The sheer loudness of its roar leaves you stunned and unable to think clearly enough to defend yourself adequately.

MON_SILVER_MOUSE.name: Silver mouse
MON_SILVER_MOUSE.flavorText: It is about three feet long with large teeth.  As the light of your lamp falls on it, it seems to grow stronger.
MON_SILVER_MOUSE.description: It is about three feet long with large teeth.  As the light of your lamp falls on it, it seems to grow stronger.

MON_THE_RAT_KING.name: The Rat King
MON_THE_RAT_KING.flavorText: A massive rat. He's the leader of the pack.
MON_THE_RAT_KING.description: A massive rat. He's the leader of the pack.

MON_VORT_THE_KOBOLD_QUEEN.name: Vort the Kobold Queen
MON_VORT_THE_KOBOLD_QUEEN.flavorText: Where Mughash is the strongest of his kind, his consort Vort is the wisest: she is her tribe's chief shamaness.
MON_VORT_THE_KOBOLD_QUEEN.description: Where Mughash is the strongest of his kind, his consort Vort is the wisest: she is her tribe's chief shamaness.

MON_FIRE_PHANTOM.name: Fire Phantom
MON_FIRE_PHANTOM.flavorText: He's back from the grave for vengeance on those who burnt him. He has no mercy for those in his way.
MON_FIRE_PHANTOM.description: He's back from the grave for vengeance on those who burnt him. He has no mercy for those in his way.

MON_THE_INSANE_PLAYER.name: The Insane Player
MON_THE_INSANE_PLAYER.flavorText: Once a powerful adventurer, this poor fighter has seen a few too many software bugs in his time. Any shred of lucidity is long gone, but he still remains dangerous. He wanders aimlessly through the dungeon randomly striking at foes both real and imagined, all the while screaming out at the world that caused his condition.
MON_THE_INSANE_PLAYER.description: Once a powerful adventurer, this poor fighter has seen a few too many software bugs in his time. Any shred of lucidity is long gone, but he still remains dangerous. He wanders aimlessly through the dungeon randomly striking at foes both real and imagined, all the while screaming out at the world that caused his condition.

MON_VERMICIOUS_KNID.name: Vermicious Knid
MON_VERMICIOUS_KNID.flavorText: An amorphous shape that looks like wet grey clay with two pale eyes. It is totally silent as it oozes towards you.
MON_VERMICIOUS_KNID.description: An amorphous shape that looks like wet grey clay with two pale eyes. It is totally silent as it oozes towards you.

MON_BONE_GOLEM.name: Bone golem
MON_BONE_GOLEM.flavorText: A skeletal form, black as night, constructed from the bones of its previous victims.
MON_BONE_GOLEM.description: A skeletal form, black as night, constructed from the bones of its previous victims.

MON_BRONZE_GOLEM.name: Bronze golem
MON_BRONZE_GOLEM.flavorText: A gigantic four-armed animated bronze statue, glowing with great heat.
MON_BRONZE_GOLEM.description: A gigantic four-armed animated bronze statue, glowing with great heat.

MON_BLUE_DRAGON_WORM.name: Blue dragon worm
MON_BLUE_DRAGON_WORM.flavorText: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Sparks fly from its jaws.
MON_BLUE_DRAGON_WORM.description: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Sparks fly from its jaws.

MON_WHITE_DRAGON_WORM.name: White dragon worm
MON_WHITE_DRAGON_WORM.flavorText: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Its breath condenses in the air.
MON_WHITE_DRAGON_WORM.description: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Its breath condenses in the air.

MON_GREEN_DRAGON_WORM.name: Green dragon worm
MON_GREEN_DRAGON_WORM.flavorText: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. You can smell foul gases on its breath.
MON_GREEN_DRAGON_WORM.description: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. You can smell foul gases on its breath.

MON_BLACK_DRAGON_WORM.name: Black dragon worm
MON_BLACK_DRAGON_WORM.flavorText: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Acidic drool drips from its jaws.
MON_BLACK_DRAGON_WORM.description: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Acidic drool drips from its jaws.

MON_RED_DRAGON_WORM.name: Red dragon worm
MON_RED_DRAGON_WORM.flavorText: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Smoke comes from its mouth.
MON_RED_DRAGON_WORM.description: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Smoke comes from its mouth.

MON_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON_WORM.name: Multi-hued dragon worm
MON_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON_WORM.flavorText: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Its scales shimmer different colours as you watch.
MON_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON_WORM.description: You thought dragons used eggs, but this worm has the scales, and the bad breath, and the fiery eyes, of a real dragon. Its scales shimmer different colours as you watch.

MON_THE_MINOTAUR_OF_THE_LABYRINTH.name: The Minotaur of the Labyrinth
MON_THE_MINOTAUR_OF_THE_LABYRINTH.flavorText: It is a cross between a human and a bull.
MON_THE_MINOTAUR_OF_THE_LABYRINTH.description: It is a cross between a human and a bull.

MON_THE_SANDWORM_QUEEN.name: The Sandworm Queen
MON_THE_SANDWORM_QUEEN.flavorText: Queen and mother of the sandworms, fear her and her prolific children.
MON_THE_SANDWORM_QUEEN.description: Queen and mother of the sandworms, fear her and her prolific children.

MON_SANDWORM.name: Sandworm
MON_SANDWORM.flavorText: Offbreed of the Sandworm Queen, they are harmless alone...
MON_SANDWORM.description: Offbreed of the Sandworm Queen, they are harmless alone...

MON_TIK_SRVZLLAT.name: Tik'srvzllat
MON_TIK_SRVZLLAT.flavorText: A disembodied and barely sentient mind, Tik'srvzllat floated through the void for eons before being awakened by sorcery, pulled into the nether realm, and shaped into the being you see before you. A flickering purple outline of a sphere, with eerie yellow-purple mist circling rapidly around it, Tik'srvzllat threatens your sanity with its appearance alone.
MON_TIK_SRVZLLAT.description: A disembodied and barely sentient mind, Tik'srvzllat floated through the void for eons before being awakened by sorcery, pulled into the nether realm, and shaped into the being you see before you. A flickering purple outline of a sphere, with eerie yellow-purple mist circling rapidly around it, Tik'srvzllat threatens your sanity with its appearance alone.

MON_THE_GLASS_GOLEM.name: The Glass Golem
MON_THE_GLASS_GOLEM.flavorText: One of the last creations of the petty dwarves of Ludarin, its existence explains their destruction. A creation of finest glass, the body of this creature bends and amplifies light in a way that makes you unsure of its position. You feel somewhat dizzy as the radiant light reflects off the walls, the ceiling and your gear.
MON_THE_GLASS_GOLEM.description: One of the last creations of the petty dwarves of Ludarin, its existence explains their destruction. A creation of finest glass, the body of this creature bends and amplifies light in a way that makes you unsure of its position. You feel somewhat dizzy as the radiant light reflects off the walls, the ceiling and your gear.

MON_THE_WHITE_BALROG.name: The White Balrog
MON_THE_WHITE_BALROG.flavorText: It is a massive humanoid demon wreathed in frost, wielding a cruel looking pike in its hands.
MON_THE_WHITE_BALROG.description: It is a massive humanoid demon wreathed in frost, wielding a cruel looking pike in its hands.

MON_GOLGARACH_THE_LIVING_ROCK.name: Golgarach, the Living Rock
MON_GOLGARACH_THE_LIVING_ROCK.flavorText: Deep in the heart of the earth, even the rock itself is sentient and has learned to despise intruders.
MON_GOLGARACH_THE_LIVING_ROCK.description: Deep in the heart of the earth, even the rock itself is sentient and has learned to despise intruders.

MON_ATLAS_THE_TITAN.name: Atlas, the Titan
MON_ATLAS_THE_TITAN.flavorText: The strongest of all the Titans.  Legend has it that he once held the sky on his shoulders; and the mountain range that now does so is named after him.
MON_ATLAS_THE_TITAN.description: The strongest of all the Titans.  Legend has it that he once held the sky on his shoulders; and the mountain range that now does so is named after him.

MON_KRONOS_LORD_OF_THE_TITANS.name: Kronos, Lord of the Titans
MON_KRONOS_LORD_OF_THE_TITANS.flavorText: The lord of the Titans, he has broken loose from his confinement in the nether hells to seek revenge on the world.
MON_KRONOS_LORD_OF_THE_TITANS.description: The lord of the Titans, he has broken loose from his confinement in the nether hells to seek revenge on the world.

MON_WATER_HOUND.name: Water hound
MON_WATER_HOUND.flavorText: The sound of a hundred waterfalls rushes through your ears as a huge wave of water, vaguely hound-shaped, rushes towards you.
MON_WATER_HOUND.description: The sound of a hundred waterfalls rushes through your ears as a huge wave of water, vaguely hound-shaped, rushes towards you.

MON_IMPROV_THE_MIGHTY_MOLD.name: Improv, the mighty MoLD
MON_IMPROV_THE_MIGHTY_MOLD.flavorText: An assistant to DarkGod, Improv has chosen the form of a dense purple smog for his incarnation into Middle-earth. It travels the dungeons, killing software bugs and creating random artifacts for guests to find.
MON_IMPROV_THE_MIGHTY_MOLD.description: An assistant to DarkGod, Improv has chosen the form of a dense purple smog for his incarnation into Middle-earth. It travels the dungeons, killing software bugs and creating random artifacts for guests to find.

MON_EMPEROR_MIMIC.name: Emperor Mimic
MON_EMPEROR_MIMIC.flavorText: A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.
MON_EMPEROR_MIMIC.description: A strange creature that disguises itself as an object to lure unsuspecting adventurers within reach of its venomous claws.

MON_MELINDA_PROUDFOOT.name: Melinda Proudfoot
MON_MELINDA_PROUDFOOT.flavorText: She seems to seek someone, you may help...
MON_MELINDA_PROUDFOOT.description: She seems to seek someone, you may help...

MON_THRAIN_THE_KING_UNDER_THE_MOUNTAIN.name: Thrain, the King Under the Mountain
MON_THRAIN_THE_KING_UNDER_THE_MOUNTAIN.flavorText: He must have suffered horrible tortures...
MON_THRAIN_THE_KING_UNDER_THE_MOUNTAIN.description: He must have suffered horrible tortures...

MON_FIRE_GOLEM.name: Fire golem
MON_FIRE_GOLEM.flavorText: A sentient mass of pure fire.
MON_FIRE_GOLEM.description: A sentient mass of pure fire.

MON_MELKOR_LORD_OF_DARKNESS.name: Melkor, Lord of Darkness
MON_MELKOR_LORD_OF_DARKNESS.flavorText: He was the most powerful of the Valar, the equal of Manwe. You banned him here, in the Void, and now you must destroy him forever. However here in the Void, his spirit gained much power for he is closer to the Flame Imperishable. He is coming to you in pure madness, which makes him even more dangerous. You are on the verge of dying!
MON_MELKOR_LORD_OF_DARKNESS.description: He was the most powerful of the Valar, the equal of Manwe. You banned him here, in the Void, and now you must destroy him forever. However here in the Void, his spirit gained much power for he is closer to the Flame Imperishable. He is coming to you in pure madness, which makes him even more dangerous. You are on the verge of dying!

MON_NEIL_THE_SORCEROR.name: Neil, the Sorceror
MON_NEIL_THE_SORCEROR.flavorText: He looks like he is looking for something, and the flecks of dragon blood on his face tell you he means business!
MON_NEIL_THE_SORCEROR.description: He looks like he is looking for something, and the flecks of dragon blood on his face tell you he means business!

KIND_BLINDNESS.name: Blindness
KIND_BLINDNESS.flavorText: This slightly poisonous potion temporarily impedes your eyesight, making you unable to see a thing.

KIND_PARANOIA.name: Paranoia
KIND_PARANOIA.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will make you scared. You will not be able to hit your enemies in combat if you're scared.

KIND_CONFUSION.name: Confusion
KIND_CONFUSION.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will confuse you. You will not be able to cast spells, use wands, staves or scrolls. You can still quaff potions, though.

KIND_HALLUCINATION.name: Hallucination
KIND_HALLUCINATION.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will make you hallucinate. You will not be able to recognise any monster or item.

KIND_CURE_POISON.name: Cure Poison
KIND_CURE_POISON.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will cure you from poison.

KIND_CURE_BLINDNESS.name: Cure Blindness
KIND_CURE_BLINDNESS.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will cure you from blindness.

KIND_CURE_PARANOIA.name: Cure Paranoia
KIND_CURE_PARANOIA.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will cure your paranoia.  Paranoia is the state when you are too afraid to attack monsters.

KIND_CURE_CONFUSION.name: Cure Confusion
KIND_CURE_CONFUSION.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will cure your confusion.  Confusion is when you are too confused to cast spells, zap staves, aim wands or read scrolls.

KIND_WEAKNESS.name: Weakness
KIND_WEAKNESS.flavorText: This nasty potion will sap your strength, making you weaker.

KIND_UNHEALTH.name: Unhealth
KIND_UNHEALTH.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will reduce your constitution by one point.

KIND_RESTORE_CONSTITUTION.name: Restore Constitution
KIND_RESTORE_CONSTITUTION.flavorText: A beneficial magical concoction, restoring your damaged health.

KIND_RESTORING.name: Restoring
KIND_RESTORING.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will restore your strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom and charisma. These need restoring when they are displayed in yellow.

KIND_STUPIDITY.name: Stupidity
KIND_STUPIDITY.flavorText: This accursed potion will cloud your intellect, making you stupid.

KIND_NAIVETY.name: Naivety
KIND_NAIVETY.flavorText: This potion casts a shadow on your knowledge, making you foolish.

KIND_POISON.name: Poison
KIND_POISON.flavorText: This bottle is filled with a mild but still dangerous liquid poison. Drinking it would be highly unwise.

KIND_SICKNESS.name: Sickness
KIND_SICKNESS.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will reduce your constitution by one point. It will also damage you quite severely in the process. That's a bad thing.

KIND_PARALYSIS.name: Paralysis
KIND_PARALYSIS.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will paralyse you for a certain time. Any nearby monsters will take this opportunity to kill you. That's a bad thing.

KIND_RESTORE_STRENGTH.name: Restore Strength
KIND_RESTORE_STRENGTH.flavorText: This magical potion will bring back your physical power to its full extent, should it be drained.

KIND_DISEASE.name: Disease
KIND_DISEASE.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will reduce your strength by one point. It will also damage you quite severely in the process. That's a bad thing.

KIND_CURE_SERIOUS_WOUNDS.name: Cure Serious Wounds
KIND_CURE_SERIOUS_WOUNDS.flavorText: This beneficial potion will cure some wounds and other inhibiting ailments.

KIND_RATION_OF_FOOD.name: & Ration~ of Food
KIND_RATION_OF_FOOD.flavorText: Lightweight and filling. Not an incredible taste experience, but that'd be asking a bit much. You can 'E'at it.

KIND_HARD_BISCUIT.name: & Hard Biscuit~
KIND_HARD_BISCUIT.flavorText: It doesn't look great, and 'E'ating it will only fill your stomach a bit, for a short time.

KIND_STRIP_OF_VENISON.name: & Strip~ of Venison
KIND_STRIP_OF_VENISON.flavorText: It looks great, and 'E'ating it will fill your stomach well.

KIND_SLIME_MOLD.name: & Slime Mold~
KIND_SLIME_MOLD.flavorText: It looks disgusting, but if you really want to you can 'E'at it. Not an incredible taste experience, but that'd be asking a bit much.

KIND_PINT_OF_FINE_ALE.name: & Pint~ of Fine Ale
KIND_PINT_OF_FINE_ALE.flavorText: A bottle of a dark beer-like beverage. You can drink it by pressing 'E'.

KIND_PINT_OF_FINE_WINE.name: & Pint~ of Fine Wine
KIND_PINT_OF_FINE_WINE.flavorText: A bottle of fine wine. You can drink it by pressing 'E'.

KIND_MATTOCK.name: & Mattock~
KIND_MATTOCK.flavorText: This is a digging tool. Use it to dig in walls, destroy doors, or cut wood.

KIND_BLUE_STONE.name: & Blue Stone~
KIND_BLUE_STONE.flavorText: A standard & Blue Stone~ from ToME.

KIND_BROKEN_DAGGER.name: & Broken Dagger~
KIND_BROKEN_DAGGER.flavorText: The blade itself is a foot long and broken off not far above the hilt.

KIND_BASTARD_SWORD.name: & Bastard Sword~
KIND_BASTARD_SWORD.flavorText: This is a long, double-edged sword with a plain hilt that could be wielded in one or two hands. It's called a "bastard sword" because in size, it falls between the broad sword and the two-handed sword, thus not having a family of its own. It's typically around 51 inches long. It is effective for cutting through tougher armours. It could be used for thrusting, but most wielders swing it like a bat.

KIND_SCIMITAR.name: & Scimitar~
KIND_SCIMITAR.flavorText: This oriental blade has 2 edges and is deeply curved. It has a wide and very sharp end. It is the forefather of the sabre.

KIND_TULWAR.name: & Tulwar~
KIND_TULWAR.flavorText: This vicious sword is half sword and half club, with a slight hook on the tip.

KIND_BROAD_SWORD.name: & Broad Sword~
KIND_BROAD_SWORD.flavorText: This broader version of the long sword is a standard weapon in the army of Gondolin.

KIND_SHORT_SWORD.name: & Short Sword~
KIND_SHORT_SWORD.flavorText: This shorter version of the long sword is a common weapon for rogues and mages.

KIND_BLADE_OF_CHAOS.name: & Blade~ of Chaos
KIND_BLADE_OF_CHAOS.flavorText: A mighty sword which seems to be completely blunt. However, it is a conduit into the realms of pure chaos and strikes its victims with the devastating might of chaos itself whenever it connects. It gives you resistance to chaos and it can polymorph, teleport, confuse or drain hit points from the monster you hit. It occasionally causes earthquakes as well.

KIND_TWO_HANDED_SWORD.name: & Two-Handed Sword~
KIND_TWO_HANDED_SWORD.flavorText: This blade is lot longer, wider and heavier than a long sword. You have to wield it with two hands. This means that wielding a shield makes fighting very difficult.

KIND_MAIN_GAUCHE.name: & Main Gauche~
KIND_MAIN_GAUCHE.flavorText: This blade is sinuously curved and tipped with a harpoon-like end. This blade has a large handguard and was designed as an off-hand weapon. This short but cruel blade is a favourite among orcs.

KIND_CUTLASS.name: & Cutlass~
KIND_CUTLASS.flavorText: This oriental weapon is a short, thick, curving sword with a single cutting edge. This simple slashing weapon is typically carried by buccaneers, pirates, and sailors.

KIND_EXECUTIONER_S_SWORD.name: & Executioner's Sword~
KIND_EXECUTIONER_S_SWORD.flavorText: These weapons have been built in all sizes. They are custom-made for warriors that want to set out and kill their archenemy. These blades are rare, costly and very deadly.

KIND_KATANA.name: & Katana~
KIND_KATANA.flavorText: The katana is a long blade with only a small disk for a guard. Its hilt is long enough for two hands, though it could be used with only one hand, and is usually wrapped in cloth or leather. The art of forging such swords is largely unknown in this part of Middle-earth, and such weapons are typically imported from distant lands.

KIND_LONG_SWORD.name: & Long Sword~
KIND_LONG_SWORD.flavorText: A long straight sword, tapering to a pronounced point. Mainly good for piercing attacks, but it can be used for slashing, too. It is a very popular design and has become standard issue in many armies.

KIND_DAGGER.name: & Dagger~
KIND_DAGGER.flavorText: It's the standard weapon of rogues and thieves.  The blade is a foot long.

KIND_RAPIER.name: & Rapier~
KIND_RAPIER.flavorText: The rapier's hilt consisted of a pair of oval guards pierced with holes, recurved quillions, and a knuckle guard.  The guard is very intricate and very effective as protection.

KIND_SABRE.name: & Sabre~
KIND_SABRE.flavorText: A long, one-edged, slightly curved sword with a knuckle guard and short hilt.  It is two-edged in its lower part.

KIND_SMALL_SWORD.name: & Small Sword~
KIND_SMALL_SWORD.flavorText: It's the favourite weapon of strong mages and thieves. The blade is about twenty inches long. It's very easy to handle, although it is a lot less efficient than the longer and heavier designs.

KIND_BROKEN_SWORD.name: & Broken Sword~
KIND_BROKEN_SWORD.flavorText: Just a hilt and a few inches of blade, broken off in a jagged stump. Probably worthless.

KIND_BALL_AND_CHAIN.name: & Ball-and-Chain~
KIND_BALL_AND_CHAIN.flavorText: This weapon has a ball linked with a chain to a wooden handle. Preferred tactic is smashing the brains of your opponent.

KIND_WHIP.name: & Whip~
KIND_WHIP.flavorText: Think Doctor Jones. This weapon is light and easy to fight with. It has nasty barbs and hooks fixed to the thong to make it useful in combat. Whips give easily multiple attacks.

KIND_FLAIL.name: & Flail~
KIND_FLAIL.flavorText: This weapon was originally used to cut corn. More warlike versions sport a large blade stuck on a wooden handle. The hinge allows it to get past enemy defences or to strike with added momentum when used skillfully.

KIND_TWO_HANDED_FLAIL.name: & Two-Handed Flail~
KIND_TWO_HANDED_FLAIL.flavorText: This two-handed version of the flail gives the fighter a fearsome weapon that can do a fair amount of damage.  It typically has several spiked metal lumps on chains.

KIND_MORNING_STAR.name: & Morning Star~
KIND_MORNING_STAR.flavorText: This weapon consists of a large club with chains that have wooden balls with metal spikes on the end.

KIND_MACE.name: & Mace~
KIND_MACE.flavorText: This weapon is a club ending in a sphere. The sphere is studded with metal shards, and thus can both crush and cut your adversary.

KIND_QUARTERSTAFF.name: & Quarterstaff~
KIND_QUARTERSTAFF.flavorText: A long, wooden pole, usually the height of the wielder. Four of them can be made out of the trunk of one young tree, hence the name. The quarterstaff is an excellent weapon for travellers as it doubles both as a walking staff and as a deterrent against brigands. The quarterstaff is used more in fencing and brawling than melee combat.

KIND_WAR_HAMMER.name: & War Hammer~
KIND_WAR_HAMMER.flavorText: A large hammer, designed to crush skulls with mighty strikes.

KIND_LEAD_FILLED_MACE.name: & Lead-Filled Mace~
KIND_LEAD_FILLED_MACE.flavorText: A large, mean mace filled with lead in order to wreak a maximum of havoc.

KIND_MACE_OF_DISRUPTION.name: & Mace~ of Disruption
KIND_MACE_OF_DISRUPTION.flavorText: This mace is custom-made for priests that go out to destroy evil. It is deadly, especially for undead.

KIND_LUCERNE_HAMMER.name: & Lucerne Hammer~
KIND_LUCERNE_HAMMER.flavorText: A war hammer combined with a spearpoint, mounted on a long pole.

KIND_BEAKED_AXE.name: & Beaked Axe~
KIND_BEAKED_AXE.flavorText: This polearm has a beak mounted opposite the blade.

KIND_GLAIVE.name: & Glaive~
KIND_GLAIVE.flavorText: A polearm with a long, slightly curved knife-like blade. It has spurs on the dull side of the blade. It's primarily a slashing and chopping weapon. Glaives are often used to protect archers, crossbowmen, and gunners while they reload. Outside of combat they are a popular processional weapon and therefore many have ornately carved blades.

KIND_HALBERD.name: & Halberd~
KIND_HALBERD.flavorText: The halberd has a broad, short axe blade on a 5 - 6ft long haft, with a spearpoint at the top, often a back-spike and occasionally a butt-spike. Used to combat heavier armour. It's usually used for cutting and stabbing.  It's the most versatile polearm in Middle-earth. The axe is used in general melee. The top pike is used to pierce armour, or is set against a cavalry charge. The back hook could unseat horses, trip opponents, parry a blow, or be a general piercing weapon.

KIND_AWL_PIKE.name: & Awl-Pike~
KIND_AWL_PIKE.flavorText: This is a polearm with a long square-sectioned spike on the end.

KIND_PIKE.name: & Pike~
KIND_PIKE.flavorText: A staff, 16-18 feet long, that has a small piercing head about 10 inches long. The pike is often used by infantry to fend off cavalry.  It is very effective against mounted troops.

KIND_SPEAR.name: & Spear~
KIND_SPEAR.flavorText: Spears tend to have a strong, wide, leaf-shaped head with a ridge down the middle. The spearhead is attached to the wooden shaft by a socket. The sockets are usually riveted to the shaft and some have two small lugs near the base of the socket to allow the head to be possibly bound on as well. This spear is 7 feet long.

KIND_TRIDENT.name: & Trident~
KIND_TRIDENT.flavorText: The trident is based on the pitchfork.  In fact, when not used as a weapon, it is often employed as a pitchfork. It is famous for its uses in gladiatorial arenas. It is used much like a spear and could even be thrown like one in desperate situations.

KIND_LANCE.name: & Lance~
KIND_LANCE.flavorText: This is the original polearm. It is shaped like a spear but is bigger. It's meant to fend off enemies, not to be thrown.

KIND_GREAT_AXE.name: & Great Axe~
KIND_GREAT_AXE.flavorText: A huge and heavy two-headed axe.

KIND_BATTLE_AXE.name: & Battle Axe~
KIND_BATTLE_AXE.flavorText: Nordic polearm with a broad blade and a hook mounted on the end of the shaft. The Nordics' take on the halberd. The polearm of choice for many Nordics, ideally suited for slashing, thrusting, and unseating cavalry.

KIND_LOCHABER_AXE.name: & Lochaber Axe~
KIND_LOCHABER_AXE.flavorText: Nordic polearm with a broad blade and a hook mounted on the end of the shaft. A Nordic version of the halberd. The polearm of choice for many Nordics, this weapon is ideally suited for slashing, thrusting, and unseating cavalry.

KIND_BROAD_AXE.name: & Broad Axe~
KIND_BROAD_AXE.flavorText: A one-headed axe made for combat, with an elongated moon-shaped blade.

KIND_SCYTHE.name: & Scythe~
KIND_SCYTHE.flavorText: A simple farm implement, converted into a weapon by slightly straightening its blade and putting it in line with its pole, instead of the typical right angle.

KIND_SCYTHE_OF_SLICING.name: & Scythe~ of Slicing
KIND_SCYTHE_OF_SLICING.flavorText: The simple design of the war scythe, but this one uses a finely crafted and incredibly sharp steel blade which causes terrible wounds when it hits.

KIND_SHORT_BOW.name: & Short Bow~
KIND_SHORT_BOW.flavorText: A piece of bent wood, fitted with a string. Easy to transport and use, but its effect is not very impressive. You can 'f'ire it after you 'w'ield it.

KIND_LONG_BOW.name: & Long Bow~
KIND_LONG_BOW.flavorText: A bow almost as long as a human. It takes considerable strength and skill to use and is rather awkward to carry around inside buildings. Nevertheless, it shoots arrows with astonishing force. You can 'f'ire it after you 'w'ield it.

KIND_LIGHT_CROSSBOW.name: & Light Crossbow~
KIND_LIGHT_CROSSBOW.flavorText: A metal bow mounted on a wooden stock. It is used for shooting bolts. This design is relatively light and not too difficult to cock, but also shoots its quarrels with less force. You can 'f'ire with it after you 'w'ield it.

KIND_HEAVY_CROSSBOW.name: & Heavy Crossbow~
KIND_HEAVY_CROSSBOW.flavorText: A metal bow mounted on a wooden stock, with attached cocking mechanism. It takes considerable time and strength to cock it and it's rather heavy. However, it hurls its ammunition with incredible force. You can 'f'ire with it after you 'w'ield it.

KIND_SLING.name: & Sling~
KIND_SLING.flavorText: A simple cloth or leather pouch with two strings attached. It is used to hurl pebbles or iron shots. You can 'f'ire with it after you 'w'ield it.

KIND_ARROW.name: & Arrow~
KIND_ARROW.flavorText: A simple metal head on a piece of wood or bamboo, fitted with some feathers. You can use it for 'f'iring a bow.

KIND_SEEKER_ARROW.name: & Seeker Arrow~
KIND_SEEKER_ARROW.flavorText: A precision-made arrow, which allows you to hit precisely the most vulnerable place of an opponent. You can use it for 'f'iring a bow.

KIND_BOLT.name: & Bolt~
KIND_BOLT.flavorText: A short metal arrow, to be 'f'ired with a crossbow.

KIND_SEEKER_BOLT.name: & Seeker Bolt~
KIND_SEEKER_BOLT.flavorText: A precision-made bolt, which allows you to hit exactly the most vulnerable place of an opponent. You can use it for 'f'iring a crossbow.

KIND_ROUNDED_PEBBLE.name: & Rounded Pebble~
KIND_ROUNDED_PEBBLE.flavorText: Small round stones. When fired with a sling, they could even hurt a giant. You can use them for 'f'iring a sling.

KIND_IRON_SHOT.name: & Iron Shot~
KIND_IRON_SHOT.flavorText: Metal balls, made for shooting with slings. You can use them for 'f'iring a sling.

KIND_SHOVEL.name: & Shovel~
KIND_SHOVEL.flavorText: A simple digging tool for shovelling away rubble and maybe even soft rock.

KIND_GNOMISH_SHOVEL.name: & Gnomish Shovel~
KIND_GNOMISH_SHOVEL.flavorText: Crafted by the gnomes, its design profits greatly from the gnomes' expertise honed in the burrowing of their hovels.

KIND_DWARVEN_SHOVEL.name: & Dwarven Shovel~
KIND_DWARVEN_SHOVEL.flavorText: The lighter digging tool used by dwarves to remove debris, but also good enough to clear away bits of rock when no pick is easily available.

KIND_PICK.name: & Pick~
KIND_PICK.flavorText: A heavy digging tool, primarily for earthworking, but also good for tunnelling through stone, if one is willing to perform the time-consuming labour.

KIND_ORCISH_PICK.name: & Orcish Pick~
KIND_ORCISH_PICK.flavorText: Although orcs tend to dig rather untidy mines and overcome difficulties in this work less by skill than mere stubbornness, they have amassed quite some expertise in mining, which has gone into this digging tool.

KIND_DWARVEN_PICK.name: & Dwarven Pick~
KIND_DWARVEN_PICK.flavorText: The dwarves, miners of legend, have made this pick, which is so expertly crafted that even weaklings can bore through solid rock with it.

KIND_ELVEN_CLOAK.name: & Elven Cloak~
KIND_ELVEN_CLOAK.flavorText: A wonderfully light cloak coloured in brown and green hues. Its colouring greatly helps the wearer to avoid undesired attention. Wearing it makes you feel lucky and somehow you seem to see what was meant to stay unseen.

KIND_PAIR_OF_SOFT_LEATHER_BOOTS.name: & Pair~ of Soft Leather Boots
KIND_PAIR_OF_SOFT_LEATHER_BOOTS.flavorText: A pair of low boots, comfortable to wear.

KIND_PAIR_OF_HARD_LEATHER_BOOTS.name: & Pair~ of Hard Leather Boots
KIND_PAIR_OF_HARD_LEATHER_BOOTS.flavorText: A pair of boots, with hardened leather at the caps, offering a little extra protection for the feet.

KIND_PAIR_OF_METAL_SHOD_BOOTS.name: & Pair~ of Metal Shod Boots
KIND_PAIR_OF_METAL_SHOD_BOOTS.flavorText: Heavy boots, with metal strips at the toes, heels and other vulnerable parts, to better protect the wearer's feet from harm.

KIND_HARD_LEATHER_CAP.name: & Hard Leather Cap~
KIND_HARD_LEATHER_CAP.flavorText: A piece of protective headgear made from hardened leather, just covering the skull.

KIND_METAL_CAP.name: & Metal Cap~
KIND_METAL_CAP.flavorText: A metal skullcap with nose and cheekguards.

KIND_IRON_HELM.name: & Iron Helm~
KIND_IRON_HELM.flavorText: A large helmet that can protect the entire head. Ventilation and bad vision can be a problem, however.

KIND_STEEL_HELM.name: & Steel Helm~
KIND_STEEL_HELM.flavorText: A helmet which protects the entire head. The expensive steel as base material allows it to offer very good protection while being fairly light.

KIND_IRON_CROWN.name: & Iron Crown~
KIND_IRON_CROWN.flavorText: An iron circlet which might be worn, but which is purely ornamental unless it has special powers.

KIND_GOLDEN_CROWN.name: & Golden Crown~
KIND_GOLDEN_CROWN.flavorText: A gilded crown, which just looks good. Sometimes such headgear also has additional properties which might make it worth wearing.

KIND_JEWEL_ENCRUSTED_CROWN.name: & Jewel Encrusted Crown~
KIND_JEWEL_ENCRUSTED_CROWN.flavorText: A gorgeous-looking silver crown, adorned with several gems. You might wear it on your head, if you really think you're worthy.

KIND_ROBE.name: & Robe~
KIND_ROBE.flavorText: A full-length garment which can be worn on the body. It is not really armour, but mages often wear them as they are very light and don't hinder movement much.

KIND_FILTHY_RAG.name: & Filthy Rag~
KIND_FILTHY_RAG.flavorText: A piece of discarded cloth, smelly and dirty. Eurgh. You're not going to wear this, are you?

KIND_SOFT_LEATHER_ARMOUR.name: & Soft Leather Armour~
KIND_SOFT_LEATHER_ARMOUR.flavorText: A leather jerkin, light and unencumbering, but not very protective.

KIND_SOFT_STUDDED_LEATHER.name: & Soft Studded Leather~
KIND_SOFT_STUDDED_LEATHER.flavorText: A leather jerkin with metal studs in critical places offering slightly better protection.

KIND_HARD_LEATHER_ARMOUR.name: & Hard Leather Armour~
KIND_HARD_LEATHER_ARMOUR.flavorText: A leather armour covering only the body. It is made of hardened leather to make it harder to penetrate.  It's also a bit harder to move in, as it is rather stiff.

KIND_HARD_STUDDED_LEATHER.name: & Hard Studded Leather~
KIND_HARD_STUDDED_LEATHER.flavorText: A suit of hardened leather armour, reinforced with metal studs.

KIND_LEATHER_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Leather Scale Mail~
KIND_LEATHER_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made of overlapping hardened leather scales. It offers good protection while still being rather lightweight.

KIND_METAL_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Metal Scale Mail~
KIND_METAL_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of overlapping metal scales, sewn onto a leather or cloth jerkin.

KIND_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Chain Mail~
KIND_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of interlinked metal rings, to be worn over a woollen garment.

KIND_RUSTY_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Rusty Chain Mail~
KIND_RUSTY_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: This chain mail has rusted beyond repair. It can still be worn, but some of the rings have gone missing and the rust has made the suit inflexible. Consequently, it offers very poor protection and is cumbersome to move in.

KIND_AUGMENTED_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Augmented Chain Mail~
KIND_AUGMENTED_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of interlinked metal rings, with additional metal plates or scales covering vulnerable parts of the wearer.

KIND_BAR_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Bar Chain Mail~
KIND_BAR_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of interlinked metal rings, with additional short metal bars added in many places to prevent penetration of the armour by piercing attacks.

KIND_METAL_BRIGANDINE_ARMOUR.name: & Metal Brigandine Armour~
KIND_METAL_BRIGANDINE_ARMOUR.flavorText: This is a leather armour with many small metal plates fixed to it, covering it entirely.

KIND_PARTIAL_PLATE_ARMOUR.name: & Partial Plate Armour~
KIND_PARTIAL_PLATE_ARMOUR.flavorText: An armour made of steel plates, covering only the body of the wearer.

KIND_METAL_LAMELLAR_ARMOUR.name: & Metal Lamellar Armour~
KIND_METAL_LAMELLAR_ARMOUR.flavorText: Lamellar consists of small rectangular plates (lames) attached to each other at each edge or corner with leather lacings through small holes in the plates.

KIND_FULL_PLATE_ARMOUR.name: & Full Plate Armour~
KIND_FULL_PLATE_ARMOUR.flavorText: A suit of armour made of metal plates, covering the body, arms and upper legs. A very effective but very heavy armour.

KIND_RIBBED_PLATE_ARMOUR.name: & Ribbed Plate Armour~
KIND_RIBBED_PLATE_ARMOUR.flavorText: This full suit of armour has been strengthened in places to better deflect or absorb blows.

KIND_ADAMANTITE_PLATE_MAIL.name: & Adamantite Plate Mail~
KIND_ADAMANTITE_PLATE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of plate armour fashioned from an unbreakable crystal by mage-smiths.

KIND_MITHRIL_PLATE_MAIL.name: & Mithril Plate Mail~
KIND_MITHRIL_PLATE_MAIL.flavorText: A full suit of plate armour, fashioned from the rare true-silver. Only the dwarves know the secret of making armour or weapons of this metal.

KIND_MITHRIL_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Mithril Chain Mail~
KIND_MITHRIL_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of chain mail, made by dwarven smiths from the rare and precious metal also called true-silver.

KIND_DOUBLE_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Double Chain Mail~
KIND_DOUBLE_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of chain mail, with an additional layer of mail in some places.

KIND_SHIELD_OF_DEFLECTION.name: & Shield~ of Deflection
KIND_SHIELD_OF_DEFLECTION.flavorText: A large shield fashioned from a metal alloy that is not subject to corrosion. It was especially crafted to better deflect attacks.

KIND_CLOAK.name: & Cloak~
KIND_CLOAK.flavorText: A cloth coat typically worn as a loose outer garment. It is spacious enough to be worn even over bulky metal armour.

KIND_SHADOW_CLOAK.name: & Shadow Cloak~
KIND_SHADOW_CLOAK.flavorText: A rare cloak imbued with magic to radiate a strange twilight, absorbing both extreme brightness and darkness.

KIND_SET_OF_LEATHER_GLOVES.name: & Set~ of Leather Gloves
KIND_SET_OF_LEATHER_GLOVES.flavorText: Light gloves which do not seriously hinder finger movements, while still protecting the hands somewhat.

KIND_SET_OF_GAUNTLETS.name: & Set~ of Gauntlets
KIND_SET_OF_GAUNTLETS.flavorText: Metal gloves protecting the hands up to the middle of the lower arm.

KIND_SET_OF_CESTI.name: & Set~ of Cesti
KIND_SET_OF_CESTI.flavorText: A set of metal gloves with nasty spikes and barbs. Though originally made to help in combat, the additional metal on the backs of the hands also offers a lot more protection.

KIND_SMALL_LEATHER_SHIELD.name: & Small Leather Shield~
KIND_SMALL_LEATHER_SHIELD.flavorText: A small disc of lindenwood, with a leather covering on one side.

KIND_LARGE_LEATHER_SHIELD.name: & Large Leather Shield~
KIND_LARGE_LEATHER_SHIELD.flavorText: A large oval or rectangular shield. It is made of wood, typically linden, and covered with a layer of hardened leather to offer better protection.

KIND_SMALL_METAL_SHIELD.name: & Small Metal Shield~
KIND_SMALL_METAL_SHIELD.flavorText: A small shield strengthened with a layer of metal.

KIND_LARGE_METAL_SHIELD.name: & Large Metal Shield~
KIND_LARGE_METAL_SHIELD.flavorText: A large piece of wood, rectangular or oval in shape, and covered with metal to strengthen it. It's to be worn strapped to the arm not occupied by the weapon when fighting.

KIND_STRENGTH.name: Strength
KIND_STRENGTH.flavorText: This beneficial potion will magically improve your physical strength.

KIND_DEXTERITY.name: Dexterity
KIND_DEXTERITY.flavorText: A strange magical drink which greatly improves your agility and nimbleness.

KIND_CONSTITUTION.name: Constitution
KIND_CONSTITUTION.flavorText: This magical concoction greatly improves your health, making you permanently tougher.

KIND_INTELLIGENCE.name: Intelligence
KIND_INTELLIGENCE.flavorText: This nice potion will magically enhance your wit, permanently improving your intellect.

KIND_SPEED.name: Speed
KIND_SPEED.flavorText: This energising rod will allow you to act a lot faster for some time.

KIND_SLOW_DIGESTION.name: Slow Digestion
KIND_SLOW_DIGESTION.flavorText: This talisman will make you hungry less quickly when worn.

KIND_FIRE_RESISTANCE.name: Fire Resistance
KIND_FIRE_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This piece of jewellery grants you some protection from the burning heat of fire.

KIND_COLD_RESISTANCE.name: Cold Resistance
KIND_COLD_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This piece of jewellery grants you some protection from the chilling forces of cold.

KIND_LEVITATION.name: Levitation
KIND_LEVITATION.flavorText: When you put on this ring, you will be able to float just above the floor. It prevents you from drowning, and all your falls will be painless.

KIND_POISON_RESISTANCE.name: Poison Resistance
KIND_POISON_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This magical ring grants protection from poison. It is rumoured that in deep dungeons monsters can kill you at once if you don't have poison resistance.

KIND_FREE_ACTION.name: Free Action
KIND_FREE_ACTION.flavorText: This magical bauble prevents you from being held. Some monsters will paralyse you and then kill you if you lack free action.

KIND_FLAMES.name: Flames
KIND_FLAMES.flavorText: This fiery circlet grants you protection, makes fire less dangerous and even allows you to call forth a ball of flame.

KIND_ACID.name: Acid
KIND_ACID.flavorText: This magical ring is imbued with spells of devouring acid, granting protection against such assaults and the ability to shoot acid at your foes.

KIND_ICE.name: Ice
KIND_ICE.flavorText: A piece of paper inscribed with light-blue runes that radiate a strange cold. Upon reading them, a large icy blast will be released.

KIND_WOE.name: Woe
KIND_WOE.flavorText: This accursed ring will turn you into a bumbling fool and, in addition, magically transports you to places you never wanted to see. It can recurse itself if you leave it on too long.

KIND_DAMAGE.name: Damage
KIND_DAMAGE.flavorText: This ring makes your hands magically strong in combat, allowing you to inflict greater pain with your hand-to-hand attacks.

KIND_ACCURACY.name: Accuracy
KIND_ACCURACY.flavorText: This ring magically improves your control in combat, allowing you to hit more often.

KIND_PROTECTION.name: Protection
KIND_PROTECTION.flavorText: This ring creates a magical aura around you, protecting you against the blows of your enemies.

KIND_AGGRAVATE_MONSTER.name: Aggravate Monster
KIND_AGGRAVATE_MONSTER.flavorText: This nasty scroll will make a loud noise, waking up foes in your vicinity.

KIND_SEE_INVISIBLE.name: See Invisible
KIND_SEE_INVISIBLE.flavorText: This magical piece of jewellery allows your eyes to perceive beings otherwise unseen.

KIND_SUSTAIN_STRENGTH.name: Sustain Strength
KIND_SUSTAIN_STRENGTH.flavorText: This magical bauble protects your physical force against attacks attempting to drain it.

KIND_SUSTAIN_INTELLIGENCE.name: Sustain Intelligence
KIND_SUSTAIN_INTELLIGENCE.flavorText: This magical ring protects your intellect against attempts to lower it.

KIND_SUSTAIN_WISDOM.name: Sustain Wisdom
KIND_SUSTAIN_WISDOM.flavorText: This magical ring protects you from attempts to make you more foolish.

KIND_SUSTAIN_CONSTITUTION.name: Sustain Constitution
KIND_SUSTAIN_CONSTITUTION.flavorText: This magical ring protects your health, making it impossible for your opponents to lower it.

KIND_SUSTAIN_DEXTERITY.name: Sustain Dexterity
KIND_SUSTAIN_DEXTERITY.flavorText: This magical ring protects your nerves, so that you will never become clumsy.

KIND_SUSTAIN_CHARISMA.name: Sustain Charisma
KIND_SUSTAIN_CHARISMA.flavorText: This ring magically protects your beauty and charm from attempts to make you ugly.

KIND_SLAYING.name: Slaying
KIND_SLAYING.flavorText: This ring magically improves your fighting prowess, allowing to hit more often and harder.

KIND_BRILLIANCE.name: Brilliance
KIND_BRILLIANCE.flavorText: This talisman grants a sharper wit, greater insight and brightness to light dark places.

KIND_CHARISMA.name: Charisma
KIND_CHARISMA.flavorText: This potion infuses you with beauty and charm.

KIND_ACID_RESISTANCE.name: Acid Resistance
KIND_ACID_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This magical talisman will make the corroding forces of acid less threatening to your health.

KIND_DOUBLE_RING_MAIL.name: & Double Ring Mail~
KIND_DOUBLE_RING_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of leather armour with metal rings sewn onto it. In addition, in important parts it is reinforced with mail.

KIND_THE_MAGI.name: the Magi
KIND_THE_MAGI.flavorText: This rare amulet is highly desirable for mages, as it makes its wearer smarter, more attentive and impervious to magics which would make their own magic-use impossible.

KIND_DOOM.name: Doom
KIND_DOOM.flavorText: This wicked amulet will drain all your abilities, turning you into a mere shadow of yourself. It is exceedingly hard to get rid of.

KIND_ENCHANT_WEAPON_TO_HIT.name: Enchant Weapon To-Hit
KIND_ENCHANT_WEAPON_TO_HIT.flavorText: This magical scroll will allow you to improve the accuracy of a weapon in your possession. However, weapons which are already very highly enchanted are more difficult to improve further.

KIND_ENCHANT_WEAPON_TO_DAM.name: Enchant Weapon To-Dam
KIND_ENCHANT_WEAPON_TO_DAM.flavorText: Upon reading this scroll, a magical enchantment will be placed on a weapon in your possession, increasing the pain it inflicts when hitting. On very highly enchanted weapons this enchantment may fail, wasting the scroll.

KIND_ENCHANT_ARMOUR.name: *Enchant Armour*
KIND_ENCHANT_ARMOUR.flavorText: This scroll will place a great enchantment on a piece of armour of your choice, making it much better at protecting you. Mark that improving armours which are already highly enchanted is very difficult and will often fail.

KIND_RUMOUR.name: Rumour
KIND_RUMOUR.flavorText: A piece of paper inscribed with a little text. You may meditate over it or ignore it at your leisure.

KIND_CHAOS.name: Chaos
KIND_CHAOS.flavorText: A piece of paper inscribed with strange shifting runes. Upon reading them, they will release a blast of chaotic forces.

KIND_REMOVE_CURSE.name: *Remove Curse*
KIND_REMOVE_CURSE.flavorText: This valuable scroll is inscribed with a powerful blessing capable of dispelling all but the mightiest curses which may have been laid on your possessions.

KIND_LIGHT.name: Light
KIND_LIGHT.flavorText: This rod can shoot a lance of bright light, hurting creatures which lurk in the dark.

KIND_FIRE.name: [Fire]
KIND_FIRE.flavorText: A bright red crystal, filled with a liquid flame that scorches you even though the surface of the gem is cool to the touch.

KIND_SUMMON_MONSTERS.name: Summon Monsters
KIND_SUMMON_MONSTERS.flavorText: This scroll was made by mischievous sorcerers. If it is read, a few creatures will appear to fight you.

KIND_PHASE_DOOR.name: Phase Door
KIND_PHASE_DOOR.flavorText: Upon reading this scroll, you will be translocated over a short distance.

KIND_TELEPORT_LEVEL.name: Teleport Level
KIND_TELEPORT_LEVEL.flavorText: This scroll will magically transport you to the level directly above or below, when read.

KIND_MONSTER_CONFUSION.name: Monster Confusion
KIND_MONSTER_CONFUSION.flavorText: Reading this scroll will cause your hands to glow with a strange mesmerising light that will attempt to confuse the next creature you hit with a hand or weapon attack.

KIND_MAGIC_MAPPING.name: Magic Mapping
KIND_MAGIC_MAPPING.flavorText: Reading this scroll will reveal the layout of your immediate surroundings to you.

KIND_RUNE_OF_PROTECTION.name: Rune of Protection
KIND_RUNE_OF_PROTECTION.flavorText: This scroll is inscribed with a powerful protective incantation. When read, this will erect a strong magical ward around the location you currently stand on. Be aware that this magic is easily disturbed by already present structures and thus cannot work where an object is lying, or on a trap.

KIND_TREASURE_DETECTION.name: Treasure Detection
KIND_TREASURE_DETECTION.flavorText: This scroll magically reveals the locations of nearby loose change to you.

KIND_OBJECT_DETECTION.name: Object Detection
KIND_OBJECT_DETECTION.flavorText: This scroll shows nearby objects to you. It only makes you aware of items on the floor, however, not those carried by creatures.

KIND_SHEAF_ARROW.name: & Sheaf Arrow~
KIND_SHEAF_ARROW.flavorText: These arrows have bigger arrowheads and bigger feathers. They also make bigger holes.

KIND_MITHRIL_SHOT.name: & Mithril Shot~
KIND_MITHRIL_SHOT.flavorText: Sling bullets made from the slags of mithril smelting. They are unusually heavy, hitting with great force, and are almost imperishable.

KIND_DOOR_STAIR_LOCATION.name: Door/Stair Location
KIND_DOOR_STAIR_LOCATION.flavorText: When fuelled with enough ambient mana, this rod can detect nearby passages.

KIND_ACQUIREMENT.name: *Acquirement*
KIND_ACQUIREMENT.flavorText: Several great treasures have been hidden in a magical compartment. This scroll serves as the key and will release them when read.

KIND_MASS_GENOCIDE.name: Mass Genocide
KIND_MASS_GENOCIDE.flavorText: An astoundingly powerful death spell is stored in the runes of this spell.  Reading it will annihilate all nearby creatures. Only a few beings of legendary stature can withstand it.

KIND_DETECT_INVISIBLE.name: Detect Invisible
KIND_DETECT_INVISIBLE.flavorText: This magical concoction will temporarily improve your eyesight so that you can see creatures otherwise unseen.

KIND_ARTIFACT_CREATION.name: Artifact Creation
KIND_ARTIFACT_CREATION.flavorText: The mighty magic on this scroll will imbue a mundane item you possess with supernatural powers, also rendering the object indestructible.

KIND_RECHARGING.name: Recharging
KIND_RECHARGING.flavorText: This scroll is inscribed with a spell releasing the enchantments used to give wands and staves their power, allowing you to replenish their spent charges.

KIND_DARKNESS.name: Darkness
KIND_DARKNESS.flavorText: This scroll will create a blast of utter darkness, which then fades to leave the immediate surroundings in a lasting gloom. The extreme darkness can blind those who are not used to it.

KIND_PROTECTION_FROM_EVIL.name: Protection from Evil
KIND_PROTECTION_FROM_EVIL.flavorText: Upon reading the runes on this piece of paper, a faint aura of holiness will spring into existence around you, protecting you from blows of evil creatures, unless they are more powerful than you.

KIND_SATISFY_HUNGER.name: Satisfy Hunger
KIND_SATISFY_HUNGER.flavorText: Reading this scroll will transport a good portion of nourishing gruel directly into your stomach. Some people say that this is a ploy of a food producer whose food nobody wants to eat.

KIND_DISPEL_UNDEAD.name: Dispel Undead
KIND_DISPEL_UNDEAD.flavorText: A powerful exorcism is inscribed on this scroll. When read it will hurt undead abominations nearby, possibly even destroying them.

KIND_ENCHANT_WEAPON.name: *Enchant Weapon*
KIND_ENCHANT_WEAPON.flavorText: Reading this scroll will magically infuse a weapon of your choice, making it more effective in combat.

KIND_CURSE_WEAPON.name: Curse Weapon
KIND_CURSE_WEAPON.flavorText: This scroll will ruin your weapon beyond repair. Only weapons of legend have a hope of escaping destruction, but even they will often be shattered.

KIND_CURSE_ARMOUR.name: Curse Armour
KIND_CURSE_ARMOUR.flavorText: This scroll bears a curse that will tear your armour to shreds. Don't read it!

KIND_SUMMON_UNDEAD.name: Summon Undead
KIND_SUMMON_UNDEAD.flavorText: These spells scribed by ancient necromancers will call their horrible creatures to haunt you.

KIND_BLESSING.name: Blessing
KIND_BLESSING.flavorText: The recitation of this scroll will grant you a blessing of the Valar, making you more confident in attack and defence for a few moments.

KIND_HOLY_CHANT.name: Holy Chant
KIND_HOLY_CHANT.flavorText: This blessing will give you a holy warrior's prowess in battle for a while.

KIND_HOLY_PRAYER.name: Holy Prayer
KIND_HOLY_PRAYER.flavorText: This incantation lets you fight as a warrior of Valinor for quite a while, supreme in attack and defence.

KIND_WORD_OF_RECALL.name: Word of Recall
KIND_WORD_OF_RECALL.flavorText: The spell on this scroll will slowly build an ethereal conduit to the town for you if you are in a dungeon, and into the dungeon if you are above ground. Upon completion, which takes a while, you will suddenly be translocated to the other place.

KIND_DESTRUCTION.name: *Destruction*
KIND_DESTRUCTION.flavorText: This scroll is inscribed with a mighty conjuration which wrecks the dungeon all around you. Monsters and objects will be annihilated by this blast; only completely indestructible things can withstand it.

KIND_SLIME_MOLD_JUICE.name: Slime Mold Juice
KIND_SLIME_MOLD_JUICE.flavorText: A strange sort of yellowish-green slime, too viscous to even slosh in the bottle. And as I know you, you're going to slurp it down.

KIND_WATER.name: [Water]
KIND_WATER.flavorText: A large gem, filled with dark blue water. It feels strangely heavy and cold.

KIND_RESTORE_INTELLIGENCE.name: Restore Intelligence
KIND_RESTORE_INTELLIGENCE.flavorText: This beneficial potion will magically heal your brain, restoring drained intelligence.

KIND_WISDOM.name: Wisdom
KIND_WISDOM.flavorText: This magical amulet will magically make you wiser, and fend off attacks that would reduce your wisdom. Beware: if cursed, the amulet will do the opposite.

KIND_RESTORE_WISDOM.name: Restore Wisdom
KIND_RESTORE_WISDOM.flavorText: This potion benefits the naive, bringing back their wisdom to what it once was.

KIND_UGLINESS.name: Ugliness
KIND_UGLINESS.flavorText: This wicked potion slightly twists your features, making you appear less fair.

KIND_RESTORE_CHARISMA.name: Restore Charisma
KIND_RESTORE_CHARISMA.flavorText: This useful potion restores drained charm.

KIND_CURING.name: Curing
KIND_CURING.flavorText: This is a rod with minor healing powers, alleviating many disabling conditions.

KIND_INVULNERABILITY.name: Invulnerability
KIND_INVULNERABILITY.flavorText: This immensely powerful potion makes your physique almost indestructible for a very short time. Very rarely, an attempt to hurt you will still succeed, so don't be too confident.

KIND_NEW_LIFE.name: New Life
KIND_NEW_LIFE.flavorText: This potion fundamentally twists your physical features, as if you were another mother's child. Your physique will be shaped anew.

KIND_CURE_CRITICAL_WOUNDS.name: Cure Critical Wounds
KIND_CURE_CRITICAL_WOUNDS.flavorText: This nice potion will cure a good bit of hurt you have suffered and also allows you to recover from unhealthy conditions like blood poisoning, confusion or blindness.

KIND_HEALING.name: *Healing*
KIND_HEALING.flavorText: This highly desirable potion will greatly help recovering from wounds, typically healing you fully.

KIND_EXPERIENCE.name: Experience
KIND_EXPERIENCE.flavorText: This exceptional drink instills into you knowledge, allowing you to advance further in your trade.

KIND_SLEEP.name: Sleep
KIND_SLEEP.flavorText: This potion was made to help people with bad sleeping disorders to find rest. Surely you don't want to take a nap while nasty goblins are searching for you?

KIND_BOOZE.name: Booze
KIND_BOOZE.flavorText: A small bottle of a dark brown distilled beverage. By its look and smell, it contains a fair amount of still muck and wood alcohol.

KIND_SLOWNESS.name: Slowness
KIND_SLOWNESS.flavorText: A magical concoction which drains force from you, forcing you to move and act a lot slower, until it wears off.

KIND_RESTORE_DEXTERITY.name: Restore Dexterity
KIND_RESTORE_DEXTERITY.flavorText: This magical brew brings your agility back to its former glory should it have been reduced.

KIND_LOSE_MEMORIES.name: Lose Memories
KIND_LOSE_MEMORIES.flavorText: A wicked potion, making you less of an adventurer than by right you should be.

KIND_SALT_WATER.name: Salt Water
KIND_SALT_WATER.flavorText: A solution of salt in water, made for curing meat. Drinking it would cause violent nausea.

KIND_ENLIGHTENMENT.name: *Enlightenment*
KIND_ENLIGHTENMENT.flavorText: This magical concoction will grant you great insight, magically improving your wits and wisdom, letting you know precisely who and where you are and what you possess.

KIND_HEROISM.name: Heroism
KIND_HEROISM.flavorText: Quaffing this drink will temporarily make you fight like a hero of great might.

KIND_BERSERK_STRENGTH.name: Berserk Strength
KIND_BERSERK_STRENGTH.flavorText: This strange drink will instill in you a wild battle rage for a while.

KIND_BOLDNESS.name: Boldness
KIND_BOLDNESS.flavorText: This drink will improve your courage, dispelling all fear.

KIND_RESTORE_LIFE_LEVELS.name: Restore Life Levels
KIND_RESTORE_LIFE_LEVELS.flavorText: If your life force has been drained, this blessed brew will bring it back.

KIND_RESIST_HEAT.name: Resist Heat
KIND_RESIST_HEAT.flavorText: This magical potion will make fire flow in your veins, rendering you less vulnerable to outward heat.

KIND_RESIST_COLD.name: Resist Cold
