KIND_RESIST_COLD.flavorText: This magical potion will for a short while grant you a familiarity with frost, so that you take less harm from extreme cold.

KIND_SLOW_POISON.name: Slow Poison
KIND_SLOW_POISON.flavorText: This healthy potion will dilute poisons in your blood.

KIND_NEUTRALISE_POISON.name: Neutralise Poison
KIND_NEUTRALISE_POISON.flavorText: This powerful antidote will completely negate the effect of poisons currently affecting you.

KIND_RESTORE_MANA.name: Restore Mana
KIND_RESTORE_MANA.flavorText: This potion infuses the drinker with pure magic force, bringing their magical potential back to its full extent.

KIND_INFRA_VISION.name: Infra-vision
KIND_INFRA_VISION.flavorText: This potion temporarily grants or improves the ability to optically perceive heat sources.

KIND_RESISTANCE.name: Resistance
KIND_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This amulet will make the wearer resist the elements.

KIND_TIDAL_WAVE.name: Tidal Wave
KIND_TIDAL_WAVE.flavorText: A standard Tidal Wave from ToME.

KIND_ICE_STORM.name: Ice Storm
KIND_ICE_STORM.flavorText: A standard Ice Storm from ToME.

KIND_NOXIOUS_CLOUD.name: Noxious Cloud
KIND_NOXIOUS_CLOUD.flavorText: A standard Noxious Cloud from ToME.

KIND_POISON_BLOOD.name: Poison Blood
KIND_POISON_BLOOD.flavorText: A standard Poison Blood from ToME.

KIND_STONE_PRISON.name: Stone Prison
KIND_STONE_PRISON.flavorText: A standard Stone Prison from ToME.

KIND_TELEPORT_AWAY.name: Teleport Away
KIND_TELEPORT_AWAY.flavorText: A standard Teleport Away from ToME.

KIND_SUMMON_ANIMAL.name: Summon Animal
KIND_SUMMON_ANIMAL.flavorText: A standard Summon Animal from ToME.

KIND_SLOW_MONSTER.name: Slow Monster
KIND_SLOW_MONSTER.flavorText: This obstructive rod emits an energy bolt which will slow the creature it hits.

KIND_ESSENCE_OF_SPEED.name: Essence of Speed
KIND_ESSENCE_OF_SPEED.flavorText: A standard Essence of Speed from ToME.

KIND_DISPERSE_MAGIC.name: Disperse Magic
KIND_DISPERSE_MAGIC.flavorText: A standard Disperse Magic from ToME.

KIND_DEMON_BLADE.name: Demon Blade
KIND_DEMON_BLADE.flavorText: A standard Demon Blade from ToME.

KIND_HEAL_MONSTER.name: Heal Monster
KIND_HEAL_MONSTER.flavorText: A standard Heal Monster from ToME.

KIND_HASTE_MONSTER.name: Haste Monster
KIND_HASTE_MONSTER.flavorText: A standard Haste Monster from ToME.

KIND_FLIGHT_ARROW.name: & Flight Arrow~
KIND_FLIGHT_ARROW.flavorText: An arrow designed for longer flight. Consequently, it is lighter and hits with less force.

KIND_BOULDER.name: & Boulder~
KIND_BOULDER.flavorText: A big nasty-looking piece of rock.

KIND_NECROMANTIC_TEETH.name: & Necromantic Teeth~
KIND_NECROMANTIC_TEETH.flavorText: This looks like some animal's teeth or at least you think it comes from an animal...

KIND_SPELL.name: Spell
KIND_SPELL.flavorText: This amulet is a container for spells. Those that are skilled in copying spells can inscribe a spell into it.

KIND_GLOBE_OF_LIGHT.name: Globe of Light
KIND_GLOBE_OF_LIGHT.flavorText: A standard Globe of Light from ToME.

KIND_FIERY_SHIELD.name: Fiery Shield
KIND_FIERY_SHIELD.flavorText: A standard Fiery Shield from ToME.

KIND_REMOVE_CURSES.name: Remove Curses
KIND_REMOVE_CURSES.flavorText: A standard Remove Curses from ToME.

KIND_WINGS_OF_WINDS.name: Wings of Winds
KIND_WINGS_OF_WINDS.flavorText: A standard Wings of Winds from ToME.

KIND_PROBABILITY_TRAVEL.name: Probability Travel
KIND_PROBABILITY_TRAVEL.flavorText: A standard Probability Travel from ToME.

KIND_SENSE_HIDDEN.name: Sense Hidden
KIND_SENSE_HIDDEN.flavorText: A standard Sense Hidden from ToME.

KIND_REVEAL_WAYS.name: Reveal Ways
KIND_REVEAL_WAYS.flavorText: A standard Reveal Ways from ToME.

KIND_SENSE_MONSTERS.name: Sense Monsters
KIND_SENSE_MONSTERS.flavorText: A standard Sense Monsters from ToME.

KIND_MANA.name: [Mana]
KIND_MANA.flavorText: A large gem that seems somehow immaterial and is filled with a strange insubstantial... power?

KIND_TOME_OF_MAGICAL_ENERGY.name: & Tome~ of Magical Energy
KIND_TOME_OF_MAGICAL_ENERGY.flavorText: The bright blue cover of this tome seems to glow with an inner violet light. You feel more attuned to raw magic as you hold it.

KIND_TOME_OF_THE_ETERNAL_FLAME.name: & Tome~ of the Eternal Flame
KIND_TOME_OF_THE_ETERNAL_FLAME.flavorText: The cover of this tome is bright red, with flickering flames dancing across it once in a while. As you hold it, you begin to gain a much closer knowledge of all that is fiery.

KIND_TOME_OF_THE_BLOWING_WIND.name: & Tome~ of the Blowing Wind
KIND_TOME_OF_THE_BLOWING_WIND.flavorText: The pages of this tome have a tendency to turn themselves, as though flipped by an errant wind. As you hold it, you start feeling wind at your fingertips.

KIND_TOME_OF_THE_IMPENETRABLE_EARTH.name: & Tome~ of the Impenetrable Earth
KIND_TOME_OF_THE_IMPENETRABLE_EARTH.flavorText: The solid leather cover of this tome seems permanently stained with caked mud and grass. Heavy it is to lift, yet strangely comforting to hold - you feel stronger and better supported.

KIND_TOME_OF_THE_EVERRUNNING_WAVE.name: & Tome~ of the Everrunning Wave
KIND_TOME_OF_THE_EVERRUNNING_WAVE.flavorText: The cover and pages of this tome seem to be perpetually wet, though they are not wet to the touch. As you hold it, you begin to understand ocean storms better.

KIND_TOME_OF_TRANSLOCATION.name: & Tome~ of Translocation
KIND_TOME_OF_TRANSLOCATION.flavorText: This book seems to flicker strangely. It's one of those books with an annoying tendency to disappear when you need it and reappear in the unlikeliest places. As you hold it, you start to understand what conveyance really means.

KIND_TOME_OF_THE_TREE.name: & Tome~ of the Tree
KIND_TOME_OF_THE_TREE.flavorText: The cover of this tome is a bright shade of green, and it gives off a healthy, zesty scent that makes your thoughts clearer. As you hold it, your heart goes out to all living things upon Arda.

KIND_TOME_OF_KNOWLEDGE.name: & Tome~ of Knowledge
KIND_TOME_OF_KNOWLEDGE.flavorText: A thick book with solid leather binding. It looks entirely unremarkable, but as you hold it, you feel strangely able to learn the inner workings of things and creatures.

KIND_IRON_SPIKE.name: & Iron Spike~
KIND_IRON_SPIKE.flavorText: A small spur of iron. Ramming one between a door and its frame might jam it.

KIND_WOODEN_TORCH.name: & Wooden Torch~
KIND_WOODEN_TORCH.flavorText: A piece of wood with an oily rag wrapped around it. When lit, it will give off a little light and much smoke.

KIND_BRASS_LANTERN.name: & Brass Lantern~
KIND_BRASS_LANTERN.flavorText: A brass container with a wick emerging from it, protected from draughts by a sheet of greased paper. It can be carried by a handle.

KIND_FLASK_OF_OIL.name: & Flask~ of oil
KIND_FLASK_OF_OIL.flavorText: A small clay container, filled with thick oil. The oil is flammable and can be used as lantern fuel.

KIND_EMPTY_BOTTLE.name: & Empty Bottle~
KIND_EMPTY_BOTTLE.flavorText: A small glass bottle. It's empty.

KIND_HAVOC.name: Havoc
KIND_HAVOC.flavorText: This powerful rod will release great blasts of destructive energy, but there's no knowing what this effect will concentrate on.

KIND_RECALL.name: Recall
KIND_RECALL.flavorText: A rod which can transport you from the depths to your home and back.

KIND_ILLUMINATION.name: Illumination
KIND_ILLUMINATION.flavorText: This rod carries a minor spell of brightness, lighting your immediate surroundings whenever activated.

KIND_LIGHTNING_BOLTS.name: Lightning Bolts
KIND_LIGHTNING_BOLTS.flavorText: This rod shoots a small spark of lightning, zapping the creature it hits.

KIND_FROST_BOLTS.name: Frost Bolts
KIND_FROST_BOLTS.flavorText: A small but extremely cold shard of ice will fly from this rod to your enemy.

KIND_FIRE_BOLTS.name: Fire Bolts
KIND_FIRE_BOLTS.flavorText: This rod fires a magical flaming arrow at your foe, burning it.

KIND_POLYMORPH.name: Polymorph
KIND_POLYMORPH.flavorText: This rod of change will cause its target creature to mutate into something else.

KIND_SLEEP_MONSTER.name: Sleep Monster
KIND_SLEEP_MONSTER.flavorText: This sorcerous rod will cause its target to stop in its tracks.

KIND_DRAIN_LIFE.name: Drain Life
KIND_DRAIN_LIFE.flavorText: This necromantic magical rod will hurt a living creature struck by its spell.

KIND_TELEPORT_OTHER.name: Teleport Other
KIND_TELEPORT_OTHER.flavorText: This rod of movement will displace its target to another location.

KIND_LIGHTNING_BALLS.name: Lightning Balls
KIND_LIGHTNING_BALLS.flavorText: This rod will hurl a large ball of lightning at its target, electrifying all it engulfs.

KIND_COLD_BALLS.name: Cold Balls
KIND_COLD_BALLS.flavorText: This rod will call forth a minor storm of ice which freezes everything in the area of its blast.

KIND_FIRE_BALLS.name: Fire Balls
KIND_FIRE_BALLS.flavorText: This rod will cause a small storm of flame to rage in a small circular area of your choice.

KIND_ACID_BALLS.name: Acid Balls
KIND_ACID_BALLS.flavorText: This destructive rod will drown its target and its immediate surroundings in caustic acid.

KIND_ACID_BOLTS.name: Acid Bolts
KIND_ACID_BOLTS.flavorText: This rod will shoot a small glob of powerful acid at its target.

KIND_DETECTION.name: Detection
KIND_DETECTION.flavorText: This rod grants knowledge about all things worthy of notice in your vicinity.

KIND_RESTORATION.name: Restoration
KIND_RESTORATION.flavorText: This rod lets you remember your previous abilities and gain them back, should they have been reduced.

KIND_BROKEN_SKULL.name: & Broken Skull~
KIND_BROKEN_SKULL.flavorText: Good old Yorick. So that's where he ended up.

KIND_BROKEN_BONE.name: & Broken Bone~
KIND_BROKEN_BONE.flavorText: A yellowish bone, broken off. Obviously, its owner no longer has a use for it.

KIND_RODENT_SKELETON.name: & Rodent Skeleton~
KIND_RODENT_SKELETON.flavorText: The remains of a cat's meal.

KIND_DWARF_SKELETON.name: & Dwarf Skeleton~
KIND_DWARF_SKELETON.flavorText: The remains of a dwarf who met his or her demise here.

KIND_ELF_SKELETON.name: & Elf Skeleton~
KIND_ELF_SKELETON.flavorText: A person of about human shape, but considerably more slightly built, has died here long ago.

KIND_GNOME_SKELETON.name: & Gnome Skeleton~
KIND_GNOME_SKELETON.flavorText: This was once a gnome. Looks very dead now.

KIND_GREAT_HAMMER.name: & Great Hammer~
KIND_GREAT_HAMMER.flavorText: A massive smith's hammer, so large and heavy it can be used as a weapon.

KIND_BLACK_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Black Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_BLACK_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: An armour made of a black dragon's hide, containing some of this beast's powers.

KIND_BLUE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Blue Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_BLUE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A piece of dragon hide fashioned into an armour, shimmering bright blue.

KIND_WHITE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & White Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_WHITE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: An armour fashioned from dragon hide, glistening the white of snow.

KIND_RED_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Red Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_RED_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: The skin of a dragon made into a suit of armour. It glows a bright red and radiates heat.

KIND_GREEN_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Green Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_GREEN_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour fashioned of dragon hide. It is dirty green and smells awful.

KIND_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Multi-Hued Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A powerful armour made of dragonhide. It glows red, blue, green, black and white.

KIND_PSEUDO_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Pseudo Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_PSEUDO_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made of dragon hide, glowing with a strange light, or is it darkness?

KIND_LAW_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Law Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_LAW_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A piece of dragonhide cut and shaped so it can be worn as armour. The scales are very sharp, and the roaring of a storm seems to come from it, but you're not afraid of either.

KIND_BRONZE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Bronze Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_BRONZE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made from dragon skin. Its brownish scales glitter in a dazzling light.

KIND_GOLD_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Gold Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_GOLD_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of golden-hued armour made of dragonhide. The rustle of its scales occasionally increases to a loud boom.

KIND_CHAOS_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Chaos Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_CHAOS_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made of dragon hide. It glows in colours you have never seen before. As you put it on, you feel like you could change the world and are no longer afraid of your equipment losing its magic.

KIND_BALANCE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Balance Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_BALANCE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made of the hide of a dead dragon. When wearing it, you feel like you understand the principles of law and chaos, and no longer fear either.

KIND_POWER_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Power Dragon Scale Mail~
KIND_POWER_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made of a very thick richly coloured dragonhide. You think you'll never have to fear dragons if you put it on.

KIND_DRAGON_HELM.name: & Dragon Helm~
KIND_DRAGON_HELM.flavorText: An iron helmet, covered with a layer of dragonhide. It offers great protection and may grant protection against some dragon's attacks, based on the dragon the hide was taken from.

KIND_DRAGON_SHIELD.name: & Dragon Shield~
KIND_DRAGON_SHIELD.flavorText: A large shield, with a dragonskin cover. Depending on which dragon the hide came from, it might grant protection against some sorts of dragon breath.

KIND_DEATH.name: Death
KIND_DEATH.flavorText: A potent and very quickly working poison, sometimes utilised by those who wish to end their lives. It is immensely toxic and will seriously hurt you even if you just get some of it on your hands.

KIND_RUINATION.name: Ruination
KIND_RUINATION.flavorText: This wicked potion will seriously damage your abilities beyond the powers of magical restoration.

KIND_DETONATIONS.name: Detonations
KIND_DETONATIONS.flavorText: This bottle is filled with a strange substance which will violently explode if strongly agitated. You don't want to know what it might do to your intestines.

KIND_AUGMENTATION.name: Augmentation
KIND_AUGMENTATION.flavorText: This blessed potion will greatly improve all your abilities, if they can still be improved.

KIND_LIFE.name: Life
KIND_LIFE.flavorText: This wonderful potion will fully heal you no matter how badly you're hurt, allow drained abilities to recover and remove various other ailments.

KIND_FEAR_RESISTANCE.name: Fear Resistance
KIND_FEAR_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring grants courage, so that you can never become afraid.

KIND_LIGHT_AND_DARKNESS_RESISTANCE.name: Light and Darkness Resistance
KIND_LIGHT_AND_DARKNESS_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring protects against fluctuations of the light.

KIND_NETHER_RESISTANCE.name: Nether Resistance
KIND_NETHER_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This blessed ring improves your life force, protecting you from the draining forces of nether and other attempts to suck your lifeblood.

KIND_NEXUS_RESISTANCE.name: Nexus Resistance
KIND_NEXUS_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring of stability protects you from the warping forces of nexus.

KIND_SOUND_RESISTANCE.name: Sound Resistance
KIND_SOUND_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring projects an aura of quiet around you, protecting you from loud noise.

KIND_CONFUSION_RESISTANCE.name: Confusion Resistance
KIND_CONFUSION_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring stabilises your mind, protecting you from all kinds of befuddlement.

KIND_SHARD_RESISTANCE.name: Shard Resistance
KIND_SHARD_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This piece of jewellery magically toughens your skin, protecting you from flying shrapnel.

KIND_DISENCHANTMENT_RESISTANCE.name: Disenchantment Resistance
KIND_DISENCHANTMENT_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This rare ring of preservation protects your equipment from attempts to sap its magic, also causing you to suffer less pain from such attacks.

KIND_CHAOS_RESISTANCE.name: Chaos Resistance
KIND_CHAOS_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring protects you from the horribly warping forces of chaos.

KIND_BLINDNESS_RESISTANCE.name: Blindness Resistance
KIND_BLINDNESS_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring magically preserves your eyesight, making you impervious to any attempt to blind you.

KIND_LORDLY_PROTECTION.name: Lordly Protection
KIND_LORDLY_PROTECTION.flavorText: This blessed ring will protect you from disenchantment, poison, attempts to drain your life force and holding magic.

KIND_EXTRA_ATTACKS.name: Extra Attacks
KIND_EXTRA_ATTACKS.flavorText: This powerful ring of fighters greatly enhances your fighting speed, allowing you to attack more often in a round of combat.

KIND_CURE_LIGHT_WOUNDS.name: Cure Light Wounds
KIND_CURE_LIGHT_WOUNDS.flavorText: This healthy drink heals a little damage you have taken.

KIND_CLUMSINESS.name: Clumsiness
KIND_CLUMSINESS.flavorText: This nasty concoction will numb your nerves, making you clumsier.

KIND_SICKLINESS.name: Sickliness
KIND_SICKLINESS.flavorText: This unhealthy drink damages your health, reducing your physical constitution.

KIND_SILVER_ARROW.name: & Silver Arrow~
KIND_SILVER_ARROW.flavorText: An arrow to be shot with a bow, its iron head coated with hallowed silver, a material that sears the flesh of all evil creatures.

KIND_SILVER_BOLT.name: & Silver Bolt~
KIND_SILVER_BOLT.flavorText: This crossbow bolt has a silver tip, blessed by the Valar for fighting evil.

KIND_LIGHTNING_RESISTANCE.name: Lightning Resistance
KIND_LIGHTNING_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This amulet will protect you from electrical discharges and storms.

KIND_REGENERATION.name: Regeneration
KIND_REGENERATION.flavorText: Wearing this amulet will trigger your body's regenerational processes quicker and make them proceed faster.

KIND_INFRAVISION.name: Infravision
KIND_INFRAVISION.flavorText: This amulet will increase your ability to sense warm-blooded creatures in your vicinity. Beware: if cursed, it will do just the opposite.

KIND_DEVOTION.name: Devotion
KIND_DEVOTION.flavorText: This blessed amulet will protect your wisdom and charms from diminishing, often adding to them as well. It also grants some extra protective magics by the grace of the Valar.

KIND_WEAPONMASTERY.name: Weaponmastery
KIND_WEAPONMASTERY.flavorText: The ultimate amulet for a warrior, it will grant protection in the face of some evil magics, protect your strength and health, also increasing them. Beware: if cursed, the amulet will sap your strength and health instead.

KIND_TRICKERY.name: Trickery
KIND_TRICKERY.flavorText: The ultimate amulet for a rogue or assassin, it protects the wearer against some evil magics, granting improvements in the abilities vital to these adventurers. Beware: if cursed, the amulet will do just the opposite.

KIND_TELEPATHY.name: Telepathy
KIND_TELEPATHY.flavorText: This rare and powerful amulet lays bare the minds of monsters before the wearer.

KIND_SUSTENANCE.name: Sustenance
KIND_SUSTENANCE.flavorText: This blessed amulet will make the wearer impervious to evil magics that would sap innate abilities. It also slows down the digestive system, making food less necessary on long journeys.

KIND_MIGHTY_HAMMER.name: & Mighty Hammer~
KIND_MIGHTY_HAMMER.flavorText: A standard & Mighty Hammer~ from ToME.

KIND_MASSIVE_IRON_CROWN.name: & Massive Iron Crown~
KIND_MASSIVE_IRON_CROWN.flavorText: A standard & Massive Iron Crown~ from ToME.

KIND_REFLECTION.name: Reflection
KIND_REFLECTION.flavorText: This wondrous amulet will magically make the wearer reflect arrows and bolts launched by adversaries.

KIND_ANTI_MAGIC.name: Anti-Magic
KIND_ANTI_MAGIC.flavorText: This amulet wards off magic of any kind, good or bad.

KIND_ANTI_TELEPORTATION.name: Anti-Teleportation
KIND_ANTI_TELEPORTATION.flavorText: This amulet will prevent the space-time continuum from being disrupted around the wearer.

KIND_ZWEIHANDER.name: & Zweihander~
KIND_ZWEIHANDER.flavorText: This great sword of foreign origin is approximately 6 feet long. The hilt is long enough for even four hands to grip. A mighty weapon for a warrior.

KIND_SPLINT_MAIL.name: & Splint Mail~
KIND_SPLINT_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of metal armour that consists of metal strips applied vertically to the backing of chain, leather, or cloth.

KIND_TRIFURCATE_SPEAR.name: & Trifurcate Spear~
KIND_TRIFURCATE_SPEAR.flavorText: This deadly spear's point has three branches, suited for inflicting greater damage than a regular spear.

KIND_THREE_PIECE_ROD.name: & Three Piece Rod~
KIND_THREE_PIECE_ROD.flavorText: A descendant of the threshing flail, consisting of three short wooden pieces linked by chain or rope.

KIND_FUR_CLOAK.name: & Fur Cloak~
KIND_FUR_CLOAK.flavorText: A coat made from the fur of various wild animals - it is somewhat bulky, but still spacious enough to wear over armour.

KIND_WATER_CURING.name: Water Curing
KIND_WATER_CURING.flavorText: It is a magical component that can purify water.

KIND_HATCHET.name: & Hatchet~
KIND_HATCHET.flavorText: This is a large axe that could be wielded in one or two hands.  It has a single blade with a pick on the reverse, designed for armour piercing.

KIND_RHINO_HIDE_ARMOUR.name: & Rhino Hide Armour~
KIND_RHINO_HIDE_ARMOUR.flavorText: A hard leather armour made from the thick hide of a rhinoceros.

KIND_LEATHER_JACKET.name: & Leather Jacket~
KIND_LEATHER_JACKET.flavorText: A garment fashioned from animal hide, resembling a robe that has been shortened to waist-length, with straight-cut sleeves and a bit of decorative fringe around the collar.

KIND_SICKLE.name: & Sickle~
KIND_SICKLE.flavorText: A semicircular blade attached to a short handle, good for chopping things up into pieces.

KIND_CLUB.name: & Club~
KIND_CLUB.flavorText: A stout heavy stick, thicker at one end. Useful for shattering and smashing things.

KIND_BROAD_SPEAR.name: & Broad Spear~
KIND_BROAD_SPEAR.flavorText: Designed specifically for foot soldiers combatting cavalry, this spear is too heavy to be effective when thrown.

KIND_KHOPESH.name: & Khopesh~
KIND_KHOPESH.flavorText: This sword comes from the regions of Far Harad. The blade is straight for 18 inches, and then it curves for another 2 feet.

KIND_FLAMBERGE.name: & Flamberge~
KIND_FLAMBERGE.flavorText: A large, two-handed sword with a blade that weaves left and right until it reaches the hilt.

KIND_CLAYMORE.name: & Claymore~
KIND_CLAYMORE.flavorText: Also known as a Claidhmore, or Greatsword, this weapon is favoured by powerful mercenaries. The blade is large, straight, and broad, almost as large as a two-handed sword.

KIND_ESPADON.name: & Espadon~
KIND_ESPADON.flavorText: This is the strictly two-handed version of the bastard sword. The blade is of medium length, double-edged, and considerably heavy to wield.

KIND_GREAT_SCIMITAR.name: & Great Scimitar~
KIND_GREAT_SCIMITAR.flavorText: This is a larger version of the curved oriental blade. Runes of war decorate its golden hilt.

KIND_FAUCHARD.name: & Fauchard~
KIND_FAUCHARD.flavorText: It is a type of glaive with two ornate hooks on the back of the blade. It is typically 8 to 9 feet long.

KIND_GUISARME.name: & Guisarme~
KIND_GUISARME.flavorText: Mounted on a long shaft for maximum reach, this weapon is effective at repelling both cavalry and infantry.

KIND_HEAVY_LANCE.name: & Heavy Lance~
KIND_HEAVY_LANCE.flavorText: This is a shock weapon. Its purpose is to unhorse a rider in single combat, or smash through the armour of opposing lines.

KIND_BASILARD.name: & Basilard~
KIND_BASILARD.flavorText: This is a two-edged dagger with a long blade. A favourite among travellers and warriors alike, it can be worn comfortably with plain clothes as well as armour.

KIND_RING_MAIL.name: & Ring Mail~
KIND_RING_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of non-overlapping metal rings sewn onto a heavy leather backing.

KIND_CORD_ARMOUR.name: & Cord Armour~
KIND_CORD_ARMOUR.flavorText: Fibres of hemp or other natural material woven and knotted into a thick, tough fabric.

KIND_PAPER_ARMOUR.name: & Paper Armour~
KIND_PAPER_ARMOUR.flavorText: Thickly pleated sheets of paper assembled together into a suit of armour.

KIND_PADDED_ARMOUR.name: & Padded Armour~
KIND_PADDED_ARMOUR.flavorText: Heavy, multi-layered cloth sewn together to cover the body, with extra padding between layers.

KIND_STONE_AND_HIDE_ARMOUR.name: & Stone and Hide Armour~
KIND_STONE_AND_HIDE_ARMOUR.flavorText: A primitive armour made from a thick hide reinforced by stone shards.

KIND_BLOOD_OF_LIFE.name: & Blood~ of Life
KIND_BLOOD_OF_LIFE.flavorText: Quaffing this measure of living blood will imbue your body and soul with the power to escape death one time.

KIND_MAGE_STAFF.name: & Mage Staff~
KIND_MAGE_STAFF.flavorText: It looks like a simple walking stick, plain and nondescript. In the hands of a spellcaster, it can be a deadly weapon.

KIND_LIGHTNING.name: Lightning
KIND_LIGHTNING.flavorText: This sparkling circlet grants you protection, makes electricity less dangerous and even allows you to call forth a ball of lightning.

KIND_INVISIBILITY.name: Invisibility
KIND_INVISIBILITY.flavorText: This magical bauble will hide you from sight.

KIND_CORRUPTION.name: Corruption
KIND_CORRUPTION.flavorText: This concoction of toxic wastes will strangely warp your shape.

KIND_DEEP_THOUGHTS.name: Deep Thoughts
KIND_DEEP_THOUGHTS.flavorText: This parchment contains the thoughts of a powerful wizard who departed Middle-earth long ago.

KIND_MORE_DEEP_THOUGHTS.name: More Deep Thoughts
KIND_MORE_DEEP_THOUGHTS.flavorText: This parchment contains the thoughts of a powerful wizard who departed Middle-earth long ago.

KIND_COMPENDIUM_OF_DEEP_THOUGHTS.name: Compendium of Deep Thoughts
KIND_COMPENDIUM_OF_DEEP_THOUGHTS.flavorText: This parchment contains the thoughts of a powerful wizard who departed Middle-earth long ago.

KIND_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_I.name: Artifact Lore Vol. I
KIND_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_I.flavorText: This parchment contains information about unique artifacts that are rumoured to exist upon Arda.

KIND_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_II.name: Artifact Lore Vol. II
KIND_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_II.flavorText: This parchment contains information about unique artifacts that are rumoured to exist upon Arda.

KIND_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_III.name: Artifact Lore Vol. III
KIND_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_III.flavorText: This parchment contains information about unique artifacts that are rumoured to exist upon Arda.

KIND_MORPHIC_OIL_OF.name: & Morphic Oil~ of #
KIND_MORPHIC_OIL_OF.flavorText: This concoction can transform your body for a short period of time.

KIND_CLOAK_OF_MIMICRY.name: Cloak of Mimicry
KIND_CLOAK_OF_MIMICRY.flavorText: Combined with proper skill, this cloak can make you seem like a different creature. Otherwise, it just provides some extra protection.

KIND_CORPSE.name: corpse
KIND_CORPSE.flavorText: Whatever happened with this one, it wasn't pretty.

KIND_SKELETON.name: skeleton
KIND_SKELETON.flavorText: The sorry, bony remains of some hapless creature.

KIND_HEAD.name: head
KIND_HEAD.flavorText: 2 eyes, 2 ears, a mouth, some hair -- yep, that's a head.

KIND_SKULL.name: skull
KIND_SKULL.flavorText: It's a white bony skull, smiling to you without teeth.

KIND_RAW_MEAT.name: raw meat
KIND_RAW_MEAT.flavorText: Yuck, just looking at it makes your stomach upset.

KIND_THUNDERLORD_COAT.name: & Thunderlord Coat~
KIND_THUNDERLORD_COAT.flavorText: This suit of thick impregnated cloth is worn by the riders of flying steeds, and protects them from extremes of temperatures.

KIND_SMALL_WOODEN_BOOMERANG.name: & Small Wooden Boomerang~
KIND_SMALL_WOODEN_BOOMERANG.flavorText: A small curved piece of wood.

KIND_WOODEN_BOOMERANG.name: & Wooden Boomerang~
KIND_WOODEN_BOOMERANG.flavorText: A strange, curved leaf-shaped piece of wood.

KIND_SMALL_METAL_BOOMERANG.name: & Small Metal Boomerang~
KIND_SMALL_METAL_BOOMERANG.flavorText: A short boomerang with metal blades on the "forward" edges.

KIND_METAL_BOOMERANG.name: & Metal Boomerang~
KIND_METAL_BOOMERANG.flavorText: A strange curved leaf-shaped piece of wood, its "forward" edges enhanced with metal blades.

KIND_SUMMON_NEVER_MOVING_PET.name: Summon Never-Moving Pet
KIND_SUMMON_NEVER_MOVING_PET.flavorText: A piece of paper, inscribed with runes which will summon an immobile creature to your aid.

KIND_CURE_LIGHT_INSANITY.name: Cure Light Insanity
KIND_CURE_LIGHT_INSANITY.flavorText: A magical potion which drives away irrational quirks of behaviour.

KIND_CURE_SERIOUS_INSANITY.name: Cure Serious Insanity
KIND_CURE_SERIOUS_INSANITY.flavorText: A magical brew which will lift shadows that have been cast on your soul.

KIND_CURE_CRITICAL_INSANITY.name: Cure Critical Insanity
KIND_CURE_CRITICAL_INSANITY.flavorText: This drink will cure you even of serious mental disorders.

KIND_CURE_INSANITY.name: Cure Insanity
KIND_CURE_INSANITY.flavorText: This blessed potion can make you completely sane and healthy, even if you have only the faintest shred of sanity left.

KIND_RANDOM_ARTIFACT.name: Random Artifact
KIND_RANDOM_ARTIFACT.flavorText: A standard Random Artifact from ToME.

KIND_CRAFTSMANSHIP.name: Craftsmanship
KIND_CRAFTSMANSHIP.flavorText: A powerful scroll, desired by many, as it can magically improve the special powers of magical weaponry.

KIND_HORN.name: & Horn~
KIND_HORN.flavorText: A simple wind instrument made from brass. If used by inexperienced musicians it sounds like somebody making "prbbt!" noises down a drainpipe.

KIND_DRUM.name: & Drum~
KIND_DRUM.flavorText: A sort of clay pot with a bit of skin stretched over its mouth.

KIND_HARP.name: & Harp~
KIND_HARP.flavorText: A number of strings held by a wooden frame.

KIND_RESET_RECALL.name: Reset Recall
KIND_RESET_RECALL.flavorText: A strange formula is inscribed on this scroll, which allows you to define another place as the location to which recalls shall move you.

KIND_DIVINATION.name: Divination
KIND_DIVINATION.flavorText: This scroll is inscribed with a ritual which allows you to discern what fate holds in store for you.

KIND_SPRIG_OF_ATHELAS.name: & Sprig~ of Athelas
KIND_SPRIG_OF_ATHELAS.flavorText: 'When the black breath blows / And death's shadow grows / And all lights pass / Come Athelas! Come Athelas! / Life to the dying / In the King's hands lying.'

KIND_OLD_SCROLL_OF_DEINCARNATION.name: & Old Scroll~ of Deincarnation
KIND_OLD_SCROLL_OF_DEINCARNATION.flavorText: It allows you to leave your body to reincarnate into another one. However, your current body is lost in the process.

KIND_DARK_SWORD.name: & Dark Sword~
KIND_DARK_SWORD.flavorText: A strange, very sharp long sword, which seems to drain light from its surroundings. As you wield it, you feel much less attuned to magic.

KIND_NUMENOREAN_FOR_BEGINNERS_I.name: Numenorean for Beginners (I)
KIND_NUMENOREAN_FOR_BEGINNERS_I.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

KIND_NUMENOREAN_FOR_BEGINNERS_II.name: Numenorean for Beginners (II)
KIND_NUMENOREAN_FOR_BEGINNERS_II.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

KIND_ADVANCED_LESSONS_OF_NUMENOREAN.name: Advanced Lessons of Numenorean
KIND_ADVANCED_LESSONS_OF_NUMENOREAN.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

KIND_ADVANCED_LESSONS_OF_SINDARIN.name: Advanced Lessons of Sindarin
KIND_ADVANCED_LESSONS_OF_SINDARIN.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

KIND_SHARD_OF_POTTERY.name: & Shard~ of Pottery
KIND_SHARD_OF_POTTERY.flavorText: Half a clay jar -- how many failed artists have taken refuge in these dungeons?

KIND_BOOK_OF_BEGINNER_CANTRIPS.name: & Book~ of Beginner Cantrips
KIND_BOOK_OF_BEGINNER_CANTRIPS.flavorText: The blood smudged on the cover makes you wonder how many people had it before you...

KIND_BOOK_OF_TELEPORTATION.name: & Book~ of Teleportation
KIND_BOOK_OF_TELEPORTATION.flavorText: A standard spellbook with a few spells.

KIND_BOOK_OF_SUMMONING.name: & Book~ of Summoning
KIND_BOOK_OF_SUMMONING.flavorText: A standard spellbook with a few spells. It smells like camel.

KIND_POTION_OF_LEARNING.name: & Potion~ of Learning
KIND_POTION_OF_LEARNING.flavorText: This old potion is supposed to grant more learning power to its user.

KIND_KHUZDUL_THE_HIDDEN_TONGUE_OF_THE_DW.name: Khuzdul - The Hidden Tongue of the Dwarves
KIND_KHUZDUL_THE_HIDDEN_TONGUE_OF_THE_DW.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

KIND_NANDORIN_FOR_DUMMIES.name: Nandorin for Dummies
KIND_NANDORIN_FOR_DUMMIES.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

KIND_ADVANCED_LESSONS_OF_ORCISH.name: Advanced Lessons of Orcish
KIND_ADVANCED_LESSONS_OF_ORCISH.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

KIND_TOME_OF_THE_TIME.name: & Tome~ of the Time
KIND_TOME_OF_THE_TIME.flavorText: This tome seems to have trouble deciding whether it really exists now. Its flickering pages contain all that is known about the currents of time.

KIND_SPELLBOOK_OF.name: & Spellbook~ of #
KIND_SPELLBOOK_OF.flavorText: This book contains a single spell within its pages.

KIND_TOME_OF_META_SPELLS.name: & Tome~ of Meta Spells
KIND_TOME_OF_META_SPELLS.flavorText: This tome gives you deeper insights on the works of magic.

KIND_TOME_OF_THE_MIND.name: & Tome~ of the Mind
KIND_TOME_OF_THE_MIND.flavorText: This tome has no pages; knowledge is transferred to you if you simply hold it.

KIND_HOLY_TOME_OF_ERU_ILUVATAR.name: & Holy Tome~ of Eru Iluvatar
KIND_HOLY_TOME_OF_ERU_ILUVATAR.flavorText: This dusty tome is filled with ancient rituals, designed to uncover all that is hidden.

KIND_HOLY_TOME_OF_MANWE_SULIMO.name: & Holy Tome~ of Manwe Sulimo
KIND_HOLY_TOME_OF_MANWE_SULIMO.flavorText: A large jewel-encrusted tome that transfers wisdom and understanding to its wearer.

KIND_WAR_TOME_OF_TULKAS.name: & War Tome~ of Tulkas
KIND_WAR_TOME_OF_TULKAS.flavorText: This tome fills you with glorious visions of total devastation. Anyone in your way shall be destroyed.

KIND_UNHOLY_TOME_OF_THE_HELLFLAME.name: & Unholy Tome~ of the Hellflame
KIND_UNHOLY_TOME_OF_THE_HELLFLAME.flavorText: This singed book smells like burned flesh.  Its power is as evident as its thirst for your blood.

KIND_CORRUPTED_TOME_OF_MELKOR.name: & Corrupted Tome~ of Melkor
KIND_CORRUPTED_TOME_OF_MELKOR.flavorText: A black and scarlet flame springs from this tome, issuing a thunderous roar under which you think you hear the screams of tormented souls.

KIND_FOREST_TOME_OF_YAVANNA.name: & Forest Tome~ of Yavanna
KIND_FOREST_TOME_OF_YAVANNA.flavorText: A standard & Forest Tome~ of Yavanna from ToME.

KIND_EARTH.name: [Earth]
KIND_EARTH.flavorText: A heavy lump of rock. As you touch it, you think you can see into the earth and perceive its secrets.

KIND_AIR.name: [Air]
KIND_AIR.flavorText: A completely translucent gem; as you behold it, you hear a great wind and feel like you're about to take off and fly away.

KIND_BLUESTEEL_BLADE.name: & Bluesteel Blade~
KIND_BLUESTEEL_BLADE.flavorText: A small sword made of a blueish metal with a strangely rough surface. As anything is hurt with it, the weapon will stick inside the wound and cause horrible wounds when torn away.

KIND_RING_OF_POWER.name: Ring~ of Power
KIND_RING_OF_POWER.flavorText: A standard Ring~ of Power from ToME.

KIND_CLIMBING_SET.name: & Climbing Set~
KIND_CLIMBING_SET.flavorText: A bunch of screws and hooks, a small pick and a very long rope. As long as a wall or rock face isn't really high, this collection of tools should help you across it.

KIND_DEMONBLADE.name: & Demonblade~
KIND_DEMONBLADE.flavorText: This blade has been taken from the corpse of a demon. Some demonic energy is still coursing through it, helping you slay other demons.

KIND_DEMONSHIELD.name: & Demonshield~
KIND_DEMONSHIELD.flavorText: This shield has been taken from the corpse of a demon. Some demonic energy is still coursing through it, giving life to any that wield it.

KIND_DEMONHORN.name: & Demonhorn~
KIND_DEMONHORN.flavorText: This horn is about six feet long.  Just looking at it makes you nervous.

KIND_WOODEN_ROD_OF.name: & Wooden Rod~ of#
KIND_WOODEN_ROD_OF.flavorText: The most common rod of all. It's the wood of oak, cut at midnight by a fair maiden.

KIND_COPPER_ROD_OF.name: & Copper Rod~ of#
KIND_COPPER_ROD_OF.flavorText: This is the common rod of the dwarves.  It is created by chanting incessantly for 48 hours.

KIND_IRON_ROD_OF.name: & Iron Rod~ of#
KIND_IRON_ROD_OF.flavorText: This is the better version of the copper rod. It has been forged with iron that comes from the greatest deeps, where even the dwarves fear to go.

KIND_SILVER_ROD_OF.name: & Silver Rod~ of#
KIND_SILVER_ROD_OF.flavorText: This rod is used often used by court mages. Its creation costs an insane amount of gold but it is still lesser than a Golden Rod.

KIND_GOLDEN_ROD_OF.name: & Golden Rod~ of#
KIND_GOLDEN_ROD_OF.flavorText: These rods are rare, since finding gold that can withstand the great magic capacity that this rod holds is very difficult.

KIND_MITHRIL_ROD_OF.name: & Mithril Rod~ of#
KIND_MITHRIL_ROD_OF.flavorText: The mithril of this rod comes from very deep, too deep. Unknown powers have been infused in this rod, making it the second most powerful type of rod on Middle-earth.

KIND_ADAMANTITE_ROD_OF.name: & Adamantite Rod~ of#
KIND_ADAMANTITE_ROD_OF.flavorText: This is the rarest and most powerful kind of rod there is.  Treasure it!

KIND_CLEAVER.name: & Cleaver~
KIND_CLEAVER.flavorText: A small axe with a heavy rectangular blade.

KIND_LIGHT_WAR_AXE.name: & Light War Axe~
KIND_LIGHT_WAR_AXE.flavorText: A broad-bladed axe, suited for battle.

KIND_SLAUGHTER_AXE.name: & Slaughter Axe~
KIND_SLAUGHTER_AXE.flavorText: A huge axe, the sort used for slaughtering animals, this weapon is unusually deadly against natural creatures.

KIND_FORTUNE_COOKIE.name: & Fortune cookie~
KIND_FORTUNE_COOKIE.flavorText: A small, sweet bakery product, with a scrap of paper inside.

KIND_CRITICAL_HITS.name: Critical Hits
KIND_CRITICAL_HITS.flavorText: A magical ring to make it likelier for the wearer to hit exceptionally heavily.

KIND_PARTIAL_TOTEM.name: Partial Totem
KIND_PARTIAL_TOTEM.flavorText: An item which a Summoner can use to animate a copy of a creature that only exists by the will of its master.

KIND_TRUE_TOTEM.name: True Totem
KIND_TRUE_TOTEM.flavorText: An item which a Summoner can use to revive a true copy of a creature.

KIND_PIECE_OF_THE_RELIC_OF_ERU.name: & Piece~ of the Relic of Eru
KIND_PIECE_OF_THE_RELIC_OF_ERU.flavorText: Although it looks like a piece of junk, it is actually part of an ancient relic belonging to Priests of Eru. The relic now lies in pieces, hidden from all but but his most dedicated followers.

KIND_PIECE_OF_THE_RELIC_OF_MANWE.name: & Piece~ of the Relic of Manwe
KIND_PIECE_OF_THE_RELIC_OF_MANWE.flavorText: Although it looks like a piece of junk, it is actually part of an ancient relic belonging to Priests of Manwe. The relic now lies in pieces, hidden from all but his most dedicated followers.

KIND_PIECE_OF_THE_RELIC_OF_TULKAS.name: & Piece~ of the Relic of Tulkas
KIND_PIECE_OF_THE_RELIC_OF_TULKAS.flavorText: Although it looks like a piece of junk, it is actually part of an ancient relic belonging to worshippers of Tulkas. The relic now lies in pieces, hidden from all but his most dedicated followers.

KIND_PIECE_OF_THE_RELIC_OF_MELKOR.name: & Piece~ of the Relic of Melkor
KIND_PIECE_OF_THE_RELIC_OF_MELKOR.flavorText: Although it looks like a piece of junk, it is actually part of an ancient relic belonging to Dark Priests. The relic now lies in pieces, hidden from all but the most faithful followers of Melkor.

KIND_PIECE_OF_THE_RELIC_OF_YAVANNA.name: & Piece~ of the Relic of Yavanna
KIND_PIECE_OF_THE_RELIC_OF_YAVANNA.flavorText: Although it looks like a piece of junk, it is actually part of an ancient relic belonging to Druids. The relic now lies in pieces, hidden from all but the most faithful followers of Yavanna.

EGO_OF_THE_ETERNAL_EYE.name: of the Eternal Eye
EGO_OF_THE_ETERNAL_EYE.flavorText: Ego power: of the Eternal Eye

EGO_OF_THE_ETHEREAL_EYE.name: of the Ethereal Eye
EGO_OF_THE_ETHEREAL_EYE.flavorText: Ego power: of the Ethereal Eye

ART_OF_GALADRIEL.name: 유물: of Galadriel
ART_OF_GALADRIEL.flavorText: A small crystal phial, with the light of Earendil's Star contained inside. Its light is imperishable, and near it darkness cannot endure.

ART_OF_ELENDIL.name: 유물: of Elendil
ART_OF_ELENDIL.flavorText: The shining Star of the West, a famed heirloom of Elendil's house.

ART_OF_THRAIN.name: 유물: of Thrain
ART_OF_THRAIN.flavorText: A great globe seemingly filled with moonlight, the famed Heart of the Mountain, which splinters the light that falls upon it into a thousand glowing shards.

ART_OF_CARLAMMAS.name: 유물: of Carlammas
ART_OF_CARLAMMAS.flavorText: A fiery circle of bronze, with mighty spells to ward off evil.

ART_OF_INGWE.name: 유물: of Ingwe
ART_OF_INGWE.flavorText: The ancient heirloom of Ingwe, high lord of the Vanyar, against whom nothing of evil could stand.

ART_NAUGLAMIR.name: 유물: 'Nauglamir'
ART_NAUGLAMIR.flavorText: A carencet of gold, set with a multitude of shining gems of Valinor.  Despite its size, its weight seems as that of gossamer.

ART_OF_FLARE.name: 유물: of Flare
ART_OF_FLARE.flavorText: The mighty ring of the Thunderlord Flare that makes the wearer strong and healthy.  Once a ring of power, it was given to Flare by Celegorm when he arrived on Middle-earth with a full nest of Thunderlords.

ART_OF_BARAHIR.name: 유물: of Barahir
ART_OF_BARAHIR.flavorText: A ring shaped into twinned serpents with eyes of emerald meeting beneath a crown of flowers, an ancient treasure of Isildur's house.

ART_OF_TULKAS.name: 유물: of Tulkas
ART_OF_TULKAS.flavorText: The treasure of Tulkas, most fleet and wrathful of the Valar.

ART_OF_POWER_NARYA.name: 유물: of Power 'Narya'
ART_OF_POWER_NARYA.flavorText: The Ring of Fire, set with a ruby that glows like flame.  Narya is one of the three Rings of Power created by the Elves and hidden by them from Sauron.

ART_OF_POWER_NENYA.name: 유물: of Power 'Nenya'
ART_OF_POWER_NENYA.flavorText: The Ring of Adamant, with a pure white stone as centrepiece.  Nenya is one of the three Rings of Power created by the Elves and hidden by them from Sauron.

ART_OF_POWER_VILYA.name: 유물: of Power 'Vilya'
ART_OF_POWER_VILYA.flavorText: The Ring of Sapphire, with clear blue gems that shine like stars, glittering untouchable despite all that Sauron ever wrought.  Vilya is one of the three Rings of Power created by the Elves and hidden by them from Sauron.

ART_OF_POWER_THE_ONE_RING.name: 유물: of Power 'The One Ring'
ART_OF_POWER_THE_ONE_RING.flavorText: "Ash nazg durbatuluk, ash nazg gimbatul, ash nazg thrakatuluk agh burzum-ishi krimpatul". Unadorned, made of massive gold, set with runes in the foul speech of Mordor, with power so great that it inevitably twists and masters any earthly being who wears it.

ART_OF_SPACE_TIME.name: 유물: of Space-Time
ART_OF_SPACE_TIME.flavorText: A powerful stone that provides a strong light for any who wields it. It is rumoured that it may even protect the wearer from the passing of time.

ART_RAZORBACK.name: 유물: 'Razorback'
ART_RAZORBACK.flavorText: A massive suit of heavy dragon scales deeply saturated with many colours. It throbs with angry energies, and you feel the raw elemental might of untamed Lightning as you put it on.

ART_OF_ETERNITY.name: 유물: of Eternity
ART_OF_ETERNITY.flavorText: Designed to be used with the Seeker Bolt of Feanor, this Crossbow is perfect against the terrible powers of Morgoth.

ART_OF_MELKOR.name: 유물: of Melkor
ART_OF_MELKOR.flavorText: The mighty spear used once by Melkor to slay the trees of Valinor.

ART_SOULKEEPER.name: 유물: 'Soulkeeper'
ART_SOULKEEPER.flavorText: A suit of imperishable adamant, with unconquerable strength to endure evil and disruptive magics, that protects the life force of its wearer as nothing else can.

ART_OF_ISILDUR.name: 유물: of Isildur
ART_OF_ISILDUR.flavorText: A gleaming steel suit covering the wearer from neck to foot, with runes of warding and stability deeply engraved into its surface.

ART_OF_THE_ROHIRRIM.name: 유물: of the Rohirrim
ART_OF_THE_ROHIRRIM.flavorText: A stiff suit of armour composed of small metal plates sewn to an inner layer of heavy canvas, and covered with a second layer of cloth.  Within it is the spirit of Eorl the Young, matchless in combat.

ART_BELEGENNON.name: 유물: 'Belegennon'
ART_BELEGENNON.flavorText: This wondrous suit of fine-linked chain shimmers as though of pure silver. It stands untouched amidst the fury of the elements, and a power of concealment rests within.

ART_OF_CELEBORN.name: 유물: of Celeborn
ART_OF_CELEBORN.flavorText: A shimmering suit of true-silver, forged long ago by dwarven smiths of legend.  It gleams with purest white as you gaze upon it, and mighty are its powers to protect and banish.

ART_OF_ARVEDUI.name: 유물: of Arvedui
ART_OF_ARVEDUI.flavorText: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, well padded with leather. You feel strong and tall as Arvedui, last king of Arnor, as you put it on.

ART_OF_CASPANION.name: 유물: of Caspanion
ART_OF_CASPANION.flavorText: A hauberk, leggings, and sleeves of interlocking steel rings, strategically reinforced at vital locations with a second layer of chain.  Magics to enhance body and mind lie within, and no door can hope to resist the wearer.

ART_OF_MARDA.name: 유물: of Marda
ART_OF_MARDA.flavorText: The flying suit of Marda, very powerful armour that protects the wearer from cold.  Wonderful as this mighty armour is, beware wearing it, for it has been cursed by a powerful wizard since Marda had it and is said to have gained a couple of undesirable side-effects...

ART_OF_TRONE.name: 유물: of Trone
ART_OF_TRONE.flavorText: The flying suit of Trone.  It protects the user from fire and imps are said to be less annoying with this on.

ART_THALKETTOTH.name: 유물: 'Thalkettoth'
ART_THALKETTOTH.flavorText: A tunic and skirt sewn with thick, overlapping scales of hardened leather whose wearer moves with agility and assurance.

ART_OF_WORMTONGUE.name: 유물: of Wormtongue
ART_OF_WORMTONGUE.flavorText: The pair of boots used by Grima son of Galmod, also named the Wormtongue: a treacherous but persuasive counsellor, ever ready to betray, sneak, lie, cheat and steal - but never ready to actually fight.

ART_OF_THORIN.name: 유물: of Thorin
ART_OF_THORIN.flavorText: Invoking the strength and endurance of Thorin, King under the Mountain, this little metal shield is proof against the Element of Earth.

ART_OF_CELEGORM.name: 유물: of Celegorm
ART_OF_CELEGORM.flavorText: This shield emblazoned with a multitude of creatures not seen for ages once protected Celegorm, lord of Himlad; around it lies a mystic balance that contains the conflicts of the elements.

ART_OF_ANARION.name: 유물: of Anarion
ART_OF_ANARION.flavorText: The great metal-bound shield of Anarion, son of Elendil, who Sauron found himself powerless to wither or diminish.

ART_OF_HURIN.name: 유물: of Hurin
ART_OF_HURIN.flavorText: Wielded by Hurin Thalion in the Fifth Battle of Beleriand, this troll-bane smoked in the black blood of Gothmog's guards.

ART_OF_MORGOTH.name: 유물: of Morgoth
ART_OF_MORGOTH.flavorText: Two Silmarils of Feanor blaze from the thunderous crown of twisted iron. The corrupted metal feels at once as infernal as hellfire and as chilling as the Outer Darkness. One protrusion from the crown is abruptly ended where a third jewel might have shone.

ART_OF_BERUTHIEL.name: 유물: of Beruthiel
ART_OF_BERUTHIEL.flavorText: The midnight-hued steel circlet of the sorceress-queen Beruthiel, which grants extraordinary powers of sight and awareness at a terrible physical cost.

ART_OF_THRANDUIL.name: 유물: of Thranduil
ART_OF_THRANDUIL.flavorText: The hunting cap of King Thranduil, to whose ears come all the secrets of his forest domain.

ART_OF_THENGEL.name: 유물: of Thengel
ART_OF_THENGEL.flavorText: A ridged helmet made of steel, and embossed with scenes of valour in fine- engraved silver.  It grants the wearer nobility, clarity of thought and understanding.

ART_OF_HAMMERHAND.name: 유물: of Hammerhand
ART_OF_HAMMERHAND.flavorText: A great helm as steady as the heroes of the Westdike. Mighty were the blows of Helm, the Hammerhand!

ART_OF_DOR_LOMIN.name: 유물: of Dor-Lomin
ART_OF_DOR_LOMIN.flavorText: The legendary dragon helm of Turin Turambar, an object of dread to the servants of Morgoth.

ART_HOLHENNETH.name: 유물: 'Holhenneth'
ART_HOLHENNETH.flavorText: A famous helm of forged iron granting extraordinary powers of mind and awareness.

ART_OF_GORLIM.name: 유물: of Gorlim
ART_OF_GORLIM.flavorText: A headpiece, gaudy and barbaric, that betrayed a warrior when he most needed succor.

ART_OF_GONDOR.name: 유물: of Gondor
ART_OF_GONDOR.flavorText: An arrow that was created to rid the world of demons.

ART_OF_NUMENOR.name: 유물: of Numenor
ART_OF_NUMENOR.flavorText: A crown of massive gold, set with wondrous jewels of thought and warding, worn by the kings of ancient Numenor.  Its wearer may go into battle always knowing what he faces - unless his own folly blinds him to the nature and magnitude of the task.

ART_COLLUIN.name: 유물: 'Colluin'
ART_COLLUIN.flavorText: A cape worn by a hero from Valinor, a land utterly beyond the strife of Elements.

ART_HOLCOLLETH.name: 유물: 'Holcolleth'
ART_HOLCOLLETH.flavorText: This elven-grey mantle possesses great powers of tranquility and of concealment, and grants the wearer the knowledge and understanding of the Sindar.

ART_OF_THINGOL.name: 유물: of Thingol
ART_OF_THINGOL.flavorText: A sable-hued cloak, with glowing elven-runes to restore magic showing calm and clear as moonlight on still water.

ART_OF_THORONGIL.name: 유물: of Thorongil
ART_OF_THORONGIL.flavorText: A cloak of shimmering green and brown that grants sight beyond sight and shakes off holding magics, worn by Aragorn son of Arathorn in his youth as he adventured under the name of Thorongil.

ART_COLANNON.name: 유물: 'Colannon'
ART_COLANNON.flavorText: A crystal-blue cape of fine silk worn by a silent messenger of the forces of Law. Somehow, its wearer is always able to escape trouble.

ART_OF_LUTHIEN.name: 유물: of Luthien
ART_OF_LUTHIEN.flavorText: The opaque midnight folds, inset with a multitude of tiny diamonds, of this cloak swirl around you and you feel a hint, a fragment of the knowledge and power to restore that lay in Luthien, the most beautiful being that ever knew death.

ART_OF_TUOR.name: 유물: of Tuor
ART_OF_TUOR.flavorText: From the ruin of Gondolin did Tuor escape, through secret ways and travail, shielded by his cloak from a multitude of hostile eyes.

ART_CAMBELEG.name: 유물: 'Cambeleg'
ART_CAMBELEG.flavorText: A hero's handgear that lends great prowess in battle.

ART_CAMMITHRIM.name: 유물: 'Cammithrim'
ART_CAMMITHRIM.flavorText: These gloves glow so brightly as to light the way for their owner and cast magical bolts with great frequency.

ART_PAURHACH.name: 유물: 'Paurhach'
ART_PAURHACH.flavorText: A fiery set of gauntlets that can even shoot fire from the user's hands.

ART_PAURNIMMEN.name: 유물: 'Paurnimmen'
ART_PAURNIMMEN.flavorText: A set of handgear so icy as to be able to fire frost bolts.

ART_PAURAEGEN.name: 유물: 'Pauraegen'
ART_PAURAEGEN.flavorText: A set of handgear with sparks surrounding it, able to fire bolts of electricity.

ART_PAURNEN.name: 유물: 'Paurnen'
ART_PAURNEN.flavorText: A set of handgear so corrosive that it may fire bolts of acid.

ART_CAMLOST.name: 유물: 'Camlost'
ART_CAMLOST.flavorText: A pair of gauntlets that sap combat ability, named after the empty hand of Beren that once clasped a Silmaril.

ART_OF_FINGOLFIN.name: 유물: of Fingolfin
ART_OF_FINGOLFIN.flavorText: The hand-sheathing of Fingolfin, warrior-king of Elves and Men, who gave Morgoth seven mighty wounds and pain that will last forever.

ART_OF_FEANOR.name: 유물: of Feanor
ART_OF_FEANOR.flavorText: Made during the war against Morgoth by Feanor, this powerful bolt is the bane of Morgoth's power, and has especial strength against those foes who are already dead.

ART_DAL_I_THALION.name: 유물: 'Dal-i-thalion'
ART_DAL_I_THALION.flavorText: A pair of high-laced shoes, strong against the powers of corruption and withering, that grant the wearer extraordinary agility.

ART_OF_THROR.name: 유물: of Thror
ART_OF_THROR.flavorText: Sturdy footwear of leather and steel as enduring as the long-suffering Dwarven King-in-exile who wore them.  Of dwarven make, these boots will make their wearer completely at home in the mountains.

ART_OF_BARD.name: 유물: of Bard
ART_OF_BARD.flavorText: The great yew bow of grim-faced Bard, who shot the mightiest arrow that songs record.

ART_OF_MAEDHROS.name: 유물: of Maedhros
ART_OF_MAEDHROS.flavorText: A short thrusting blade with a large guard worn by Maedhros the Tall, eldest son of Feanor, and wielded with his left hand after the loss of his right hand in the pits of Thangorodrim.

ART_ANGRIST.name: 유물: 'Angrist'
ART_ANGRIST.flavorText: Forged from meteoric iron, this long chopping dagger slices through ordinary metal as easily as its title, "Iron Cleaver", suggests.

ART_NARTHANC.name: 유물: 'Narthanc'
ART_NARTHANC.flavorText: A fiery dagger finely balanced for deadly throws.

ART_NIMTHANC.name: 유물: 'Nimthanc'
ART_NIMTHANC.flavorText: A frosty dagger finely balanced for deadly throws.

ART_DETHANC.name: 유물: 'Dethanc'
ART_DETHANC.flavorText: A dagger covered in sparks and finely balanced for deadly throws.

ART_OF_RILIA.name: 유물: of Rilia
ART_OF_RILIA.flavorText: A large stiletto dagger that glistens with odourless poison, to which the wearer seems oddly immune.

ART_BELANGIL.name: 유물: 'Belangil'
ART_BELANGIL.flavorText: A frosty dagger surrounded in a nimbus of ice with a hilt of elk horn and an edge to wound the wind.

ART_CALRIS.name: 유물: 'Calris'
ART_CALRIS.flavorText: This sword has runes of power incised on its ornate hilt and a single blood channel that gleams coldly blue as you grasp this mighty weapon of peril.

ART_ARANRUTH.name: 유물: 'Aranruth'
ART_ARANRUTH.flavorText: The beautiful sword of Thingol with a hilt of gold and silver inlay, glistening icily enough to freeze the hearts of demons.  You feel supple and lightfooted as you hold it.

ART_GLAMDRING.name: 유물: 'Glamdring'
ART_GLAMDRING.flavorText: This fiery, shining blade earned its sobriquet "Foe-Hammer" from dying orcs who dared to come near hidden Gondolin.

ART_AEGLIN.name: 유물: 'Aeglin'
ART_AEGLIN.flavorText: Like unto Orcrist and Glamdring, and like them long lost, this sword is continually coved in tiny arcs of captive lightning that flash and dance eerily in the globe of light they create.

ART_ORCRIST.name: 유물: 'Orcrist'
ART_ORCRIST.flavorText: This coldly gleaming blade is called simply "Biter", by orcs who came to know its power all too well.

ART_GURTHANG.name: 유물: 'Gurthang'
ART_GURTHANG.flavorText: A giant sword once wielded by mighty Turin, and a great dragonbane which bathed in Glaurung's blood:  but beware, it will drink the blood of those who wield it eventually.

ART_ZARCUTHRA.name: 유물: 'Zarcuthra'
ART_ZARCUTHRA.flavorText: Dark and deadly runes stand stark against the naked steel of this awesome weapon, and you feel a stunning power of slaying and rending as you slowly approach.

ART_MORMEGIL.name: 유물: 'Mormegil'
ART_MORMEGIL.flavorText: A foul, twisted sword with blackened spines and knobs, whose very name is a curse upon the lips of Elves and Men.

ART_GONDRICAM.name: 유물: 'Gondricam'
ART_GONDRICAM.flavorText: Famed sea-defender of Lebennin.  A short, slightly curved chopping blade with a perfect edge shining cleanly in the sun, an object of hate to the men of Umbar who met it in combat.

ART_CRISDURIAN.name: 유물: 'Crisdurian'
ART_CRISDURIAN.flavorText: A giant's weapon, with a long blade tall and straight thrusting out from a massive double-pronged hilt.  On its blade are written doomspells against both the living and undead.

ART_AGLARANG.name: 유물: 'Aglarang'
ART_AGLARANG.flavorText: An utterly perfect, cleanly chiselled sword, with a edge that effortlessly slices rock and bone, and spells to render the wearer lithe and nimble.  It is combat incarnate.

ART_RINGIL.name: 유물: 'Ringil'
ART_RINGIL.flavorText: The weapon of Fingolfin, High King of the Noldor; it shines like a column of ice lit by light unquenchable.  Morgoth came but unwillingly to meet it of old; his lame foot will remind him of its might should he meet it again.

ART_ANDURIL.name: 유물: 'Anduril'
ART_ANDURIL.flavorText: The famed "Flame of the West", the sword that was broken and is forged again.  It glows with the essence of fire, its wearer is mighty in combat, and no creature of Sauron can withstand it.  It will never be stained or broken even in defeat.

ART_ANGUIREL.name: 유물: 'Anguirel'
ART_ANGUIREL.flavorText: Forged of black galvorn by the Dark-Elven smith Eol, this blade has the living lightning trapped inside.

ART_ELVAGIL.name: 유물: 'Elvagil'
ART_ELVAGIL.flavorText: The "Singing Blade", whose wearer can slay Orcs and Trolls in the hidden and secret places of the earth.

ART_FORASGIL.name: 유물: 'Forasgil'
ART_FORASGIL.flavorText: A slender, tapered blade whose wielder strikes icy blows with deadly accuracy.

ART_CARETH_ASDRIAG.name: 유물: 'Careth Asdriag'
ART_CARETH_ASDRIAG.flavorText: An heirloom of the Lords of Rhun far to the east, and a name of dismay to creatures natural and unnatural.

ART_STING.name: 유물: 'Sting'
ART_STING.flavorText: "I will give you a name, and I shall call you Sting."  The perfect size for Bilbo, and stamped forever by the courage he found in Mirkwood, this sturdy little blade grants the wearer combat prowess and survival abilities they did not know they had.

ART_HARADEKKET.name: 유물: 'Haradekket'
ART_HARADEKKET.flavorText: A damascened scimitar that seems wondrously easy to hold.  Famed in song as the "Sickle of Harad", and a deadly foe to the undead.

ART_GILETTAR.name: 유물: 'Gilettar'
ART_GILETTAR.flavorText: A stubby blade worn by Beren, whose horn sounded of old in the glades of Brethil.

ART_DOOMCALLER.name: 유물: 'Doomcaller'
ART_DOOMCALLER.flavorText: This weapon of wrath, cursed with a violent anger, dives hungrily into the flesh of its enemies. It gathers shadows of death into its owner as they inflict wounds that will never heal.

ART_VORPAL_BLADE.name: 유물: 'Vorpal Blade'
ART_VORPAL_BLADE.flavorText: "One, two! One, two!  And through, and through, the vorpal blade went snicker-snack!"

ART_OF_THEODEN.name: 유물: of Theoden
ART_OF_THEODEN.flavorText: The narrow axe head of this weapon, finely balanced by a crow's beak, would pierce even the armour of Smaug, and its wielder becomes aware of the minds of their enemies.

ART_OF_PAIN.name: 유물: of Pain
ART_OF_PAIN.flavorText: The massive chopper that crowns this glaive glows blood-red and black; fell spells of annihilation swirl and dance as you swing death's myrmidon down.

ART_OSONDIR.name: 유물: 'Osondir'
ART_OSONDIR.flavorText: Lordly and tall did Osondir stand against the wrath of giants, and clear-eyed in barrows fell, wielding a halberd glowing ruby red.

ART_TIL_I_ARC.name: 유물: 'Til-i-arc'
ART_TIL_I_ARC.flavorText: Within this long thrusting spear lie the spirits of frost giants and fire demons, who war forever, trapped by magely spells.

ART_AEGLOS.name: 유물: 'Aeglos'
ART_AEGLOS.flavorText: The mighty spear of Gil-galad, famed as "Snow-point" in the songs of Elves, against which all the foul corruptions of Sauron dashed in vain.

ART_OF_OROME.name: 유물: of Orome
ART_OF_OROME.flavorText: The thrusting spear of wise Orome the Vala, strong against giants of frost, which can melt rock or flesh with ease.

ART_NIMLOTH.name: 유물: 'Nimloth'
ART_NIMLOTH.flavorText: A thin spike of thrice-forged steel caps a straight sylvan shaft cut from a legendary tree; spells to break the will of the undead and strike cold fear into the hearts of foes lie on this perfectly balanced spear.

ART_OF_EORLINGAS.name: 유물: of Eorlingas
ART_OF_EORLINGAS.flavorText: "Forth Eorlingas!"  To the field of Cormallen came Eorl the Young to save beleaguered Gondor, and from his lance fled massive trolls and dire wolves.

ART_OF_DURIN.name: 유물: of Durin
ART_OF_DURIN.flavorText: The greatest of the Seven Rings of the Dwarf-lords, and the last to be lost.  Alone among the Seven, it was not taken by Sauron when he made war on the Elves, but was given as a gift from Celebrimbor to King Durin III of Moria in token of friendship:  nevertheless, Sauron in disguise had a hand in its making, and so it is cursed, and draws evil towards it.

ART_OF_EONWE.name: 유물: of Eonwe
ART_OF_EONWE.flavorText: The axe of Eonwe, leader of the Hosts of the West before the gates of Thangorodrim, strikes with icy wrath at the undead, disperses hosts of evil at a word, and grants Maia-like powers of body and mind.

ART_OF_BALLI_STONEHAND.name: 유물: of Balli Stonehand
ART_OF_BALLI_STONEHAND.flavorText: The twin blades of this weapon were forged in Belegost, and powerful forces to resist and endure lie ready for he who shall wield it once more.

ART_LOTHARANG.name: 유물: 'Lotharang'
ART_LOTHARANG.flavorText: A superbly crafted double-bladed axe that slays the creatures of earth and allows rapid recovery from their blows.

ART_OF_THE_DWARVES.name: 유물: of the Dwarves
ART_OF_THE_DWARVES.flavorText: A massive axe with twin razor-sharp heads, so large that it usually requires two hands to wield, intricately engraved in gold with spells to ward off the elements and smite evil.

ART_BARUKKHELED.name: 유물: 'Barukkheled'
ART_BARUKKHELED.flavorText: A royal heirloom of the southern coast, strong in combat against evil creatures of the earth.

ART_OF_WRATH.name: 유물: of Wrath
ART_OF_WRATH.flavorText: A massive triple-pronged spear, so great it normally requires two hands to wield, evoking the spirit of Osse who with it pierced legions of evil and undead.

ART_OF_ULMO.name: 유물: of Ulmo
ART_OF_ULMO.flavorText: The awesome weapon of the Vala Ulmo, Lord of Waters.  Mightiest of all the powers of good save Manwe himself, Ulmo laughs in scorn at the dread powers of the undead, and is utterly in command of the element of water.

ART_AVAVIR.name: 유물: 'Avavir'
ART_AVAVIR.flavorText: With elemental powers whose struggles turn this weapon red and purest white, this shining reaper bears within it a power of going forth and returning.

ART_OF_THE_DAWN.name: 유물: of the Dawn
ART_OF_THE_DAWN.flavorText: Forged in the farthest East by a race of mighty spellcasters, this shiny pale sword gleams with the rays of rising sun as you invoke its power of commanding legions of powerful immortal warriors...

ART_GROND.name: 유물: 'Grond'
ART_GROND.flavorText: The mighty Hammer of the Underworld, blackened by doomspells of shattering, whose wielder holds the lives of all Morgoth's servants in his hand.

ART_TOTILA.name: 유물: 'Totila'
ART_TOTILA.flavorText: A flail whose head befuddles those who stare as you whirl it around, and becomes a fiery comet as you bring it down.

ART_THUNDERFIST.name: 유물: 'Thunderfist'
ART_THUNDERFIST.flavorText: The long-lost weapon of Kzurin, Dwarven champion of ancient Belegost, with runes of strength in its handle, and flames and sparks that roar and crackle around its massive head.

ART_BLOODSPIKE.name: 유물: 'Bloodspike'
ART_BLOODSPIKE.flavorText: You feel strong and firm of foot as you whip the chain-suspended spiked orb around - and bathe it in the blood of your foes.

ART_FIRESTAR.name: 유물: 'Firestar'
ART_FIRESTAR.flavorText: A famed battle-lord of old, with a ruddy head, coloured as embers are that can yet rise up in wrath.

ART_TARATOL.name: 유물: 'Taratol'
ART_TARATOL.flavorText: A great ridged mace that calls around you a nimbus of living lightning; you remain utterly untouched even as fat sparks arc around your fingers and eyebrows.

ART_OF_AULE.name: 유물: of Aule
ART_OF_AULE.flavorText: The wondrous hammer of Aule, creator of the wise Dwarven lords of old. It bears magics of demolishing that no serpent or demon can withstand, and invokes the strength of mountains to ward off the tumult of the elements.

ART_NAR_I_VAGIL.name: 유물: 'Nar-i-vagil'
ART_NAR_I_VAGIL.flavorText: Named for a fiery star and set with gems of great worth binding mystic virtues of protection and thought.

ART_ERIRIL.name: 유물: 'Eriril'
ART_ERIRIL.flavorText: The radiant golden staff of an Istari of legend, this wizard's companion grants keen sight and the knowledge of many hidden things.

ART_OF_OLORIN.name: 유물: of Olorin
ART_OF_OLORIN.flavorText: A staff tall and sturdy, with rough-hewn runes that invoke the element of Earth, and which strikes down all creatures who live in the shadow of mountains.

ART_DEATHWREAKER.name: 유물: 'Deathwreaker'
ART_DEATHWREAKER.flavorText: A weapon so massive it seems beyond the strength of mortals, yet you feel the might of giants within you as you heft it.  As you grip the handle of ebony and steel, coronas of fire blaze and mighty spells to preserve magic activate around you.  You wield the Fear of Dragons and the Despair of the Undead!

ART_TURMIL.name: 유물: 'Turmil'
ART_TURMIL.flavorText: Wielded by the High Priest of Meneltarma, this great mace gleams coldly as though moonlit, and it can strike as mighty a blow spiritually as physically.

ART_BELTHRONDING.name: 유물: 'Belthronding'
ART_BELTHRONDING.flavorText: The great bow of Beleg, made of black yew and strung with elven hair that faintly shines a pale clear gold.

ART_CUBRAGOL.name: 유물: 'Cubragol'
ART_CUBRAGOL.flavorText: A crossbow that grants fiery speed to he who finds it, and from which shoot bolts that blaze with flame unquenchable.

ART_OF_BEOR.name: 유물: of Beor
ART_OF_BEOR.flavorText: Beor's boomerang makes its wielder as agile as the winds, and as hard to harm.

ART_GLIMDRIR.name: 유물: 'Glimdrir'
ART_GLIMDRIR.flavorText: A powerful boomerang that makes one agile and fast, with a thirst for evil and undead creatures, but demands its wielder not teleport, for fear of desertion.

ART_OF_INCANUS.name: 유물: of Incanus
ART_OF_INCANUS.flavorText: Gandalf's long, flowing robe.  It provides insight and allows the wearer to see things not seen by all.

ART_OF_THE_THAIN.name: 유물: of the Thain
ART_OF_THE_THAIN.flavorText: This sling was crafted by Faramir I, Thain of the Shire, just in case the nasties of his father's stories ever dare to enter the Shire again.

ART_LASHER.name: 유물: 'Lasher'
ART_LASHER.flavorText: A powerful whip that is deadly against orcs.  It poisons your foes and is said to go "snicker snack".

ART_BULLSEYE.name: 유물: 'Bullseye'
ART_BULLSEYE.flavorText: A powerful arrow that is feared by even the mightiest demons.

ART_TRAVAK.name: 유물: 'Travak'
ART_TRAVAK.flavorText: A rounded pebble imbued with the powers of the elements.

ART_OF_MAGLOR.name: 유물: of Maglor
ART_OF_MAGLOR.flavorText: This harp that once belonged to Maglor makes those who use it seem more forceful and convincing.  It is also said that those who have used it found themselves walking faster, as if to an unheard beat.

ART_OF_THE_SKY.name: 유물: of the Sky
ART_OF_THE_SKY.flavorText: The drum is decorated with the images of the stars, the clouds, the Sun guided by Arien and the Moon with Tilion.  It imparts to the wearer an echo of the beauty of the sky, and protects him from the elements day or night.  The beat of the drum marks the passage of time, and will make time pass differently for the wearer.

ART_OF_DAERON.name: 유물: of Daeron
ART_OF_DAERON.flavorText: A pretty harp that makes those who play it beautiful, wise and fast.

ART_OF_EREBOR.name: 유물: of Erebor
ART_OF_EREBOR.flavorText: A pick that provides a magical light by which to see while tunnelling.

ART_OF_THE_DRUEDAIN.name: 유물: of the Druedain
ART_OF_THE_DRUEDAIN.flavorText: The fabled Drum of the Druedain that will protect those who play it from darkness and poison attacks.  It also aids in the seeing of warm-blooded creatures.

ART_OF_ROHAN.name: 유물: of Rohan
ART_OF_ROHAN.flavorText: A horn carved from the bones of the Dragon of Ered-Mithrin, this heirloom of the House of Eorl bestows to its user the gifts of courage and command.

ART_OF_HELM.name: 유물: of Helm
ART_OF_HELM.flavorText: Heedless of cold, fearless of darkness -- besiegers fled at the wind of the solitary coming of King Helm Hammerhand, proclaimed by a single horn-blast in the dead of winter.

ART_OF_BOROMIR.name: 유물: of Boromir
ART_OF_BOROMIR.flavorText: Boromir's horn gives courage and endurance to the wearer, provided he does not wish to travel in secrecy: for it must always sound when its wielder sets forth on a journey.  "Loud and clear it sounds in the valleys of the hills... and then let all the foes of Gondor flee!"

ART_OF_GREAT_LUCK.name: 유물: of Great Luck
ART_OF_GREAT_LUCK.flavorText: A powerful wizard once created this robe to grant him incredible luck.... It seems he forgot to wear it.

ART_OF_FARMER_MAGGOT.name: 유물: of Farmer Maggot
ART_OF_FARMER_MAGGOT.flavorText: This ordinary seeming leather sling has been raised to legendary status amongst generations of hobbit children.  Farmer Maggot's ability to notice and strike any mushroom thief anywhere within his patch almost keeps young poachers at bay, but once they get within range they soon flee for less painful pastures, frequently with rounded pebbles stinging their backsides...

ART_OF_ANGMAR.name: 유물: of Angmar
ART_OF_ANGMAR.flavorText: Dark flames wreath the naked steel of the Witch-King of Angmar. A mighty curse to all those who wield it apart from its master, the torture of the wraithworld awaits those who dare.

ART_OF_THE_SANDWORM.name: 유물: of the Sandworm
ART_OF_THE_SANDWORM.flavorText: This powerful piece of armour was made using the remains of the Sandworm Queen.

ART_DRAGONBANE.name: 유물: 'Dragonbane'
ART_DRAGONBANE.flavorText: Forged by the Dwarves to defend their home of Khazad-dum from dragons, this axe has been lost to time... until now.

ART_LIMBSLICER.name: 유물: 'Limbslicer'
ART_LIMBSLICER.flavorText: The Petty-dwarves of Bathak forged this blade, and it shares their thirst for blood.

ART_ORCHAST.name: 유물: 'Orchast'
ART_ORCHAST.flavorText: Forged by the dwarves of Khazad-dum in a time of desperation, this axe turned many a battle against the invading orcs.

ART_OF_THE_NIGHT.name: 유물: of the Night
ART_OF_THE_NIGHT.flavorText: Found on an unmarked grave after a violent storm, this hatchet has a sinister aura of darkness and decay.

ART_NATUREBANE.name: 유물: 'Naturebane'
ART_NATUREBANE.flavorText: Used by the orcs in their battle at Dagor Bragollach against the elves, this axe has a bloodthirst for nature.

ART_OF_ICE.name: 유물: of Ice
ART_OF_ICE.flavorText: Crafted of purest ice and held solid by powerful spells, this icy axe delivers a chill of death to its victims.

ART_NARSIL.name: 유물: 'Narsil'
ART_NARSIL.flavorText: The sword that was broken shall be reforged...

ART_LEBOHAUM.name: 유물: 'Lebohaum'
ART_LEBOHAUM.flavorText: With the Helm 'Lebohaum' your head is safe!

ART_MEDIATOR.name: 유물: 'Mediator'
ART_MEDIATOR.flavorText: A mighty suit of dragon armour, set with the scales of dragons of both Law and Chaos, and with power over both.

ART_OF_HIMRING.name: 유물: of Himring
ART_OF_HIMRING.flavorText: Contained within this studded cuirass of pliable leather is the memory of unvanquished Himring, defiant fortress surrounded by the legions of Morgoth.

ART_HITHLOMIR.name: 유물: 'Hithlomir'
ART_HITHLOMIR.flavorText: Familiar with the secret ways hidden in darkness, this leather cuirass is truly more than it appears.

ART_OF_GIL_GALAD.name: 유물: of Gil-galad
ART_OF_GIL_GALAD.flavorText: The legendary shield of Gil-Galad, who fought his way to the gates of the Dark Tower, and with whom came light even to Gorgoroth.

ART_OF_CELEBRIMBOR.name: 유물: of Celebrimbor
ART_OF_CELEBRIMBOR.flavorText: This once belonged to Celebrimbor, maker of the Rings of Power.  One who knows both fire and acid, from the business of forging and engraving, will fear neither: nor have his enchantments ever faded.  Celebrimbor was even aware of Sauron before Sauron became aware of him, when Sauron put on the One Ring for the first time.

ART_OF_UMBAR.name: 유물: of Umbar
ART_OF_UMBAR.flavorText: A great brazen arbalest with arms of gleaming steel, shooting quarrels with speed and power for those brave enough to risk betrayal.

ART_OF_AMROD.name: 유물: of Amrod
ART_OF_AMROD.flavorText: This bow, and its twin, belonged to Feanor's last two twin sons, Amrod and Amras, who both hunted with the Green-elves for a time.  Like the twins, the bows are similar, for both protect their wielders from the elements:  and yet they are also unlike, for this bow gives endurance and strength, while the other gives quickness and subtlety.

ART_OF_AMRAS.name: 유물: of Amras
ART_OF_AMRAS.flavorText: This bow, and its twin, belonged to Feanor's last two twin sons, Amrod and Amras, who both hunted with the Green-elves for a time.  Like the twins, the bows are similar, for both protect their wielders from the elements:  and yet they are also unlike, for this bow gives quickness and subtlety, while the other gives endurance and strength.

ART_OF_NAIN.name: 유물: of Nain
ART_OF_NAIN.flavorText: Wielded by Nain of the Iron Hills at the Battle of Azanulbizar, this great mattock brought victory to the Dwarves over Azog's Orcs - though Nain himself fell at the last, even with victory already assured.

ART_OF_FUNDIN_BLUECLOAK.name: 유물: of Fundin Bluecloak
ART_OF_FUNDIN_BLUECLOAK.flavorText: The weapon of one of the great dwarven priests, with powers to preserve body, soul and enchantments, and the bane of those who seek life beyond death.

ART_OF_THE_HARADRIM.name: 유물: of the Haradrim
ART_OF_THE_HARADRIM.flavorText: A great shield from the far lands of the South, whose wielder will go charging into battle heedless of danger, with the strength and endurance of a madman.  Nor will he fear poison, for the Southron barbarians handle poisoned darts naturally.

ART_SKULLCLEAVER.name: 유물: 'Skullcleaver'
ART_SKULLCLEAVER.flavorText: This mighty bludgeon brings destruction to all around it, and is the bane of dragons and magic.

ART_OF_EOL.name: 유물: of Eol
ART_OF_EOL.flavorText: The iron-shod gauntlets of the Dark Elven smith Eol, tingling with magics that he could channel in battle.

ART_OF_NEVRAST.name: 유물: of Nevrast
ART_OF_NEVRAST.flavorText: Footgear made of bear leather and set with opals, which grant the wearer silent, hasted movement.

ART_OF_GIMLI.name: 유물: of Gimli
ART_OF_GIMLI.flavorText: A set of iron-shod boots stamped by Gimli's combat prowess, a peerless ally to those journeying through halls of stone under mountains.

ART_OF_UNDEATH.name: 유물: of Undeath
ART_OF_UNDEATH.flavorText: It appears like the Phial of Galadriel at first - but wait! It is a cursed phial created by an evil wizard to lure adventurers into wielding it unknowingly.

ART_OF_ORTHANC.name: 유물: of Orthanc
ART_OF_ORTHANC.flavorText: A shining white ball of unbreakable crystal, the ancient Palantiri were used by kings of Numenor and later by the Exiles for rapid communication between distant lands.  Nothing is hidden from one who gazes into a Palantir, but the observed will also be aware of the observer, as was Sauron when Saruman tried to spy on him with this particular Palantir.

ART_OF_PHASING.name: 유물: of Phasing
ART_OF_PHASING.flavorText: Imbued with the screams of the victims of undead everywhere, this ring is more a hole in reality than anything else.  Strange forces ripple over its surface, giving you visions of a reality considerably less solid than this one.  You feel your senses reel, and must make a conscious effort not to throw this ring as far from you as possible.

ART_TORIS_MEJISTOS.name: 유물: 'Toris Mejistos'
ART_TORIS_MEJISTOS.flavorText: A blue stone, with an incredible number of incredibly small runes of power on it.  It carries many secrets.

ART_ELESSAR.name: 유물: 'Elessar'
ART_ELESSAR.flavorText: This green gem glows with inner light.  Aragorn son of Arathorn wore it at the Battle of the Pelennor Fields, and he was himself given the name of 'Elessar' by the people of Gondor because of this.

ART_EVENSTAR.name: 유물: 'Evenstar'
ART_EVENSTAR.flavorText: A pure white jewel, the last gift of Queen Arwen Undomiel to Frodo Baggins, intended to be worn around his neck on the chain that had once borne the One Ring.

ART_OF_MINAS_ITHIL.name: 유물: of Minas Ithil
ART_OF_MINAS_ITHIL.flavorText: A shining white ball of unbreakable crystal, the ancient Palantiri were used by kings of Numenor and later by the Exiles for rapid communication between distant lands.  This Palantir, however, was taken by Sauron long ago, and mastered to his evil uses, to the destruction of all others who would gaze into it.

ART_BALEFIRE.name: 유물: 'Balefire'
ART_BALEFIRE.flavorText: This silver-tipped bolt, ablaze with undying celestial fire, is especially potent against undead and creatures of the netherworld; it even points the way to places where such enemies lurk.

ART_STONE_BITER.name: 유물: 'Stone-biter'
ART_STONE_BITER.flavorText: Wherever it strikes, this silver-tipped bolt eats through rock and metal as easily as through flesh.  The dwarf-smith who crafted Stone-biter also inscribed the shaft with powerful doom-spells against the orcs and trolls who had destroyed his ancestral home.

ART_HEART_S_BLOOD.name: 유물: 'Heart's Blood'
ART_HEART_S_BLOOD.flavorText: The barbed head of this bolt glows deep red with terrible runes of destruction; legend has it that Heart's Blood cannot hit its mark without causing a mortal wound.

ART_SCALE_PIERCER.name: 유물: 'Scale-piercer'
ART_SCALE_PIERCER.flavorText: This bolt, crafted from the bones of a Great Wyrm, is less famous and less powerful than Bard's black arrow.  Nonetheless it enables the owner to find dragons unerringly, face them bravely, and kill them swiftly.

ART_OF_FOROCHEL.name: 유물: of Forochel
ART_OF_FOROCHEL.flavorText: A shaft of pure, invincible crystal cut from the heart of one of the great glaciers ringing the Ice-Bay of Forochel. While you hold it, your mind feels as clear as the winter sky.

ART_OF_MELLYRN.name: 유물: of Mellyrn
ART_OF_MELLYRN.flavorText: Bearing the same lyrical name as the great trees of Lothlorien and containing in its close-woven folds the speed and skill of the Galadrim, this grey cloak is ideal for those who travel in forests.

ART_OF_EPHEL_DUATH.name: 유물: of Ephel Duath
ART_OF_EPHEL_DUATH.flavorText: This filthy orc-blade is famed for vile deeds of torture and blood, and its wielder will never cease to fear treachery.

ART_GARACHOTH.name: 유물: 'Garachoth'
ART_GARACHOTH.flavorText: A ghastly axe with the soul of a demon lord trapped inside, this horrifying creation reverberates with the screams of the damned.  As you gaze into its glassy, translucent blade, it seems that endless sulphrous wastelands stretch away from you into the distance, obscured by sheets of fire.

ART_SKYCLEAVER.name: 유물: 'Skycleaver'
ART_SKYCLEAVER.flavorText: The handgear of a legendary dragonslaying hero.  The wearer of these wyrmskin gauntlets will be versed in all aerial ways, and will fear no dragon that walks or flies.

ART_OF_THE_MACHINE.name: 유물: of the Machine
ART_OF_THE_MACHINE.flavorText: A massive pair of adamantine boots studded with gold, the final and greatest product of the petty-dwarven magical forge.  Despite the great powers they contain, they are heavy and awkward enough to make quite a racket whenever you move.
